/**
 * AttendSure - Universal Page Setup Modal
 * File: frontend/src/components/common/PageSetupModal.tsx
 *
 * Configures paper dimensions, margins, orientation, and layout format.
 * The official letterhead header is locked to Page 1 across all reports.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Check,
  RotateCw,
  FileText,
  Maximize2,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Palette,
  BookmarkCheck,
  Undo2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { PAPER_SIZES, MARGIN_PRESETS } from '../../types/pageSetup';
import type {
  PageSetupConfig,
  PaperSizeKey,
  PageOrientation,
  LayoutMode,
  MarginPresetKey,
} from '../../types/pageSetup';

interface PageSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentConfig: PageSetupConfig;
  onLiveChange?: (config: PageSetupConfig) => void;
  onApply: (config: PageSetupConfig, setAsDefault: boolean) => void;
  reportTitle?: string;
}

const PRESET_COLORS = [
  { label: 'Standard White', value: '#ffffff' },
  { label: 'Soft Ivory', value: '#fdfbf7' },
  { label: 'Clean Slate', value: '#f8fafc' },
  { label: 'Document Cream', value: '#fffdf5' },
];

export const PageSetupModal: React.FC<PageSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentConfig,
  onLiveChange,
  onApply,
  reportTitle = 'Report',
}) => {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageSetupConfig>({
    ...currentConfig,
    headerRepeat: 'first_page_only', // Enforce 1st page header rule
  });
  const [setAsDefault, setSetAsDefault] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const initialConfigRef = useRef<PageSetupConfig>(currentConfig);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setDraft({
        ...currentConfig,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      });
      initialConfigRef.current = currentConfig;
      setSetAsDefault(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, currentConfig]);

  const updateDraft = useCallback(
    (newDraft: PageSetupConfig) => {
      const standardizedDraft: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...newDraft,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      setDraft(standardizedDraft);
      onLiveChange?.(standardizedDraft);
    },
    [onLiveChange]
  );

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    onLiveChange?.(initialConfigRef.current);
    onClose();
  }, [onLiveChange, onClose]);

  // Keyboard shortcut listener (Escape to cancel)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleCancel();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, handleCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleOrientationChange = (orientation: PageOrientation) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, orientation });
  };

  const handleLayoutModeChange = (layoutMode: LayoutMode) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, layoutMode });
  };

  const handlePaperSizeChange = (paperSize: PaperSizeKey) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, paperSize });
  };

  const handlePageColorChange = (pageColor: string) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, pageColor });
  };

  const handleMarginPresetChange = (preset: MarginPresetKey) => {
    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: preset,
      margins: { ...MARGIN_PRESETS[preset].margins },
    });
  };

  const handleCustomMarginChange = (side: keyof PageSetupConfig['margins'], val: number) => {
    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: 'custom',
      margins: {
        ...draft.margins,
        [side]: Math.max(0, Number(val) || 0),
      },
    });
  };

  const handleResetToInitial = () => {
    updateDraft(initialConfigRef.current);
    setSetAsDefault(false);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    onApply(draft, setAsDefault);
    onClose();
  };

  const selectedPaper = PAPER_SIZES[draft.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.folio;
  const isLandscape = draft.orientation === 'landscape';
  const liveWidth = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.height : selectedPaper.width;
  const liveHeight = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.width : selectedPaper.height;

  return (
    <div
      style={overlayStyle}
      onClick={handleCancel}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="page-setup-modal-title"
    >
      <div style={modalContainerStyle} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div style={modalHeaderStyle}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <div style={iconBadgeStyle}>
              <SlidersHorizontal size={18} color="#0284c7" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 id="page-setup-modal-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                Page Setup
              </h2>
              <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                Configure document layout for {reportTitle}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleCancel}
            style={closeButtonStyle}
            aria-label="Close page setup modal"
            type="button"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div style={modalBodyStyle}>
          {/* 1. Layout Mode (Pages vs Pageless) */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <label style={sectionLabelStyle}>Layout Format</label>
            <div style={buttonToggleGridStyle}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleLayoutModeChange('pages')}
                style={{
                  ...toggleCardStyle,
                  borderColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <FileText size={16} color={draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Pages</span>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                  Divided sheets with Page 1 header, footers &amp; paper bounds.
                </p>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleLayoutModeChange('pageless')}
                style={{
                  ...toggleCardStyle,
                  borderColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <Maximize2 size={16} color={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Pageless</span>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                  Continuous fluid layout with header at the top.
                </p>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Orientation */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <label style={sectionLabelStyle}>Orientation</label>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless'}
                onClick={() => handleOrientationChange('landscape')}
                style={{
                  ...optionCardStyle,
                  opacity: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 0.5 : 1,
                  borderColor: draft.orientation === 'landscape' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.orientation === 'landscape' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <RotateCw size={15} color={draft.orientation === 'landscape' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Landscape</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Official DepEd SF1 / SF2 / SF4</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless'}
                onClick={() => handleOrientationChange('portrait')}
                style={{
                  ...optionCardStyle,
                  opacity: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 0.5 : 1,
                  borderColor: draft.orientation === 'portrait' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.orientation === 'portrait' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <FileText size={15} color={draft.orientation === 'portrait' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Portrait</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Standard upright format</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3. Paper Size Selection with Dimension Badge */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 6 }}>
              <label style={{ ...sectionLabelStyle, marginBottom: 0 }}>Paper Size</label>
              {draft.layoutMode !== 'pageless' && (
                <span style={dimensionBadgeStyle}>
                  {liveWidth.toFixed(2)}&quot; × {liveHeight.toFixed(2)}&quot; ({isLandscape ? 'Landscape' : 'Portrait'})
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <select
              disabled={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless'}
              value={draft.paperSize}
              onChange={(e) => handlePaperSizeChange(e.target.value as PaperSizeKey)}
              style={{
                ...selectDropdownStyle,
                opacity: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 0.5 : 1,
                cursor: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {Object.entries(PAPER_SIZES).map(([key, item]) => (
                <option key={key} value={key}>
                  {item.name} — {item.description} ({item.width}&quot; × {item.height}&quot;)
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* 4. Page Background Color */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <Palette size={15} color="#475569" />
              <label style={{ ...sectionLabelStyle, marginBottom: 0 }}>Page Background Color</label>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {PRESET_COLORS.map((c) => (
                <button
                  key={c.value}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handlePageColorChange(c.value)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 6,
                    padding: '6px 12px',
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    border: draft.pageColor === c.value ? '2px solid #0284c7' : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    backgroundColor: c.value,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '0.74rem',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: '#0f172a',
                  }}
                >
                  <span
                    style={{
                      width: 12,
                      height: 12,
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      backgroundColor: c.value,
                      border: '1px solid #94a3b8',
                      display: 'inline-block',
                    }}
                  />
                  {c.label}
                </button>
              ))}

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Custom:</span>
                <input
                  type="color"
                  value={draft.pageColor}
                  onChange={(e) => handlePageColorChange(e.target.value)}
                  style={colorPickerInputStyle}
                  title="Choose custom background color"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 5. Margins Configuration */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <label style={sectionLabelStyle}>Margins</label>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {(Object.keys(MARGIN_PRESETS) as MarginPresetKey[]).map((presetKey) => (
                <button
                  key={presetKey}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleMarginPresetChange(presetKey)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '5px 12px',
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    border: draft.marginPreset === presetKey ? '1px solid #0284c7' : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    backgroundColor: draft.marginPreset === presetKey ? '#0284c7' : '#ffffff',
                    color: draft.marginPreset === presetKey ? '#ffffff' : '#475569',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {MARGIN_PRESETS[presetKey].label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div style={marginInputsGridStyle}>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Top (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.top}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('top', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Bottom (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.bottom}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('bottom', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Left (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.left}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('left', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Right (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.right}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('right', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 6. Default Persistence Option */}
          <div style={defaultCheckboxContainerStyle}>
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={setAsDefault}
                onChange={(e) => setSetAsDefault(e.target.checked)}
                style={{ width: 16, height: 16, accentColor: '#0284c7', cursor: 'pointer' }}
              />
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <BookmarkCheck size={16} color="#0284c7" />
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  Set as default for all reports
                </span>
              </div>
            </label>
            <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 26px', fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
              Saves these dimensions across SF1, SF2, SF4, and future generated registers.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Actions */}
        <div style={modalFooterStyle}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResetToInitial}
            style={btnResetStyle}
            title="Reset to initial configuration"
          >
            <Undo2 size={14} />
            <span>Reset</span>
          </button>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
            <button type="button" onClick={handleCancel} style={btnSecondaryStyle}>
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={handleSave} style={btnApplyStyle}>
              <Check size={16} />
              <span>Apply Settings</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Server Pagination Bar & Safe CSV Exporter
 * File: web/src/components/common/Pagination.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. OWASP CSV Formula Injection Defense: Neutralizes cells starting with =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r.
 * 2. Asynchronous Memory Cleanup: Delays URL.revokeObjectURL by 1s to prevent premature download aborts.
 * 3. Strict Numeric Math: Guards against NaN / divide-by-zero during rapid page size switching.
 * 4. WCAG Accessible Controls: Adds aria-label descriptors to all buttons and select inputs.
 */

import React, { useId } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight } from 'lucide-react';

/** Safe upper ceiling representing "All" records without exhausting server RAM */
export const ALL_ROWS_SIZE = 10000;

export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS: number[] = [
  25,
  50,
  100,
  250,
  500,
  1000,
  ALL_ROWS_SIZE,
];

/**
 * Cybersecurity Helper: Sanitizes cell values to prevent CSV Formula / DDE Injection
 * in Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice, and Google Sheets.
 * Blocks: =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r
 */
export const sanitizeCsvCell = (val: string | number | boolean | undefined | null): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '""';
  
  // Escape internal double quotes by doubling them per RFC 4180
  const clean = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""').trim();
  
  // Neutralize formula trigger characters with a leading single quote
  if (/^[=+\-@\t\r|]/.test(clean)) {
    return `"'${clean}"`;
  }
  
  return `"${clean}"`;
};

/**
 * Reusable CSV Downloader for any table module.
 * Embeds UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF) for proper display of special characters in Excel.
 */
export const exportToCsv = (
  filename: string,
  headers: string[],
  rows: (string | number | boolean | undefined | null)[][]
): boolean => {
  if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return false;

  const csvLines = [
    headers.map((h) => sanitizeCsvCell(h)).join(','),
    ...rows.map((row) => row.map((cell) => sanitizeCsvCell(cell)).join(',')),
  ];

  // UTF-8 BOM prefix ensures correct rendering in Excel
  const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + csvLines.join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);

  // Defer revocation by 1 second to ensure browser has completed file stream
  setTimeout(() => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 1000);

  return true;
};

export interface PaginationProps {
  currentPage: number;
  totalPages: number;
  totalCount: number;
  pageSize: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange?: (size: number) => void;
  pageSizeOptions?: number[];
  itemLabel?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export const Pagination: React.FC<PaginationProps> = ({
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  totalCount,
  pageSize,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS,
  itemLabel = 'records',
  disabled = false,
  className,
  style,
}) => {
  const selectId = useId();

  if (totalCount <= 0) return null;

  // Defensive Numeric Guards
  const safePageSize = Math.max(1, Number(pageSize) || 25);
  const isAllSelected = safePageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;
  const safeTotalPages = isAllSelected ? 1 : Math.max(1, Number(totalPages) || 1);
  const safeCurrentPage = isAllSelected
    ? 1
    : Math.min(Math.max(1, Number(currentPage) || 1), safeTotalPages);

  const startRecord = isAllSelected ? 1 : (safeCurrentPage - 1) * safePageSize + 1;
  const endRecord = isAllSelected ? totalCount : Math.min(safeCurrentPage * safePageSize, totalCount);

  const isPrevDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage <= 1;
  const isNextDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage >= safeTotalPages;

  return (
    <div className={className} style={{ ...containerStyle, ...style }} role="navigation" aria-label="Pagination Navigation">
      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', color: '#475569' }}>
        Showing <strong>{startRecord.toLocaleString()}</strong> to <strong>{endRecord.toLocaleString()}</strong> of{' '}
        <strong>{totalCount.toLocaleString()}</strong> {itemLabel}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {onPageSizeChange && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginRight: 8 }}>
            <label htmlFor={selectId} style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
              Rows per page:
            </label>
            <select
              id={selectId}
              value={safePageSize}
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-label="Rows per page selector"
              onChange={(e) => {
                const nextSize = Number(e.target.value);
                if (!isNaN(nextSize) && nextSize > 0) {
                  onPageSizeChange(nextSize);
                }
              }}
              style={{
                ...selectStyle,
                opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
                cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {pageSizeOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt} value={opt}>
                  {opt >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 'All' : opt}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* First Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(1)}
          disabled={isPrevDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to first page"
          title="First Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isPrevDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isPrevDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronsLeft size={16} />
        </button>

        {/* Previous Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(safeCurrentPage - 1)}
          disabled={isPrevDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to previous page"
          title="Previous Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isPrevDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isPrevDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronLeft size={16} />
        </button>

        {/* Page Position Indicator */}
        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.80rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            padding: '0 8px',
            color: '#0f172a',
            userSelect: 'none',
          }}
        >
          Page {safeCurrentPage} of {safeTotalPages}
        </span>

        {/* Next Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(safeCurrentPage + 1)}
          disabled={isNextDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to next page"
          title="Next Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isNextDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isNextDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronRight size={16} />
        </button>

        {/* Last Page */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange(safeTotalPages)}
          disabled={isNextDisabled}
          aria-label="Go to last page"
          title="Last Page"
          style={{
            ...btnStyle,
            opacity: isNextDisabled ? 0.35 : 1,
            cursor: isNextDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
          }}
        >
          <ChevronsRight size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Pagination;

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable User & Faculty Avatar
 * Replaces duplicate implementations across FacultyTab, GateLogsTab, DTRTab, and MyAssignedClassesTab.
 * File: web/src/components/common/ProfileAvatar.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { User } from 'lucide-react';

interface ProfileAvatarProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  iconSize?: number;
}

export const ProfileAvatar: React.FC<ProfileAvatarProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name = 'Member',
  size = 38,
  iconSize = 19,
}) => {
  const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setImageFailed(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const hasPhoto = Boolean(
    photoUrl &&
      typeof photoUrl === 'string' &&
      photoUrl.trim() !== '' &&
      photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'null' &&
      photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'undefined'
  );

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-subtle, #f1f5f9)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e2e8f0)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {hasPhoto && !imageFailed ? (
        <img
          src={photoUrl!}
          alt={name}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
          onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
        />
      ) : (
        <User size={iconSize} color="var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProfileAvatar;

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Status Badge
 * Replaces hardcoded status pills for Attendance, Direction, and Account states.
 * File: web/src/components/common/StatusBadge.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import { LogIn, LogOut, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

interface StatusBadgeProps {
  status: string;
  type?: 'DIRECTION' | 'ATTENDANCE' | 'ACTIVE' | 'GENERIC';
}

export const StatusBadge: React.FC<StatusBadgeProps> = ({ status, type = 'GENERIC' }) => {
  const s = String(status || '').toUpperCase();

  let bg = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.12)';
  let text = 'var(--text-secondary, #64748b)';
  let border = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.25)';
  let icon: React.ReactNode = null;

  if (type === 'DIRECTION' || s === 'IN' || s === 'OUT') {
    if (s === 'IN') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
      icon = <LogIn size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <LogOut size={11} />;
    }
  } else if (type === 'ACTIVE' || s === 'ACTIVE' || s === 'INACTIVE') {
    if (s === 'ACTIVE') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
      icon = <CheckCircle2 size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <XCircle size={11} />;
    }
  } else if (type === 'ATTENDANCE' || ['PRESENT', 'LATE', 'ABSENT', 'CUTTING'].includes(s)) {
    if (s === 'PRESENT') {
      bg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-success, #10B981)';
      border = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)';
    } else if (s === 'LATE' || s === 'TARDY') {
      bg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-warning, #F59E0B)';
      border = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28)';
      icon = <Clock size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
      text = 'var(--brand-danger, #EF4444)';
      border = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)';
      icon = <AlertTriangle size={11} />;
    }
  }

  return (
    <span
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 4,
        padding: '3px 8px',
        borderRadius: 6,
        fontSize: '0.68rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        backgroundColor: bg,
        color: text,
        border: `1px solid ${border}`,
        letterSpacing: '0.2px',
      }}
    >
      {icon}
      <span>{s}</span>
    </span>
  );
};

export default StatusBadge;

}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [fetchFailed, setFetchFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Live Calendar State
  const [calendarDate, setCalendarDate] = useState<Date>(new Date());

  const isMounted = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const effectiveRole = (userRole || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isAdmin = effectiveRole === 'ADMIN' || effectiveRole === 'SUPERADMIN' || effectiveRole === 'PRINCIPAL';
  const isFaculty = effectiveRole === 'FACULTY';
  const isGuard = effectiveRole === 'GUARD';

  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardMetrics>({
    total_students: 0,
    students_present: 0,
    students_absent: 0,
    attendance_rate: 0,
    faculty_on_duty: 0,
    total_faculty: 0,
    gate_scans_today: 0,
    active_gate_passes: 0,
    sms_sent_today: 0,
    sms_pending_count: 0,
    sms_failed_count: 0,
    kiosks_online: 0,
    total_kiosks: 0,
    hourly_scans: [],
    grade_levels: [],
    recent_scans: [],
    notices: [],
    events: [],
    analytics: {},
    database: {},
  });

  const isOnline = isServerOnline && !fetchFailed;

  const navigateTo = (detail: string | { tab: string; report?: string }) => {
    const targetTab = typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : detail.tab;
    const targetReport = typeof detail === 'string' ? undefined : detail.report;

    if (onNavigateTab) {
      onNavigateTab(targetTab, targetReport);
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:navigate', { detail }));
  };

  const fetchDashboardData = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (abortControllerRef.current) {
        abortControllerRef.current.abort();
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortControllerRef.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setRefreshing(true);

        const res = await apiClient.get<DashboardMetrics>('/dashboard/overview/', {
          params: { silent: silent ? '1' : undefined },
          timeout: 6000,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (isMounted.current && res.data) {
          setFetchFailed(false);
          const totalStudents = Number(res.data.total_students) || 0;
          const presentStudents = Number(res.data.students_present) || 0;
          const calculatedRate =
            totalStudents > 0
              ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((presentStudents / totalStudents) * 100)))
              : Number(res.data.attendance_rate) || 0;

          const rawHourly = Array.isArray(res.data.hourly_scans) ? res.data.hourly_scans : [];
          const maxHourlyVolume = Math.max(...rawHourly.map((h) => Number(h.count) || 0), 1);
          const normalizedHourly = rawHourly.map((item) => {
            const count = Number(item.count) || 0;
            return {
              hour: String(item.hour || ''),
              count,
              height: count > 0 ? Math.round((count / maxHourlyVolume) * 100) : 0,
              is_peak: Boolean(item.is_peak),
            };
          });

          setData({
            total_students: totalStudents,
            students_present: presentStudents,
            students_absent: Number(res.data.students_absent) || Math.max(0, totalStudents - presentStudents),
            attendance_rate: calculatedRate,
            faculty_on_duty: Number(res.data.faculty_on_duty) || 0,
            total_faculty: Number(res.data.total_faculty) || 0,
            gate_scans_today: Number(res.data.gate_scans_today) || 0,
            active_gate_passes: Number(res.data.active_gate_passes) || 0,
            sms_sent_today: Number(res.data.sms_sent_today) || 0,
            sms_pending_count: Number(res.data.sms_pending_count) || 0,
            sms_failed_count: Number(res.data.sms_failed_count) || 0,
            kiosks_online: Number(res.data.kiosks_online) || 0,
            total_kiosks: Number(res.data.total_kiosks) || 0,
            hourly_scans: normalizedHourly,
            grade_levels: Array.isArray(res.data.grade_levels) ? res.data.grade_levels : [],
            recent_scans: Array.isArray(res.data.recent_scans) ? res.data.recent_scans : [],
            notices: Array.isArray(res.data.notices) ? res.data.notices : [],
            events: Array.isArray(res.data.events) ? res.data.events : [],
            analytics: res.data.analytics || {},
            database: res.data.database || {},
          });

          setLastSyncTime(
            new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
              hour: '2-digit',
              minute: '2-digit',
              second: '2-digit',
            })
          );

          if (onGateStatusChange) {
            onGateStatusChange((Number(res.data.kiosks_online) || 0) > 0);
          }
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (err && typeof err === 'object' && 'name' in err && err.name === 'CanceledError') {
          return;
        }
        if (isMounted.current) {
          setFetchFailed(true);
          if (onGateStatusChange) onGateStatusChange(false);
        }
      } finally {
        if (isMounted.current) {
          setLoading(false);
          if (!silent) setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [onGateStatusChange]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    fetchDashboardData(false);

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetchDashboardData(true);
    }, 20000);

    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (abortControllerRef.current) {
        abortControllerRef.current.abort();
      }
    };
  }, [fetchDashboardData]);

  const handleManualSync = () => {
    fetchDashboardData(false);
    if (onManualRefresh) {
      onManualRefresh();
    }
  };

  const hasHourlyScans = isOnline && data.hourly_scans.some((h) => h.count > 0);

  const currentMonthYear = useMemo(() => {
    return calendarDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  }, [calendarDate]);

  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => {
    const year = calendarDate.getFullYear();
    const month = calendarDate.getMonth();
    const firstDayIndex = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();

    const days: Array<{ day: number | null; isToday: boolean }> = [];
    const now = new Date();

    for (let i = 0; i < firstDayIndex; i++) {
      days.push({ day: null, isToday: false });
    }

    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
      const isToday =
        now.getFullYear() === year && now.getMonth() === month && now.getDate() === d;
      days.push({ day: d, isToday });
    }

    return days;
  }, [calendarDate]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 60, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
        <RefreshCw size={26} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 10px auto', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>Synchronizing school dashboard and hardware telemetry...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        height: '100%',
        overflowY: 'auto',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        padding: 'clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px)',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 1380, margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
        {/* 1. Telemetry Status Header */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 10,
            backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
            padding: '10px 18px',
            borderRadius: 14,
            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '4px 10px',
                borderRadius: 9999,
                backgroundColor: isOnline ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)',
                color: isOnline ? brand.success : brand.danger,
                fontSize: '0.70rem',
                fontWeight: 800,
                border: `1px solid ${isOnline ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)'}`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: isOnline ? brand.success : brand.danger }} />
              {isOnline ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE'}
            </span>

            {isAdmin && (
              <>
                <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  <Database size={13} color={brand.primary} />
                  <span>Server: {isOnline ? 'Active' : 'Offline'}</span>
                </span>
                <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  <Radio size={13} color={brand.primary} />
                  <span>Kiosks: {data.kiosks_online} of {data.total_kiosks} Online</span>
                </span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            {lastSyncTime && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                Synced: {lastSyncTime}
              </span>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleManualSync}
              disabled={refreshing}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                borderRadius: 8,
                padding: '5px 12px',
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
              <span>{refreshing ? 'Syncing...' : 'Sync Now'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Core KPI Statistics Grid */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr))', gap: 14 }}>
          <div style={kpiCardStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
              <div>
                <span style={kpiLabelStyle}>LEARNERS IN SCHOOL</span>
                <div style={kpiValueStyle}>{isOnline ? data.students_present.toLocaleString() : '—'}</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 38, height: 38, borderRadius: 10, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)', color: brand.success }}>
                <UserCheck size={20} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={kpiFooterStyle}>
              <span style={{ color: brand.success, fontWeight: 800 }}>{data.attendance_rate}%</span>
              <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>of {data.total_students} enrolled learners</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={kpiCardStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
              <div>
                <span style={kpiLabelStyle}>ABSENT LEARNERS</span>
                <div style={{ ...kpiValueStyle, color: data.students_absent > 0 ? brand.danger : tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {isOnline ? data.students_absent.toLocaleString() : '—'}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 38, height: 38, borderRadius: 10, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)', color: brand.danger }}>
                <UserX size={20} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={kpiFooterStyle}>
              <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>Unverified departures today</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={kpiCardStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
              <div>
                <span style={kpiLabelStyle}>FACULTY ON DUTY</span>
                <div style={kpiValueStyle}>
                  {isOnline ? `${data.faculty_on_duty}/${data.total_faculty}` : '—'}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 38, height: 38, borderRadius: 10, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)', color: brand.success }}>
                <Clock size={20} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={kpiFooterStyle}>
              <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>Verified on campus DTR</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={kpiCardStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
              <div>
                <span style={kpiLabelStyle}>GATE TAPS TODAY</span>
                <div style={kpiValueStyle}>{isOnline ? data.gate_scans_today.toLocaleString() : '—'}</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 38, height: 38, borderRadius: 10, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary }}>
                <Scan size={20} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={kpiFooterStyle}>
              <span style={{ color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>{data.active_gate_passes} Active Gate Passes</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 3. Quick Action Center */}
        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
            borderRadius: 16,
            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
            padding: '18px 20px',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 14,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 30, height: 30, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <Sparkles size={16} color={brand.primary} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.94rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                Quick Action
              </h3>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                Immediate 1-click shortcuts for daily school operations
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr))',
              gap: 12,
            }}
          >
            {/* 1. Attendance Scanner (Faculty & Admin) */}
            {!isGuard && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => navigateTo('classroom-scanner')}
                style={actionTileStyle}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = brand.primary;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.1)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = tokens.borderSubtle;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ ...actionIconFrame, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary }}>
                  <QrCode size={20} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={actionTileTitle}>Attendance Scanner</div>
                  <div style={actionTileDesc}>Scan student QR or barcode card</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* 2. Issue Gate Pass (All Users) */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => navigateTo('gate-passes')}
              style={actionTileStyle}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = brand.primary;
                e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = tokens.borderSubtle;
                e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ ...actionIconFrame, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.1)', color: brand.primary }}>
                <Ticket size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div style={actionTileTitle}>{isFaculty ? 'Issue Student Permit' : 'Gate Passes'}</div>
                <div style={actionTileDesc}>Student exit &amp; faculty travel</div>
              </div>
            </button>

            {/* 3. Daily Attendance SF2 (Faculty & Admin) */}
            {!isGuard && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => navigateTo({ tab: 'reports', report: 'sf2' })}
                style={actionTileStyle}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = brand.primary;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = tokens.borderSubtle;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ ...actionIconFrame, backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)', color: brand.success }}>
                  <CalendarCheck size={20} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={actionTileTitle}>Daily Attendance (SF2)</div>
                  <div style={actionTileDesc}>Official DepEd attendance register</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* 4. Civil Service DTR (Faculty & Admin) */}
            {!isGuard && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => navigateTo('dtr')}
                style={actionTileStyle}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = brand.primary;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.1)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = tokens.borderSubtle;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ ...actionIconFrame, backgroundColor: 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.1)', color: brand.secondary }}>
                  <Clock size={20} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={actionTileTitle}>Civil Service DTR</div>
                  <div style={actionTileDesc}>Inspect and endorse Form 48 hours</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* 5. Live Gate Monitor (Guards & Admins) */}
            {(isAdmin || isGuard) && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => navigateTo('gate-logs')}
                style={actionTileStyle}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = brand.primary;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = tokens.borderSubtle;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ ...actionIconFrame, backgroundColor: 'rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1)', color: '#7c3aed' }}>
                  <Scan size={20} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={actionTileTitle}>Live Gate Monitor</div>
                  <div style={actionTileDesc}>Real-time arrival &amp; departure taps</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* 6. Class Lists / My Classes (Faculty & Admin) */}
            {!isGuard && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => navigateTo(isFaculty ? 'my-classes' : 'students')}
                style={actionTileStyle}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = brand.primary;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.1)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = tokens.borderSubtle;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ ...actionIconFrame, backgroundColor: 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.1)', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  {isFaculty ? <BookOpen size={20} /> : <Users size={20} />}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={actionTileTitle}>{isFaculty ? 'My Teaching Classes' : 'Class Lists'}</div>
                  <div style={actionTileDesc}>Verify enrolled students by section</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* 7. SMS Broadcast (Admin Only) */}
            {isAdmin && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => navigateTo('sms')}
                style={actionTileStyle}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = brand.primary;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)';
                }}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = tokens.borderSubtle;
                  e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ ...actionIconFrame, backgroundColor: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)', color: brand.warning }}>
                  <Send size={20} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={actionTileTitle}>SMS Parent Alert</div>
                  <div style={actionTileDesc}>Send emergency broadcast to parents</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 4. Split Main Content: Left Analytics & Right Utility Rail */}
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0, 1.8fr) minmax(320px, 1fr)', gap: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
            <div style={sectionCardStyle}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <div>
                  <h3 style={sectionCardTitle}>Arrivals by Hour</h3>
                  <span style={sectionCardSubtitle}>Gate scanner arrivals recorded today</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 6, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary, fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  <TrendingUp size={12} color={brand.primary} />
                  <span>Today</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {hasHourlyScans ? (
                <div style={{ height: 180, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 8, padding: '12px 0 4px 0' }}>
                  {data.hourly_scans.map((item, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', height: '100%', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.62rem', fontWeight: 700, color: item.is_peak ? brand.primary : tokens.textMuted, marginBottom: 2 }}>
                        {item.count > 0 ? item.count : ''}
                      </span>
                      <div
                        style={{
                          width: '100%',
                          maxWidth: 28,
                          height: `${item.height}%`,
                          backgroundColor: item.is_peak ? brand.primary : item.count > 0 ? brand.secondary : tokens.borderSubtle,
                          borderRadius: '4px 4px 0 0',
                          transition: 'height 0.3s ease',
                        }}
                      />
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.62rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
                        {item.hour}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div style={emptyCardBox}>
                  <Inbox size={26} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    No Gate Scans Recorded Today
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={sectionCardStyle}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 12 }}>
                <div>
                  <h3 style={sectionCardTitle}>Recent Gate Taps</h3>
                  <span style={sectionCardSubtitle}>Real-time campus entrance &amp; exit feed</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => navigateTo('gate-logs')}
                  style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0 }}
                >
                  View All
                </button>
              </div>

              {data.recent_scans.length > 0 ? (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                  {data.recent_scans.slice(0, 5).map((scan, idx) => (

                        borderRadius: 10,
                        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                        <span
                          style={{
                            padding: '2px 8px',
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontSize: '0.66rem',
                            fontWeight: 800,
                            backgroundColor: scan.direction === 'IN' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)',
                            color: scan.direction === 'IN' ? brand.success : brand.danger,
                          }}
                        >
                          {scan.direction}
                        </span>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{scan.person_name}</div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                            {scan.grade_section} &bull; {scan.scan_method}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{scan.scan_time}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div style={emptyCardBox}>
                  <Inbox size={26} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    No Gate Taps Recorded Yet
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
            <div style={sectionCardStyle}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 14 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {currentMonthYear}
                </span>

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  <button

                    style={calNavBtn}

                  >
                    <ChevronRight size={14} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 6 }}>
                {['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'].map((d) => (

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 4, textAlign: 'center' }}>

              )}

};

/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Floating Framed Layout
 * File: web/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import Sidebar, { type NavItemKey } from './Sidebar';
import Header from './Header';
import Footer from './Footer';
import type { UserSession } from '../../types/section';

interface AppLayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  activeTab: NavItemKey;
  onSelectTab: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  title?: string;
  session?: UserSession | null;
}

export const AppLayout: React.FC<AppLayoutProps> = ({
  children,
  activeTab,
  onSelectTab,
  title = 'Dashboard',
  session = null,
}) => {
  const { tokens } = useTheme();
  const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Safely resolve active user session matching the exact UserSession type
  const activeSession: UserSession | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (session) return session;
    try {
      const rawUser = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user') || localStorage.getItem('user');
      const token =
        localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') ||
        localStorage.getItem('auth_token') ||
        localStorage.getItem('token') ||
        '';

      if (rawUser) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawUser);
        const resolved: UserSession = {
          user_id: parsed.id || parsed.user_id || 0,
          username: parsed.username || 'staff',
          role: String(parsed.role || parsed.system_role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase() as any,
          token,
          faculty_name: parsed.faculty_name || parsed.full_name || parsed.username || 'Staff User',
        };
        return resolved;
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback if local storage is empty or unparseable
    }
    return null;
  }, [session]);

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        minHeight: '100vh',
        height: '100vh',
        padding: 'clamp(6px, 1.2vw, 14px)',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp || '#f1f5f9',
        display: 'flex',
        gap: 'clamp(6px, 1.2vw, 14px)',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease',
      }}
    >
      {/* 1. Collapsible Sidebar Navigation */}
      <Sidebar
        activeTab={activeTab}
        onSelectTab={onSelectTab}
        session={activeSession}
        isCollapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
        onToggleCollapse={() => setIsSidebarCollapsed((prev) => !prev)}
        schoolName="Lapasan National High School"
        schoolId="55555"
      />

      {/* 2. Floating Main Workspace Card */}
      <div
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          minWidth: 0,
          height: '100%',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface || '#ffffff',
          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle || '#e2e8f0'}`,
          borderRadius: 16,
          boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow || '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
        }}
      >
        {/* Top Header */}
        <Header
          currentTitle={title}
          activeTab={activeTab}
          onNavigateTab={onSelectTab}
          session={activeSession}
        />

        {/* Scrollable Main Content Area */}
        <main
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            minHeight: 0,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle || '#f8fafc',
            padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)',
            overflowY: 'auto',
            overflowX: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            userSelect: 'text',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ flex: '1 0 auto', width: '100%', maxWidth: '100%' }}>
            {children}
          </div>
        </main>

        {/* Responsive System Footer */}
        <Footer />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AppLayout;

/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Main Header
 * File: web/src/components/layout/Header.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import StudentIdPassModal from '../modals/StudentIdPassModal';
import {
  Search,
  Bell,
  ChevronDown,
  LogOut,
  User,
  Shield,
  BookOpen,
  Send,
  Cpu,
  FileClock,
  CheckCircle2,
  X,
  Activity,
  QrCode,
  Inbox,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { UserSession } from '../../types/section';
import type { NavItemKey } from './Sidebar';

export interface TabBadgeCounts {
  students?: number;
  faculties?: number;
  schedules?: number;
  gatelogs?: number;
  sms?: number;
  gatepasses?: number;
  scanners?: number;
  [key: string]: number | undefined;
}

export function formatBadgeCount(count?: number | null): string {
  if (count === undefined || count === null || count <= 0) return '';
  if (count > 999) return `${(count / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(count);
}

export interface HeaderProps {
  title?: string;
  currentTitle?: string;
  activeTab?: string;
  onTabChange?: (tab: string) => void;
  isGateNodeOnline?: boolean;
  session?: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  onLogout?: () => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  onOpenProfile?: () => void;
}

interface CurrentUser {
  username: string;
  full_name: string;
  role: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  employee_id?: string;
  rfid_uid?: string;
}

interface NotificationItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  type: 'GATE' | 'CLASS' | 'SMS' | 'KIOSK' | 'GATE_PASS';
  time: string;
  targetRole?: 'ADMIN' | 'ALL';
}

const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') {
    return false;
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('javascript:') || clean.startsWith('vbscript:')) {
    return false;
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('data:') && !clean.startsWith('data:image/')) {
    return false;
  }
  return (
    clean.startsWith('http://') ||
    clean.startsWith('https://') ||
    clean.startsWith('/') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    clean.startsWith('blob:')
  );
};

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  title,
  currentTitle = 'Dashboard',
  isGateNodeOnline,
  userPhoto,
  onLogout,
  onOpenProfile,
}) => {
  const displayTitle = title || currentTitle;
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<CurrentUser>({
    username: '',
    full_name: '',
    role: '',
  });

  const [gateOnline, setGateOnline] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [searchVal, setSearchVal] = useState<string>('');
  const [dropdownOpen, setDropdownOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [notifOpen, setNotifOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [readIds, setReadIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [liveNotifications, setLiveNotifications] = useState<NotificationItem[]>([]);
  const [isDigitalPassOpen, setIsDigitalPassOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof isGateNodeOnline === 'boolean') {
      setGateOnline(isGateNodeOnline);
    }
  }, [isGateNodeOnline]);

  const fetchSystemStatus = useCallback(async () => {
    const token =
      localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') ||
      localStorage.getItem('auth_token') ||
      localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (!token) return;

    try {
      const [userRes, kioskRes, smsRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get('/me/'),
        apiClient.get('/kiosks/'),
        apiClient.get('/sms-outbox/metrics/').catch(() => null),
      ]);

      if (userRes.status === 'fulfilled' && userRes.value?.data) {
        const u = userRes.value.data;
        setCurrentUser({
          username: u.username || '',
          full_name: u.full_name || u.first_name || u.username || 'User',
          role: String(u.role || u.system_role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase(),
          photo_url: u.photo_url || u.photo || null,
          employee_id: u.employee_id || u.username || '',
          rfid_uid: u.rfid_uid || '',
        });
      }

      const generatedAlerts: NotificationItem[] = [];

      if (kioskRes.status === 'fulfilled' && kioskRes.value?.data) {
        const kiosks = Array.isArray(kioskRes.value.data)
          ? kioskRes.value.data
          : kioskRes.value.data.results || [];

        const hasOnlineKiosks =
          kiosks.length === 0 ||
          kiosks.some(
            (k: { is_active?: boolean; is_online?: boolean }) =>
              k.is_active !== false && k.is_online !== false
          );

        if (typeof isGateNodeOnline !== 'boolean') {
          setGateOnline(hasOnlineKiosks);
        }

        const offlineList = kiosks.filter(
          (k: { is_active?: boolean; is_online?: boolean }) => k.is_active && !k.is_online
        );

        if (offlineList.length > 0) {
          generatedAlerts.push({
            id: 'gate-offline-alert',
            title: 'Gate Scanner Offline',
            message: `${offlineList.length} gate scanner unit(s) are currently disconnected.`,
            type: 'KIOSK',
            time: 'Just now',
            targetRole: 'ADMIN',
          });
        }
      }

      if (smsRes && smsRes.status === 'fulfilled' && smsRes.value?.data) {
        const pendingCount = Number(smsRes.value.data.pending_total || 0);
        const failedCount = Number(smsRes.value.data?.failed_total || 0);

        if (pendingCount > 50 || failedCount > 0) {
          generatedAlerts.push({
            id: 'sms-pending-alert',
            title: 'Text Alert Delay',
            message: `${pendingCount} parent text message(s) are waiting to be sent.`,
            type: 'SMS',
            time: 'Just now',
            targetRole: 'ADMIN',
          });
        }
      }

      setLiveNotifications(generatedAlerts);
    } catch {
      if (typeof isGateNodeOnline !== 'boolean') setGateOnline(false);
    }
  }, [isGateNodeOnline]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSystemStatus();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchSystemStatus, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [fetchSystemStatus]);

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    if (onLogout) {
      onLogout();
      return;
    }
    try {
      await apiClient.post('/auth/logout/').catch(() => {});
    } finally {
      localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_token');
      localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_username');
      localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_role');
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:auth-expired'));
    }
  };

  const role = currentUser.role;
  const isAdminOrPrincipal = role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'SUPERADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL';
  const isFaculty = role === 'FACULTY';

  const visibleNotifications = useMemo(() => {
    return liveNotifications.filter((n) => {
      if (n.targetRole === 'ADMIN') return isAdminOrPrincipal;
      if ((n.targetRole as string) === 'FACULTY') return isFaculty || isAdminOrPrincipal;
      return true;
    });
  }, [liveNotifications, isAdminOrPrincipal, isFaculty]);

  const unreadCount = useMemo(() => {
    return visibleNotifications.filter((n) => !readIds.includes(n.id)).length;
  }, [visibleNotifications, readIds]);

  const markAllAsRead = () => {
    setReadIds(visibleNotifications.map((n) => n.id));
  };

  const dismissNotification = (id: string) => {
    setReadIds((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev : [...prev, id]));
  };

  const getNotifIcon = (type: NotificationItem['type']) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'CLASS':
        return <BookOpen size={14} color={brand.primary} />;
      case 'SMS':
        return <Send size={14} color={brand.secondary} />;
      case 'KIOSK':
        return <Cpu size={14} color={brand.danger} />;
      case 'GATE_PASS':
        return <FileClock size={14} color={brand.warning} />;
      default:
        return <Shield size={14} color={brand.primary} />;
    }
  };

  const rawPhoto = userPhoto || currentUser.photo_url;
  const resolvedPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto : null;

  return (
    <header
      style={{
        backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        padding: '12px clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 24px)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: '12px 16px',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: '100%',
        minHeight: 64,
        position: 'relative',
        zIndex: 40,
      }}
    >
      {/* Page Title & School ID */}
      <div style={{ flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 'min(100%, 200px)' }}>
        <h1
          style={{
            margin: 0,
            fontSize: 'clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem)',
            fontWeight: 800,
            color: tokens.textPrimary,
            letterSpacing: '-0.3px',
            lineHeight: 1.2,
          }}
        >
          {displayTitle}
        </h1>
        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.74rem',
            color: tokens.textMuted,
            marginTop: 3,
            display: 'block',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
          }}
        >
          Macasandig National High School | School ID: 55555
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Action Controls */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: '8px 12px',
          justifyContent: 'flex-end',
          flex: '1 1 auto',
        }}
      >
        {/* Search Input Box */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
            borderRadius: 9999,
            padding: '6px 12px',
            flex: '1 1 160px',
            maxWidth: 240,
            minWidth: 130,
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
          }}
        >
          <Search size={14} color={tokens.textMuted} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search student, LRN..."
            value={searchVal}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchVal(e.target.value)}
            style={{
              border: 'none',
              background: 'transparent',
              outline: 'none',
              fontSize: '0.78rem',
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
              width: '100%',
              minWidth: 0,
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* My Gate Pass Button */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsDigitalPassOpen(true)}
          style={{
            display: 'inline-flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 6,
            padding: '6px 12px',
            borderRadius: 9999,
            fontSize: '0.74rem',
            fontWeight: 700,
            backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
            border: `1px solid ${brand.primary}`,
            color: brand.primary,

            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',

          }}
          title="Open your personal gate QR code pass"
        >
          <QrCode size={13} />
          <span>My Pass</span>

        {/* Gate Status Pill */}
        <div
          style={{

                {currentUser.role || 'FACULTY'}
              </div>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown size={14} color={tokens.textMuted} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />

          {dropdownOpen && (
            <div
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                top: 'calc(100% + 8px)',
                right: 0,
                backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                borderRadius: 12,
                boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
                width: 'min(190px, calc(100vw - 32px))',
                zIndex: 1000,
                overflow: 'hidden',
                boxSizing: 'border-box',
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ padding: '8px 12px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Logged in as</span>
                <strong style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textPrimary, wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>
                  {currentUser.username || 'User'}
                </strong>
              </div>

              {onOpenProfile && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDropdownOpen(false);
                    onOpenProfile();
                  }}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 8,
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '8px 12px',
                    border: 'none',
                    background: 'none',
                    fontSize: '0.76rem',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: tokens.textPrimary,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    textAlign: 'left',
                  }}
                >
                  <User size={14} />
                  <span>Profile</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleLogout}
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 8,
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 12px',
                  border: 'none',
                  background: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.76rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: brand.danger,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  textAlign: 'left',
                }}
              >
                <LogOut size={14} color={brand.danger} />
                <span>Sign Out</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {isDigitalPassOpen && (

          student={{

          } as any}
          onClose={() => setIsDigitalPassOpen(false)}
          onCopyLrn={(id) => {
            if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(id);
          }}

      )}
