/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Modular Tab Navigation Bar
 * File: web/src/components/layout/Navbar.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { formatBadgeCount, type TabBadgeCounts } from './Header';
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  DoorOpen,
  BookOpen,
  GraduationCap,
  Users,
  Calendar,
  MessageSquare,
  Ticket,
  Cpu,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface NavbarProps {
  activeTab: string;
  onTabChange: (tabId: string) => void;
  badgeCounts?: TabBadgeCounts;
}

export const Navbar: React.FC<NavbarProps> = ({
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
  badgeCounts = {},
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [internalBadges, setInternalBadges] = useState<TabBadgeCounts>(badgeCounts);
  const [totalBadges, setTotalBadges] = useState<number>(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const fetchBadges = async () => {
      try {
        const results = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get('/students/metrics/'),
          apiClient.get('/sms-outbox/metrics/'),
        ]);

        if (!isMounted) return;

        const studRes = results[0].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[0].value : null;
        const smsRes = results[1].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[1].value : null;

        const counts: TabBadgeCounts = {
          ...badgeCounts,
          students: studRes?.data?.total || badgeCounts.students,
          sms: smsRes?.data?.pending_total || badgeCounts.sms,
        };

        setInternalBadges(counts);

        const sum = Object.values(counts).reduce<number>((acc: number, curr: unknown) => {
          return acc + (typeof curr === 'number' ? curr : 0);
        }, 0);

        setTotalBadges(sum);
      } catch {
        const fallbackSum = Object.values(badgeCounts).reduce<number>((acc: number, curr: unknown) => {
          return acc + (typeof curr === 'number' ? curr : 0);
        }, 0);
        if (isMounted) setTotalBadges(fallbackSum);
      }
    };

    fetchBadges();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchBadges, 25000);
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [badgeCounts]);

  const navItems = [
    { id: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard },
    { id: 'gatelogs', label: 'Gate Logs', icon: DoorOpen, badgeKey: 'gatelogs' },
    { id: 'classes', label: 'Classes', icon: BookOpen },
    { id: 'students', label: 'Students', icon: GraduationCap, badgeKey: 'students' },
    { id: 'faculties', label: 'Faculties', icon: Users, badgeKey: 'faculties' },
    { id: 'schedules', label: 'Schedules', icon: Calendar, badgeKey: 'schedules' },
    { id: 'sms', label: 'SMS Alerts', icon: MessageSquare, badgeKey: 'sms' },
    { id: 'gatepasses', label: 'Gate Passes', icon: Ticket, badgeKey: 'gatepasses' },
    { id: 'scanners', label: 'Scanners', icon: Cpu, badgeKey: 'scanners' },
  ];

  return (
    <nav
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 6,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        padding: '0 clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 24px)',
        overflowX: 'auto',
        WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        width: '100%',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      }}
      aria-label="Navigation Tabs"
    >
      {navItems.map((item) => {
        const Icon = item.icon;
        const isActive = activeTab === item.id;
        const rawCount = item.badgeKey ? internalBadges[item.badgeKey] : undefined;
        const badgeLabel = formatBadgeCount(rawCount);

        return (
          <button
            key={item.id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onTabChange(item.id)}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              padding: '12px 14px',
              border: 'none',
              background: 'transparent',
              borderBottom: isActive ? `2.5px solid ${brand.primary}` : '2.5px solid transparent',
              color: isActive ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
              fontSize: '0.80rem',
              fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 500,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              flexShrink: 0,
              transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
            }}
          >
            <Icon size={16} color={isActive ? brand.primary : tokens.textMuted} />
            <span>{item.label}</span>
            {badgeLabel && (
              <span
                style={{
                  padding: '2px 6px',
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  fontSize: '0.64rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  backgroundColor: isActive ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: isActive ? brand.primary : tokens.textMuted,
                }}
              >
                {badgeLabel}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}

      {totalBadges > 0 && (
        <span style={{ display: 'none' }} aria-hidden="true">
          {totalBadges}
        </span>
      )}
    </nav>
  );
};

export default Navbar;

/**
 * AttendSure - User Account & Profile Popover Menu (Theme Adaptive)
 * File: web/src/components/layout/ProfileDropdown.tsx
 */

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  Clock,
  KeyRound,
  LogOut,
  CheckCircle2,
  UserCog,
  Shield,
  Settings,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { UserSession } from '../../types/section';
import type { NavItemKey } from './Sidebar';

interface ProfileDropdownProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  session: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  onLogout: () => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  onOpenProfile?: () => void;
}

export const ProfileDropdown: React.FC<ProfileDropdownProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  session,
  userPhoto,
  onLogout,
  onNavigateTab,
  onOpenProfile,
}) => {
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [imgError, setImgError] = useState(false);
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      }
    },
    [onClose]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose, handleKeyDown]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const userName = session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'User';
  const userRole = (session?.role || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const userInitial = userName ? userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : '?';

  const handleAction = (tab?: NavItemKey) => {
    if (tab && onNavigateTab) {
      onNavigateTab(tab);
    }
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSecurityAction = () => {
    if (userRole === 'ADMIN') {
      if (onNavigateTab) {
        onNavigateTab('users');
      } else {
        const host = window.location.hostname || 'localhost';
        const protocol = window.location.protocol || 'http:';
        window.open(`${protocol}//${host}:8000/admin/auth/user/`, '_blank');
      }
    } else {
      if (onNavigateTab) {
        onNavigateTab('settings');
      }
    }
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={dropdownRef}
      role="menu"
      aria-label="User Account Menu"
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        top: 52,
        right: 0,
        width: 'min(300px, 90vw)',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderRadius: 14,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        zIndex: 100,
        overflow: 'hidden',
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        userSelect: 'none',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ padding: '16px 16px 12px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: 44,
              height: 44,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              backgroundColor: brand.primary,
              color: '#ffffff',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              fontWeight: 800,
              fontSize: '1.05rem',
              flexShrink: 0,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              border: `2px solid ${tokens.primaryLight}`,
            }}
          >
            {userPhoto && !imgError ? (
              <img
                src={userPhoto}
                alt={userName}
                onError={() => setImgError(true)}
                style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
              />
            ) : (
              userInitial
            )}
          </div>

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {onOpenProfile && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {

              onOpenProfile();

            backgroundColor: 'transparent',

        >
          <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
            {userRole === 'ADMIN' ? <Shield size={16} color={brand.primary} /> : <KeyRound size={16} color={tokens.textMuted} />}
          </div>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              {userRole === 'ADMIN' ? 'User & Role Security' : 'Account Security'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
              {userRole === 'ADMIN' ? 'Manage faculty roles & credentials' : 'Credentials & session policies'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleAction('settings')}
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 10,

          <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            onClose();
            onLogout();
          }}
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 10,
            padding: '8px 10px',
            borderRadius: 8,
            border: 'none',
            backgroundColor: 'transparent',
            width: '100%',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            transition: 'background-color 0.12s ease',
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)')}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent')}
        >
          <div style={{ width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>

          </div>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 700, color: brand.danger }}>Log Out</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>End current session safely</div>
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProfileDropdown;

import React, { useMemo, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export type NavItemKey =
  | 'dashboard'
  | 'classroom-scanner'
  | 'my-classes'
  | 'advisory-monitor'
  | 'gate-logs'
  | 'students'
  | 'facultys'
  | 'users'
  | 'gate-passes'
  | 'schedules'
  | 'dtr'
  | 'geofence'
  | 'scanners'
  | 'sms'
  | 'reports'
  | 'settings';

interface SidebarProps {
  activeTab: NavItemKey;
  onSelectTab: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  session?: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  isCollapsed?: boolean;
  onToggleCollapse?: () => void;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  canTeach?: boolean;
  allowedTabs?: NavItemKey[];
  badgeCounts?: TabBadgeCounts;
}

interface NavItem {
  key: NavItemKey;
  label: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}

interface NavGroup {
  groupTitle: string;
  items: NavItem[];
}

interface HoverTooltipState {
  label: string;
  badge?: string;
  top: number;
  left: number;
}

// Cybersecurity: Block unsafe URI schemes (XSS prevention)
const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('javascript:') || clean.startsWith('vbscript:')) return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('data:') && !clean.startsWith('data:image/')) return false;
  return (
    clean.startsWith('http://') ||
    clean.startsWith('https://') ||
    clean.startsWith('/') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    clean.startsWith('blob:')
  );
};

// Generates school initials abbreviation (e.g., "Lapasan National High School" -> "LNHS")
const getSchoolAbbreviation = (name?: string): string => {
  if (!name || !name.trim()) return 'AS';
  const clean = name.trim();
  const ignoreWords = new Set(['of', 'the', 'and', 'in', 'at', 'for', 'to', 'ng', 'mga', 'sa']);
  const words = clean.split(/\s+/).filter((w) => !ignoreWords.has(w.toLowerCase()));
  if (words.length === 1) {
    return words[0].slice(0, 4).toUpperCase();
  }
  return words.map((w) => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 6);
};

const formatBadge = (count?: number): string => {
  if (!count || count <= 0) return '';
  return count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
};

export const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({

  onToggleCollapse,

  schoolId = '55555',
  schoolLogo,
  canTeach = false,
  allowedTabs,
  badgeCounts: propBadgeCounts,

  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [liveBadges, setLiveBadges] = useState<TabBadgeCounts>({});
  const [tooltip, setTooltip] = useState<HoverTooltipState | null>(null);

  // Persistent sidebar collapse state (icons-only vs tab names)
  const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('attendsure_sidebar_collapsed') === 'true';
  });

  const isCollapsed = controlledCollapsed !== undefined ? controlledCollapsed : internalCollapsed;

  const handleToggle = () => {
    const nextState = !isCollapsed;
    setInternalCollapsed(nextState);
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_sidebar_collapsed', String(nextState));
    if (onToggleCollapse) {
      onToggleCollapse();
    }
  };

  const role = (session?.role || 'ADMIN').toUpperCase();
  const isLeadership = role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'SUPERADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL' || role === 'DEPT_HEAD';

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBadgeSync = (e: Event) => {
      const customEvent = e as CustomEvent<TabBadgeCounts>;
      if (customEvent.detail) {
        setLiveBadges(customEvent.detail);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', handleBadgeSync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', handleBadgeSync);
  }, []);

  const mergedBadges: TabBadgeCounts = { ...liveBadges, ...propBadgeCounts };
  const schoolAbbreviation = useMemo(() => getSchoolAbbreviation(schoolName), [schoolName]);

  const allMenuGroups: NavGroup[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        groupTitle: 'OVERVIEW',
        items: [
          { key: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: <LayoutDashboard size={20} /> },
          { key: 'gate-logs', label: 'Gate Logs', icon: <Scan size={20} /> },
        ],
      },
      {
        groupTitle: 'ACADEMICS',
        items: [
          { key: 'classroom-scanner', label: 'Attendance Scanner', icon: <QrCode size={20} /> },
          { key: 'my-classes', label: 'Classes', icon: <BookOpen size={20} /> },
          { key: 'advisory-monitor', label: 'Advisory Matrix', icon: <LayoutGrid size={20} /> },
          { key: 'students', label: 'Students', icon: <GraduationCap size={20} /> },
          { key: 'facultys', label: 'Faculties', icon: <Users size={20} /> },
          { key: 'schedules', label: 'Schedules', icon: <CalendarDays size={20} /> },
        ],
      },
      {
        groupTitle: 'GATE & TELEMETRY',
        items: [
          { key: 'sms', label: 'SMS Alerts', icon: <Send size={20} /> },
          { key: 'gate-passes', label: 'Gate Passes', icon: <Ticket size={20} /> },
          { key: 'scanners', label: 'Gate Kiosks', icon: <Cpu size={20} /> },
          { key: 'dtr', label: 'DTR', icon: <Clock size={20} /> },
          { key: 'geofence', label: 'Geofence', icon: <MapPin size={20} /> },
        ],
      },
      {
        groupTitle: 'GOVERNANCE',
        items: [
          { key: 'reports', label: 'Reports', icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={20} /> },
          { key: 'users', label: 'Users', icon: <UserCheck size={20} /> },
          { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: <Settings size={20} /> },
        ],
      },
    ],
    []
  );

  const filteredMenuGroups = useMemo(() => {
    return allMenuGroups
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        items: group.items.filter((item) => {
          if (allowedTabs && allowedTabs.length > 0) {
            return allowedTabs.includes(item.key);
          }
          if (item.key === 'classroom-scanner') return canTeach || isLeadership;
          if (item.key === 'my-classes') return canTeach;
          if (item.key === 'advisory-monitor') return canTeach || isLeadership;
          if (item.key === 'users') return role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'SUPERADMIN';
          if (['settings', 'sms', 'scanners', 'geofence'].includes(item.key)) {

          }
          if (['facultys', 'reports', 'schedules'].includes(item.key)) return isLeadership;
          if (role === 'GUARD') return ['dashboard', 'gate-logs', 'gate-passes'].includes(item.key);
          return true;
        }),
      }))
      .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
  }, [allMenuGroups, allowedTabs, canTeach, role, isLeadership]);

  const safeLogo = isSafeImageUrl(schoolLogo) ? schoolLogo : null;
  const safeUserPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(userPhoto) ? userPhoto : null;

  return (

          alignItems: 'center',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',

            alignItems: 'center',
            width: '100%',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
            position: 'relative',
          }}
        >
          {/* Collapse/Expand Toggle Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleToggle}

                src={safeUserPhoto}
                alt="Profile"
                style={{
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  objectFit: 'cover',
                  border: `2px solid ${brand.primary}`,
                }}
              />
            ) : (
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                  color: brand.primary,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.85rem',
                  border: `1.5px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                }}
              >
                {session?.faculty_name ? session.faculty_name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'U'}
              </div>
            )}
            <span
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                bottom: 0,
                right: 0,
                width: 10,
                height: 10,
                backgroundColor: brand.success,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                border: `2px solid ${tokens.bgSurface}`,
              }}
            />
          </div>

          {!isCollapsed && (
            <div style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.78rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                }}
              >
                {session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'User'}
              </div>
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.64rem',
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  color: tokens.textMuted,
                  textTransform: 'uppercase',
                }}
              >
                {role}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Floating Hover Tooltip (Icons-only mode) */}
      {tooltip && isCollapsed && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: tooltip.top,
            left: tooltip.left,
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            zIndex: 9999,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
            color: tokens.textPrimary,
            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            borderRadius: 8,
            padding: '7px 12px',
            boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16)',
            fontSize: '0.80rem',
            fontWeight: 700,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            animation: 'fadeIn 0.12s ease',
          }}
        >
          <span>{tooltip.label}</span>
          {tooltip.badge && (
            <span
              style={{
                backgroundColor: brand.danger,
                color: '#FFFFFF',
                borderRadius: 9999,
                padding: '1px 6px',
                fontSize: '0.64rem',
                fontWeight: 800,
              }}
            >
              {tooltip.badge}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;

File: web\src\components\modals\AcademicSetupModal.tsx

/**
 * AttendSure - Academic Structure Setup Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/AcademicSetupModal.tsx
 * Allows management of Sections, Advisers, Schedules, and Subject Faculty.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import {
  Calendar,
  BookOpen,
  DoorOpen,
  Layers,
  Users,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  Trash2,
  Edit2,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';

export type TabType =
  | 'SECTIONS'
  | 'SCHEDULE'
  | 'SECTION'
  | 'ROOM'
  | 'ROOMS'
  | 'SUBJECT'
  | 'SUBJECTS'
  | 'GRADES'
  | 'YEARS';

export interface AcademicSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated?: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  initialTab?: TabType;
  editItem?: any;
}

const normalizeTab = (tab: TabType): 'SECTIONS' | 'SCHEDULE' | 'ROOMS' | 'SUBJECTS' | 'GRADES' | 'YEARS' => {
  if (tab === 'SECTION' || tab === 'SECTIONS') return 'SECTIONS';
  if (tab === 'SCHEDULE') return 'SCHEDULE';
  if (tab === 'ROOM' || tab === 'ROOMS') return 'ROOMS';
  if (tab === 'SUBJECT' || tab === 'SUBJECTS') return 'SUBJECTS';
  if (tab === 'GRADES') return 'GRADES';
  return 'YEARS';
};

export const AcademicSetupModal: React.FC<AcademicSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onUpdated,
  onSuccess,
  initialTab = 'SECTIONS',
  editItem = null,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<
    'SECTIONS' | 'SCHEDULE' | 'ROOMS' | 'SUBJECTS' | 'GRADES' | 'YEARS'
  >(normalizeTab(initialTab));

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Database Records
  const [years, setYears] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [grades, setGrades] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [facultyList, setFacultyList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<any[]>([]);

  // Section & Adviser Form State
  const [sectionForm, setSectionForm] = useState({
    id: null as number | null,
    name: '',
    grade_level: '',
    adviser_id: '',
    room_number: '',
    capacity: 45,
  });

  // Schedule & Subject Faculty Form State
  const [scheduleForm, setScheduleForm] = useState({
    id: null as number | null,
    section_id: '',
    subject_id: '',
    faculty_id: '',
    room_id: '',
    start_time: '07:30',
    end_time: '08:30',
    days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',
  });

  // Simple Structural Forms (Rooms, Subjects, Grades)
  const [simpleForm, setSimpleForm] = useState({
    code: '',
    name: '',
    building: '',
    capacity: 45,
    title: '',
    units: 1,
  });

  // Synchronize Tab & Edit Item
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialTab) {
      const target = normalizeTab(initialTab);
      setActiveSubTab(target);

      if (editItem) {
        if (target === 'SECTIONS') {
          const advId =
            editItem.adviser_id ||
            (typeof editItem.adviser === 'object' && editItem.adviser ? editItem.adviser.id : editItem.adviser) ||
            '';
          const gradeId =
            editItem.grade_level_id ||
            (typeof editItem.grade_level === 'object' && editItem.grade_level ? editItem.grade_level.id : editItem.grade_level) ||
            '';

          setSectionForm({
            id: editItem.id || null,
            name: editItem.name || editItem.section_name || '',
            grade_level: String(gradeId || ''),
            adviser_id: String(advId || ''),
            room_number: editItem.room_number || '',
            capacity: editItem.capacity || 45,
          });
        } else if (target === 'SCHEDULE') {
          const secId =
            editItem.section_id ||
            (typeof editItem.section === 'object' && editItem.section ? editItem.section.id : editItem.section) ||
            '';
          const subId =
            editItem.subject_id ||
            (typeof editItem.subject === 'object' && editItem.subject ? editItem.subject.id : editItem.subject) ||
            '';
          const facId =
            editItem.faculty_id ||
            (typeof editItem.faculty === 'object' && editItem.faculty ? editItem.faculty.id : editItem.faculty) ||
            '';
          const roomId =
            (typeof editItem.room === 'object' && editItem.room ? editItem.room.id : editItem.room) || '';

          setScheduleForm({
            id: editItem.id || null,
            section_id: String(secId || ''),
            subject_id: String(subId || ''),
            faculty_id: String(facId || ''),
            room_id: String(roomId || ''),
            start_time: editItem.start_time ? String(editItem.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '07:30',
            end_time: editItem.end_time ? String(editItem.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',
            days_of_week: editItem.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
          });
        }
      } else {
        // Reset to clean states
        setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 });
        setScheduleForm({ id: null, section_id: '', subject_id: '', faculty_id: '', room_id: '', start_time: '07:30', end_time: '08:30', days_of_week: 'MON-FRI' });
      }
    }
  }, [initialTab, editItem]);

  // Fast Batch Data Loading
  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get('/academic-years/'),
        apiClient.get('/grade-levels/'),
        apiClient.get('/rooms/'),
        apiClient.get('/subjects/'),
        apiClient.get('/sections/?page_size=300'),
        apiClient.get('/faculty/dropdown/').catch(() => apiClient.get('/faculties/')),
        apiClient.get('/schedules/?page_size=300'),
      ]);

      const getData = (res: PromiseSettledResult<any>) =>
        res.status === 'fulfilled' && res.value?.data
          ? Array.isArray(res.value.data)
            ? res.value.data
            : res.value.data.results || []
          : [];

      setYears(getData(results[0]));
      setGrades(getData(results[1]));
      setRooms(getData(results[2]));
      setSubjects(getData(results[3]));
      setSections(getData(results[4]));
      setFacultyList(getData(results[5]));
      setSchedules(getData(results[6]));
    } catch {
      setError('Could not fetch academic records.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadData();
    }
  }, [isOpen, loadData]);

  // Handle Section & Adviser Save
  const handleSaveSection = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!sectionForm.name.trim()) {
      setError('Section name is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (!sectionForm.grade_level) {
      setError('Please select a grade level.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    const payload = {
      name: sectionForm.name.trim(),
      grade_level: Number(sectionForm.grade_level),
      adviser_id: sectionForm.adviser_id ? Number(sectionForm.adviser_id) : null,
      adviser: sectionForm.adviser_id ? Number(sectionForm.adviser_id) : null,
      room_number: sectionForm.room_number.trim(),
      capacity: Number(sectionForm.capacity) || 45,
    };

    try {
      if (sectionForm.id) {
        await apiClient.patch(`/sections/${sectionForm.id}/`, payload);
        setSuccessMessage('Section and Class Adviser updated successfully.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post('/sections/', payload);
        setSuccessMessage('New Section and Class Adviser assigned.');
      }

      setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 });
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.detail || err.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to save section.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle Class Schedule & Subject Faculty Save
  const handleSaveSchedule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!scheduleForm.section_id) {
      setError('Please select a class section.');
      return;
    }
    if (!scheduleForm.subject_id) {
      setError('Please select an academic subject.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    const payload = {
      section: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      section_id: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      subject: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      subject_id: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      faculty: scheduleForm.faculty_id ? Number(scheduleForm.faculty_id) : null,
      faculty_id: scheduleForm.faculty_id ? Number(scheduleForm.faculty_id) : null,
      room: scheduleForm.room_id ? Number(scheduleForm.room_id) : null,
      start_time: scheduleForm.start_time,
      end_time: scheduleForm.end_time,
      days_of_week: scheduleForm.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
    };

    try {
      if (scheduleForm.id) {
        await apiClient.patch(`/schedules/${scheduleForm.id}/`, payload);
        setSuccessMessage('Class schedule and Subject Faculty updated.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post('/schedules/', payload);
        setSuccessMessage('New class period and Subject Faculty assigned.');
      }

      setScheduleForm({
        id: null,
        section_id: '',
        subject_id: '',
        faculty_id: '',
        room_id: '',
        start_time: '07:30',
        end_time: '08:30',
        days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',
      });
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.detail || err.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to save schedule period.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle Simple Items (Rooms, Subjects, Grades)
  const handleAddSimpleItem = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      if (activeSubTab === 'ROOMS') {
        await apiClient.post('/rooms/', {
          name: simpleForm.name.trim(),
          building: simpleForm.building.trim(),
          capacity: Number(simpleForm.capacity) || 45,
        });
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
        await apiClient.post('/subjects/', {
          code: simpleForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
          title: simpleForm.title.trim(),
          units: Number(simpleForm.units) || 1,
        });
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'GRADES') {
        await apiClient.post('/grade-levels/', {
          code: simpleForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
          name: simpleForm.name.trim(),
        });
      }

      setSimpleForm({ code: '', name: '', building: '', capacity: 45, title: '', units: 1 });
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to save record.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = async (endpoint: string, id: number) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this record?')) return;
    try {
      await apiClient.delete(`/${endpoint}/${id}/`);
      loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch {
      alert('Could not delete record.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="Academic Structure & Faculty Assignments">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 8,
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            paddingBottom: 8,
            overflowX: 'auto',
          }}
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SECTIONS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Users size={14} /> Sections &amp; Advisers
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SCHEDULE'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Clock size={14} /> Schedules &amp; Subject Faculty
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SUBJECTS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <BookOpen size={14} /> Subjects
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('ROOMS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'ROOMS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <DoorOpen size={14} /> Classrooms
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('GRADES'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'GRADES', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Layers size={14} /> Grade Levels
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('YEARS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'YEARS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Calendar size={14} /> School Years
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status Alerts */}
        {error && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle('rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)', brand.danger)}>
            <AlertCircle size={15} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {successMessage && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle('rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)', brand.success)}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={15} />
            <span>{successMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 1. SECTIONS & CLASS ADVISER FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSection} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {sectionForm.id ? 'Edit Section & Adviser' : 'Add Section & Assign Class Adviser'}
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Section Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Diamond"
                    value={sectionForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, name: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Level *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={sectionForm.grade_level}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, grade_level: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Grade Level</option>
                    {grades.map((g) => (
                      <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>
                        {g.name || g.code}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                {/* Class Adviser Selection */}
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Adviser (Faculty)</label>
                  <select
                    value={sectionForm.adviser_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, adviser_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Default Room Number</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Room 204"
                    value={sectionForm.room_number}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, room_number: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
                {sectionForm.id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 })}
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : sectionForm.id ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Section'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            {/* List Existing Sections with Adviser */}
            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Grade</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Class Adviser</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {sections.map((sec) => {
                    const adviserName =
                      sec.adviser_name ||
                      sec.adviser_full_name ||
                      (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name : null) ||
                      facultyList.find((f) => f.id === sec.adviser_id || f.id === sec.adviser)?.full_name ||
                      'Unassigned';

                    return (
                      <tr key={sec.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{sec.name}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{sec.grade_level_name || sec.grade_level?.name || '—'}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: adviserName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : brand.primary, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                          {adviserName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const advId = sec.adviser_id || (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.id : sec.adviser) || '';
                              setSectionForm({
                                id: sec.id,
                                name: sec.name,
                                grade_level: String(sec.grade_level?.id || sec.grade_level || ''),
                                adviser_id: String(advId || ''),
                                room_number: sec.room_number || '',
                                capacity: sec.capacity || 45,
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Section & Adviser"
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('sections', sec.id)}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Section"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 2. SCHEDULES & SUBJECT FACULTY FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSchedule} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {scheduleForm.id ? 'Edit Class Schedule & Faculty' : 'Add Subject Period & Assign Faculty'}
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Section *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.section_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, section_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Section</option>
                    {sections.map((s) => (
                      <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                        {s.name} ({s.grade_level_name || s.grade_level?.name || 'Section'})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.subject_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, subject_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Subject</option>
                    {subjects.map((sub) => (
                      <option key={sub.id} value={sub.id}>
                        {sub.code} - {sub.title}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                {/* Subject Faculty Selection */}
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Faculty</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.faculty_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, faculty_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Classroom</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.room_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, room_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(Select Room)</option>
                    {rooms.map((r) => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                        {r.name} {r.building ? `(${r.building})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Start Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.start_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, start_time: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>End Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.end_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, end_time: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
                {scheduleForm.id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setScheduleForm({ id: null, section_id: '', subject_id: '', faculty_id: '', room_id: '', start_time: '07:30', end_time: '08:30', days_of_week: 'MON-FRI' })}
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : scheduleForm.id ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Class Period'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            {/* List Existing Schedules */}
            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject Faculty</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Time</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {schedules.map((sc) => {
                    const secName = sc.section_name || sc.section?.name || 'Section';
                    const subCode = sc.subject_code || sc.subject?.code || 'SUB';
                    const facultyName =
                      sc.faculty_name ||
                      (typeof sc.faculty === 'object' && sc.faculty ? sc.faculty.full_name || sc.faculty.name : null) ||
                      facultyList.find((f) => f.id === sc.faculty_id || f.id === sc.faculty)?.full_name ||
                      'Unassigned';

                    return (
                      <tr key={sc.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{secName}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>{subCode}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: facultyName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                          {facultyName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                          {String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5)} - {String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const secId = sc.section_id || (typeof sc.section === 'object' && sc.section ? sc.section.id : sc.section) || '';
                              const subId = sc.subject_id || (typeof sc.subject === 'object' && sc.subject ? sc.subject.id : sc.subject) || '';
                              const facId = sc.faculty_id || (typeof sc.faculty === 'object' && sc.faculty ? sc.faculty.id : sc.faculty) || '';
                              const roomId = (typeof sc.room === 'object' && sc.room ? sc.room.id : sc.room) || '';

                              setScheduleForm({
                                id: sc.id,
                                section_id: String(secId || ''),
                                subject_id: String(subId || ''),
                                faculty_id: String(facId || ''),
                                room_id: String(roomId || ''),
                                start_time: sc.start_time ? String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '07:30',
                                end_time: sc.end_time ? String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',
                                days_of_week: sc.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Schedule & Faculty"
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('schedules', sc.id)}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Schedule"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 3. SIMPLE MODES: ROOMS, SUBJECTS, GRADES, YEARS */}
        {!['SECTIONS', 'SCHEDULE'].includes(activeSubTab) && (
          <form onSubmit={handleAddSimpleItem} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {activeSubTab === 'ROOMS' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Room Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Room 101"
                    value={simpleForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Building</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Science Wing"
                    value={simpleForm.building}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, building: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {activeSubTab === 'GRADES' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Code</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. G7"
                    value={simpleForm.code}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Grade 7"
                    value={simpleForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Code</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. MATH7"
                    value={simpleForm.code}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Title</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g. Mathematics 7"
                    value={simpleForm.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, title: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {activeSubTab !== 'YEARS' && (
              <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : 'Add Record'}
              </Button>
            )}
          </form>
        )}

        {/* Simple Tables */}
        {!['SECTIONS', 'SCHEDULE'].includes(activeSubTab) && (
          <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Item Name / Code</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Details</th>
                  <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {activeSubTab === 'YEARS' &&
                  years.map((y) => (
                    <tr key={y.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{y.code}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                        {y.is_active ? <span style={{ color: brand.success, fontWeight: 700 }}>Active School Year</span> : 'Archived'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Locked</span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}

                {activeSubTab === 'GRADES' &&
                  grades.map((g) => (
                    <tr key={g.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{g.code}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{g.name}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('grade-levels', g.id)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                          <Trash2 size={13} />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}

                {activeSubTab === 'ROOMS' &&
                  rooms.map((r) => (
                    <tr key={r.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{r.name}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                        {r.building ? `${r.building} • ` : ''}Cap: {r.capacity}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('rooms', r.id)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                          <Trash2 size={13} />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}

                {activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' &&
                  subjects.map((s) => (
                    <tr key={s.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{s.code}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{s.title}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => handleDeleteItem('subjects', s.id)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                          <Trash2 size={13} />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
            Close
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};

// Styling definitions
const tabBtnStyle = (active: boolean, brandColor: string, tokens: any): React.CSSProperties => ({
  padding: '6px 12px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  border: 'none',
  backgroundColor: active ? tokens.primaryLight : 'transparent',
  color: active ? brandColor : tokens.textSecondary,
  fontWeight: 700,
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  cursor: 'pointer',
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  gap: 6,
  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
});

const formCardStyle = (tokens: any): React.CSSProperties => ({
  padding: 12,
  borderRadius: 8,
  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
});

const labelStyle = (tokens: any): React.CSSProperties => ({
  display: 'block',
  fontSize: '0.70rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: tokens.textSecondary,
  marginBottom: 3,
});

const inputStyle = (tokens: any): React.CSSProperties => ({
  width: '100%',
  padding: '6px 10px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
  color: tokens.textPrimary,
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  outline: 'none',
});

const tableContainer = (tokens: any): React.CSSProperties => ({
  maxHeight: 240,
  overflowY: 'auto',
  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
  borderRadius: 8,
});

  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  gap: 8,
  padding: '8px 12px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  backgroundColor: bg,
  color,
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  fontWeight: 600,
});

/**
 * AttendSure - First-Time Profile Completion Modal (With Live Validation)
 * File: frontend/src/components/profile/CompleteProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { UserCheck, ShieldCheck, Phone, Lock, Building, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface CompletedProfileUser {
  full_name?: string;
  username?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface CompleteProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onCompleted: (updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => void;
}

export const CompleteProfileModal: React.FC<CompleteProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onCompleted }) => {
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    contact_number: '',
    department: '',
    password: '',
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // Live validation rules computed on every keystroke
  const liveErrors = useMemo(() => {
    const errs: { first_name?: string; last_name?: string; contact_number?: string; password?: string } = {};

    if (formData.first_name && formData.first_name.trim().length < 2) {
      errs.first_name = 'First name must be at least 2 characters.';
    }
    if (formData.last_name && formData.last_name.trim().length < 2) {
      errs.last_name = 'Last name must be at least 2 characters.';
    }

    const cleanPhone = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    if (cleanPhone && !/^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone)) {
      errs.contact_number = 'Enter a valid 11-digit PH mobile number (e.g. 09171234567).';
    }

    if (formData.password) {
      if (formData.password.length < 8) {
        errs.password = 'New password must be at least 8 characters.';
      } else if (!/[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) || !/[0-9]/.test(formData.password)) {
        errs.password = 'Password must contain both letters and numbers.';
      }
    }

    return errs;
  }, [formData]);

  const isFormValid =
    formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    /^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '')) &&
    Object.keys(liveErrors).length === 0;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isFormValid) return;

    setSaving(true);
    const cleanContact = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    const payload: Record<string, string> = {
      first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
      middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
      last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
      suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
      contact_number: cleanContact,
      department: formData.department.trim(),
    };

    if (formData.password && formData.password.trim().length >= 8) {
      payload.password = formData.password.trim();
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put('/me/', payload);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Profile Completed',
        message: 'Your official faculty record is now active and synchronized.',
        type: 'success',
      });
      onCompleted(res.data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Completion Error',
        message: err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update profile.',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => {}} title="Complete Your Profile Information">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
            border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
            borderRadius: 8,
            padding: '10px 14px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 10,
          }}
        >
          <ShieldCheck size={20} color="#0284c7" />
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', color: '#1e3a8a', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>
            Your account was created by the School Administrator. Please complete your personal details to activate your DTR and class student_list access.
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>First Name *</label>
            <input
              required
              type="text"
              style={{
                ...inputStyle,
                borderColor: liveErrors.first_name ? '#dc2626' : formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 ? '#059669' : '#cbd5e1',
              }}
              value={formData.first_name}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. Maria"
            />
            {liveErrors.first_name && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.first_name}</span>}
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name *</label>
            <input
              required
              type="text"
              style={{
                ...inputStyle,
                borderColor: liveErrors.last_name ? '#dc2626' : formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 ? '#059669' : '#cbd5e1',
              }}
              value={formData.last_name}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, last_name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. Santos"
            />
            {liveErrors.last_name && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.last_name}</span>}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Middle Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.middle_name}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Optional"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Suffix</label>
            <select
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.suffix}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, suffix: e.target.value })}
            >
              <option value="">None</option>
              <option value="Jr.">Jr.</option>
              <option value="Sr.">Sr.</option>
              <option value="II">II</option>
              <option value="III">III</option>
              <option value="IV">IV</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>
              <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <Phone size={12} color="#64748b" /> Contact Number *
              </span>
            </label>
            <input
              required
              type="text"
              maxLength={13}
              placeholder="09171234567"
              style={{
                ...inputStyle,
                borderColor: liveErrors.contact_number
                  ? '#dc2626'
                  : formData.contact_number.length >= 11
                  ? '#059669'
                  : '#cbd5e1',
              }}
              value={formData.contact_number}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, contact_number: e.target.value })}
            />
            {liveErrors.contact_number && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.contact_number}</span>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>
              <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <Building size={12} color="#64748b" /> Department *
              </span>
            </label>
            <select
              required
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.department}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, department: e.target.value })}
            >
              <option value="Junior High School">Junior High School</option>
              <option value="Senior High School">Senior High School</option>
              <option value="English Department">English Department</option>
              <option value="Science Department">Science Department</option>
              <option value="Mathematics Department">Mathematics Department</option>
              <option value="Office of the Principal / Administration">Office of the Principal / Administration</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label style={labelStyle}>
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
              <Lock size={12} color="#64748b" /> Personal Password (Optional, min 8 chars)
            </span>
          </label>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Leave blank to keep your current password"
            style={{
              ...inputStyle,
              borderColor: liveErrors.password ? '#dc2626' : formData.password.length >= 8 ? '#059669' : '#cbd5e1',
            }}
            value={formData.password}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, password: e.target.value })}
          />
          {liveErrors.password && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.password}</span>}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
          <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving || !isFormValid}>
            {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <UserCheck size={16} />}
            <span>{saving ? 'Activating Profile...' : 'Complete & Activate Profile'}</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: '#334155',
  marginBottom: 4,
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%',
  padding: '8px 12px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
  fontSize: '0.84rem',
  outline: 'none',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  color: '#0f172a',
  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
};

const errorTextStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontSize: '0.70rem',
  color: '#dc2626',
  fontWeight: 600,
  marginTop: 3,
};

export default CompleteProfileModal;

          <div style={fieldInfoBox}>
            <span style={fieldInfoLabel}>TERMINAL</span>
