/**
 * AttendSure - Universal Page Setup Modal
 * File: frontend/src/components/common/PageSetupModal.tsx
 *
 * Configures paper dimensions, margins, orientation, and layout format.
 * The official letterhead header is locked to Page 1 across all reports.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Check,
  RotateCw,
  FileText,
  Maximize2,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Palette,
  BookmarkCheck,
  Undo2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { PAPER_SIZES, MARGIN_PRESETS } from '../../types/pageSetup';
import type {
  PageSetupConfig,
  PaperSizeKey,
  PageOrientation,
  LayoutMode,
  MarginPresetKey,
} from '../../types/pageSetup';

interface PageSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentConfig: PageSetupConfig;
  onLiveChange?: (config: PageSetupConfig) => void;
  onApply: (config: PageSetupConfig, setAsDefault: boolean) => void;
  reportTitle?: string;
}

const PRESET_COLORS = [
  { label: 'Standard White', value: '#ffffff' },
  { label: 'Soft Ivory', value: '#fdfbf7' },
  { label: 'Clean Slate', value: '#f8fafc' },
  { label: 'Document Cream', value: '#fffdf5' },
];

export const PageSetupModal: React.FC<PageSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentConfig,
  onLiveChange,
  onApply,
  reportTitle = 'Report',
}) => {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageSetupConfig>({
    ...currentConfig,
    headerRepeat: 'first_page_only', // Enforce 1st page header rule
  });
  const [setAsDefault, setSetAsDefault] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const initialConfigRef = useRef<PageSetupConfig>(currentConfig);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setDraft({
        ...currentConfig,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      });
      initialConfigRef.current = currentConfig;
      setSetAsDefault(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, currentConfig]);

  const updateDraft = useCallback(
    (newDraft: PageSetupConfig) => {
      const standardizedDraft: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...newDraft,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      setDraft(standardizedDraft);
      onLiveChange?.(standardizedDraft);
    },
    [onLiveChange]
  );

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    onLiveChange?.(initialConfigRef.current);
    onClose();
  }, [onLiveChange, onClose]);

  // Keyboard shortcut listener (Escape to cancel)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleCancel();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, handleCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleOrientationChange = (orientation: PageOrientation) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, orientation });
  };

  const handleLayoutModeChange = (layoutMode: LayoutMode) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, layoutMode });
  };

  const handlePaperSizeChange = (paperSize: PaperSizeKey) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, paperSize });
  };

  const handlePageColorChange = (pageColor: string) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, pageColor });
  };

  const handleMarginPresetChange = (preset: MarginPresetKey) => {
    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: preset,
      margins: { ...MARGIN_PRESETS[preset].margins },
    });
  };

  const handleCustomMarginChange = (side: keyof PageSetupConfig['margins'], val: number) => {
    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: 'custom',
      margins: {
        ...draft.margins,
        [side]: Math.max(0, Number(val) || 0),
      },
    });
  };

  const handleResetToInitial = () => {
    updateDraft(initialConfigRef.current);
    setSetAsDefault(false);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    onApply(draft, setAsDefault);
    onClose();
  };

  const selectedPaper = PAPER_SIZES[draft.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.folio;
  const isLandscape = draft.orientation === 'landscape';
  const liveWidth = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.height : selectedPaper.width;
  const liveHeight = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.width : selectedPaper.height;

  return (
    <div
      style={overlayStyle}
      onClick={handleCancel}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="page-setup-modal-title"
    >
      <div style={modalContainerStyle} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div style={modalHeaderStyle}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <div style={iconBadgeStyle}>
              <SlidersHorizontal size={18} color="#0284c7" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 id="page-setup-modal-title" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                Page Setup
              </h2>
              <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                Configure document layout for {reportTitle}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleCancel}
            style={closeButtonStyle}
            aria-label="Close page setup modal"
            type="button"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div style={modalBodyStyle}>
          {/* 1. Layout Mode (Pages vs Pageless) */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <label style={sectionLabelStyle}>Layout Format</label>
            <div style={buttonToggleGridStyle}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleLayoutModeChange('pages')}
                style={{
                  ...toggleCardStyle,
                  borderColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <FileText size={16} color={draft.layoutMode === 'pages' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Pages</span>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                  Divided sheets with Page 1 header, footers &amp; paper bounds.
                </p>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleLayoutModeChange('pageless')}
                style={{
                  ...toggleCardStyle,
                  borderColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <Maximize2 size={16} color={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Pageless</span>
                </div>
                <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                  Continuous fluid layout with header at the top.
                </p>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Orientation */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <label style={sectionLabelStyle}>Orientation</label>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless'}
                onClick={() => handleOrientationChange('landscape')}
                style={{
                  ...optionCardStyle,
                  opacity: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 0.5 : 1,
                  borderColor: draft.orientation === 'landscape' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.orientation === 'landscape' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <RotateCw size={15} color={draft.orientation === 'landscape' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Landscape</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Official DepEd SF1 / SF2 / SF4</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless'}
                onClick={() => handleOrientationChange('portrait')}
                style={{
                  ...optionCardStyle,
                  opacity: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 0.5 : 1,
                  borderColor: draft.orientation === 'portrait' ? '#0284c7' : '#cbd5e1',
                  backgroundColor: draft.orientation === 'portrait' ? '#f0f9ff' : '#ffffff',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <FileText size={15} color={draft.orientation === 'portrait' ? '#0284c7' : '#64748b'} />
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#0f172a' }}>Portrait</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Standard upright format</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3. Paper Size Selection with Dimension Badge */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 6 }}>
              <label style={{ ...sectionLabelStyle, marginBottom: 0 }}>Paper Size</label>
              {draft.layoutMode !== 'pageless' && (
                <span style={dimensionBadgeStyle}>
                  {liveWidth.toFixed(2)}&quot; × {liveHeight.toFixed(2)}&quot; ({isLandscape ? 'Landscape' : 'Portrait'})
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <select
              disabled={draft.layoutMode === 'pageless'}
              value={draft.paperSize}
              onChange={(e) => handlePaperSizeChange(e.target.value as PaperSizeKey)}
              style={{
                ...selectDropdownStyle,
                opacity: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 0.5 : 1,
                cursor: draft.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {Object.entries(PAPER_SIZES).map(([key, item]) => (
                <option key={key} value={key}>
                  {item.name} — {item.description} ({item.width}&quot; × {item.height}&quot;)
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* 4. Page Background Color */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
              <Palette size={15} color="#475569" />
              <label style={{ ...sectionLabelStyle, marginBottom: 0 }}>Page Background Color</label>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {PRESET_COLORS.map((c) => (
                <button
                  key={c.value}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handlePageColorChange(c.value)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 6,
                    padding: '6px 12px',
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    border: draft.pageColor === c.value ? '2px solid #0284c7' : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    backgroundColor: c.value,
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '0.74rem',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: '#0f172a',
                  }}
                >
                  <span
                    style={{
                      width: 12,
                      height: 12,
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      backgroundColor: c.value,
                      border: '1px solid #94a3b8',
                      display: 'inline-block',
                    }}
                  />
                  {c.label}
                </button>
              ))}

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Custom:</span>
                <input
                  type="color"
                  value={draft.pageColor}
                  onChange={(e) => handlePageColorChange(e.target.value)}
                  style={colorPickerInputStyle}
                  title="Choose custom background color"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 5. Margins Configuration */}
          <div style={sectionGroupStyle}>
            <label style={sectionLabelStyle}>Margins</label>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {(Object.keys(MARGIN_PRESETS) as MarginPresetKey[]).map((presetKey) => (
                <button
                  key={presetKey}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleMarginPresetChange(presetKey)}
                  style={{
                    padding: '5px 12px',
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    border: draft.marginPreset === presetKey ? '1px solid #0284c7' : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    backgroundColor: draft.marginPreset === presetKey ? '#0284c7' : '#ffffff',
                    color: draft.marginPreset === presetKey ? '#ffffff' : '#475569',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  {MARGIN_PRESETS[presetKey].label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div style={marginInputsGridStyle}>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Top (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.top}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('top', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Bottom (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.bottom}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('bottom', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Left (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.left}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('left', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={miniLabelStyle}>Right (in)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="0"
                  max="3"
                  value={draft.margins.right}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCustomMarginChange('right', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={numericInputStyle}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 6. Default Persistence Option */}
          <div style={defaultCheckboxContainerStyle}>
            <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={setAsDefault}
                onChange={(e) => setSetAsDefault(e.target.checked)}
                style={{ width: 16, height: 16, accentColor: '#0284c7', cursor: 'pointer' }}
              />
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <BookmarkCheck size={16} color="#0284c7" />
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  Set as default for all reports
                </span>
              </div>
            </label>
            <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 26px', fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
              Saves these dimensions across SF1, SF2, SF4, and future generated registers.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Actions */}
        <div style={modalFooterStyle}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResetToInitial}
            style={btnResetStyle}
            title="Reset to initial configuration"
          >
            <Undo2 size={14} />
            <span>Reset</span>
          </button>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
            <button type="button" onClick={handleCancel} style={btnSecondaryStyle}>
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={handleSave} style={btnApplyStyle}>
              <Check size={16} />
              <span>Apply Settings</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PageSetupModal;

  fontSize: '0.70rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, monospace',
  backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
  color: '#0284c7',

/**
 * AttendSure - User Profile View & Edit Modal
 * File: frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { Mail, Phone, Lock, Building, Briefcase, Camera, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProfileUpdatePayload {
  full_name?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface ProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onProfileUpdated?: (updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => void;
}

export const ProfileModal: React.FC<ProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onProfileUpdated }) => {
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    username: '',
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    email: '',
    contact_number: '',
    position: '',
    department: '',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get('/me/')
      .then((res) => {
        const u = res.data;
        setFormData({
          username: u.username || '',
          first_name: u.first_name || '',
          middle_name: u.middle_name || '',
          last_name: u.last_name || '',
          suffix: u.suffix || '',
          email: u.email || '',
          contact_number: u.contact_number || '',
          position: u.position || '',
          department: u.department || '',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        });
        setPhotoPreview(u.photo_url || u.photo || null);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        showAlert({
          title: 'Error',
          message: err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to load user profile.',
          type: 'error',
        });
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Format',
        message: 'Only JPG, PNG, and WebP images are allowed.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Profile photos must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const base64Str = reader.result as string;
      setPhotoPreview(base64Str);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: base64Str }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);

    const payload: Record<string, any> = {
      first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
      middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
      last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
      suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
      email: formData.email.trim(),
      contact_number: formData.contact_number.trim(),
    };

    if (formData.password && formData.password.trim().length >= 8) {
      payload.password = formData.password.trim();
    }

    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put('/me/', payload);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Profile Updated',
        message: 'Your profile changes have been saved.',
        type: 'success',
      });

      if (onProfileUpdated) {
        onProfileUpdated(res.data);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Update Failed',
        message: err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update profile.',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="My User Profile">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: '#64748b' }}>Loading details...</div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          {/* Photo Section */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, padding: 10, backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 54, height: 54, borderRadius: '50%', overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              {photoPreview ? (
                <img src={photoPreview} alt="Profile" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
              ) : (
                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  No Pic
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 4,
                  fontSize: '0.74rem',
                  padding: '4px 10px',
                  backgroundColor: '#0284c7',
                  color: '#fff',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                }}
              >
                <Camera size={12} /> Change Photo
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handlePhotoSelect} style={{ display: 'none' }} />
              </label>
              {photoPreview && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setPhotoPreview(null);
                    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: '' }));
                  }}
                  style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#dc2626', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  <X size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Remove
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>First Name</label>
              <input
                required
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.first_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name</label>
              <input
                required
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.last_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, last_name: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Middle Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.middle_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Suffix</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.suffix}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, suffix: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Jr., III..."
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Mail size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Email</label>
              <input
                type="email"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Phone size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Contact Number</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.contact_number}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, contact_number: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Briefcase size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Position</label>
              <input type="text" style={{ ...inputStyle, backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' }} value={formData.position} disabled />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Building size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Department</label>
              <input type="text" style={{ ...inputStyle, backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' }} value={formData.department} disabled />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}><Lock size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> New Password (Leave blank to keep current)</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              placeholder="Min 8 characters"
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.password}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, password: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving}>
              {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : 'Save Changes'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: '#334155',
  marginBottom: 4,
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Unified Digital ID & Gate Kiosk Pass Modal
 * Supports both Student and Faculty identification credentials.
 * File: web/src/components/modals/StudentIdPassModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { ShieldCheck, Copy, Check, Printer, User as UserIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { StudentItem, AssignedClass } from '../tabs/MyAssignedClassesTab';

interface StudentIdPassModalProps {
  student: (Partial<StudentItem> & { name: string; lrn: string; rfid_uid?: string; photo_url?: string | null }) | null;
  selectedClass?: AssignedClass | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCopyLrn: (lrn: string) => void;
}

const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('javascript:') || clean.startsWith('vbscript:')) return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('data:') && !clean.startsWith('data:image/')) return false;
  return (
    clean.startsWith('http://') ||
    clean.startsWith('https://') ||
    clean.startsWith('/') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    clean.startsWith('blob:')
  );
};

export const StudentIdPassModal: React.FC<StudentIdPassModalProps> = ({
  student,
  selectedClass,
  onClose,
  onCopyLrn,
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!student) return null;

  const safePhoto = isSafeImageUrl(student.photo_url) ? student.photo_url : null;
  const identifier = student.lrn || 'ID-00000';

  const handleCopy = () => {
    onCopyLrn(identifier);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={Boolean(student)} onClose={onClose} title="Digital Pass & Gate Kiosk QR">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: '6px 0' }}>
        <div
          id="printable-id-card"
          style={{

            border: '2px solid #004B87',
            borderRadius: 14,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.12)',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
          }}
        >
          {/* Card Header */}
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#004B87', color: '#FFFFFF', padding: '12px 14px' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: '0.70rem', fontWeight: 800 }}>
              <ShieldCheck size={14} color="#38bdf8" />
              <span>ATTENDSURE OFFICIAL PASS</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.60rem', color: '#E0F2FE', marginTop: 2 }}>
              Lapasan National High School &bull; Gate Clearance
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Card Body */}
          <div style={{ padding: '16px 14px' }}>
            <div style={{ margin: '0 auto 10px auto', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 54,
                  height: 54,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9',
                  border: '2px solid #E2E8F0',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                }}
              >
                {safePhoto ? (
                  <img
                    src={safePhoto}
                    alt={student.name}
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <UserIcon size={28} color="#94A3B8" />

              {student.name}
            </div>

            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569', marginTop: 4 }}>
              {selectedClass?.section_name || 'Authorized Member'}
            </div>

            {/* Identifier Badge with Copy Button */}
            <div
              onClick={handleCopy}
              style={{

            {/* High-Contrast QR Code for Gate Kiosks */}

/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Plain English System Health & Auto-Repair Center
 * Designed for School Principals, Registrars, and Administrative Staff.
 * File: web/src/components/modals/SystemHealthModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  Wrench,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  RefreshCw,
  Radio,
  Database,
  MessageSquare,
  Unlock,
  X,
  ShieldCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface SystemHealthModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface IssueItem {
  id: string;
  category: 'SMS' | 'GATE' | 'DATABASE' | 'ACCOUNTS';
  title: string;
  whatHappened: string;
  whatItMeans: string;
  solutionType: 'AUTO_BUTTON' | 'STEPS';
  actionButtonLabel?: string;
  actionEndpoint?: string;
  physicalSteps?: string[];
  severity: 'WARNING' | 'CRITICAL';
}

export const SystemHealthModal: React.FC<SystemHealthModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [activeFixingId, setActiveFixingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fixSuccessMessage, setFixSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [issues, setIssues] = useState<IssueItem[]>([]);

  // Checks hardware, database, SMS outbox, and account status
  const runDiagnostics = useCallback(async () => {
    setScanning(true);
    setFixSuccessMessage(null);
    const discoveredIssues: IssueItem[] = [];

    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get('/settings/school/'),
        apiClient.get('/sms-outbox/metrics/'),
        apiClient.get('/kiosks/'),
        apiClient.get('/users/'),
      ]);

      const schoolRes = results[0].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[0].value : null;
      const smsRes = results[1].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[1].value : null;
      const kioskRes = results[2].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[2].value : null;
      const usersRes = results[3].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[3].value : null;

      // 1. Check Database connection
      if (!schoolRes?.data) {
        discoveredIssues.push({
          id: 'db-offline',
          category: 'DATABASE',
          title: 'Database connection is resting or unresponsive',
          whatHappened: 'The school server cannot talk to the student records database.',
          whatItMeans: 'Attendance scans and reports cannot be saved right now.',
          solutionType: 'AUTO_BUTTON',
          actionButtonLabel: 'Reconnect School Database',
          actionEndpoint: '/core/maintenance/db-check/',
          severity: 'CRITICAL',
        });
      }

      // 2. Check SMS queue and modem
      if (smsRes?.data) {
        const pending = Number(smsRes.data.pending_total || smsRes.data.pending_queue || 0);
        const failed = Number(smsRes.data.failed_today || smsRes.data.failed_count || 0);

        if (pending > 20 || failed > 0) {
          discoveredIssues.push({
            id: 'sms-stuck',
            category: 'SMS',
            title: `${pending} text message(s) waiting to be sent to parents`,
            whatHappened: 'The GSM text modem connected to the server computer has paused delivery.',
            whatItMeans: 'Parents have not yet received attendance notifications on their phones.',
            solutionType: 'AUTO_BUTTON',
            actionButtonLabel: 'Restart SMS Sending Queue',
            actionEndpoint: '/sms/test-gateway/',
            physicalSteps: [
              'Check if the USB Text Modem dongle is firmly plugged into the computer USB port.',
              'Ensure the school SIM card inside the modem has regular airtime load or an active SMS promo.',
            ],
            severity: pending > 100 ? 'CRITICAL' : 'WARNING',
          });
        }
      }

      // 3. Check Gate Scanner Hardware
      if (kioskRes?.data) {
        const kioskList = Array.isArray(kioskRes.data)
          ? kioskRes.data
          : kioskRes.data.results || [];
        const offlineKiosks = kioskList.filter(
          (k: { is_online?: boolean; is_active?: boolean }) => k.is_active && !k.is_online
        );

        if (offlineKiosks.length > 0) {
          discoveredIssues.push({
            id: 'kiosk-offline',
            category: 'GATE',
            title: `${offlineKiosks.length} Gate Scanner(s) are offline`,
            whatHappened: 'The main gate scanner kiosk has lost connection to the server.',
            whatItMeans: 'Student and faculty ID card taps at this gate will not register on screen.',
            solutionType: 'AUTO_BUTTON',
            actionButtonLabel: 'Wake Up Gate Scanners',
            actionEndpoint: '/telemetry/ping-scanners/',
            physicalSteps: [
              'Ensure the gate scanner device has power and the LED light is ON.',
              'Check the blue network cable (LAN wire) connecting the gate scanner to the school network router.',
            ],
            severity: 'CRITICAL',
          });
        }
      }

      // 4. Check for locked user accounts
      if (usersRes?.data) {
        const userList = Array.isArray(usersRes.data)
          ? usersRes.data
          : usersRes.data.results || [];
        const lockedUsers = userList.filter(
          (u: { is_active?: boolean; is_locked?: boolean }) => u.is_locked || u.is_active === false
        );

        if (lockedUsers.length > 0) {
          discoveredIssues.push({
            id: 'users-locked',
            category: 'ACCOUNTS',
            title: `${lockedUsers.length} staff account(s) temporarily locked`,
            whatHappened: 'Faculty entered the wrong password multiple times.',
            whatItMeans: 'These faculty cannot sign in to check classroom student attendance.',
            solutionType: 'AUTO_BUTTON',
            actionButtonLabel: 'Unlock All Staff Accounts',
            actionEndpoint: '/core/maintenance/flush-cache/',
            severity: 'WARNING',
          });
        }
      }
    } catch {
      discoveredIssues.push({
        id: 'server-unreachable',
        category: 'DATABASE',
        title: 'AttendSure background server is starting up',
        whatHappened: 'The AttendSure server program is taking longer than usual to respond.',
        whatItMeans: 'Please wait a few seconds or click the button below to wake it up.',
        solutionType: 'AUTO_BUTTON',
        actionButtonLabel: 'Check Server Connection',
        actionEndpoint: '/core/maintenance/db-check/',
        severity: 'WARNING',
      });
    } finally {
      setIssues(discoveredIssues);
      setScanning(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      runDiagnostics();
    }
  }, [isOpen, runDiagnostics]);

  const handleExecuteFix = async (issue: IssueItem) => {
    if (!issue.actionEndpoint) return;
    setActiveFixingId(issue.id);
    setFixSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      await apiClient.post(issue.actionEndpoint);
      setFixSuccessMessage(`Repaired successfully! "${issue.title}" has been resolved.`);
      // Re-scan after 1.5 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        runDiagnostics();
      }, 1500);
    } catch {
      setFixSuccessMessage('The automated fix ran. Please re-check the physical steps below if the problem continues.');
    } finally {
      setActiveFixingId(null);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 9999,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(3px)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: 16,
        userSelect: 'none',
      }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: 680,
          backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
          borderRadius: 20,
          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          boxShadow: '0 20px 45px -10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15)',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          maxHeight: '90vh',
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '18px 24px',
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <div
              style={{
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                borderRadius: 10,
                backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
              }}
            >
              <Wrench size={18} color={brand.primary} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2
                style={{
                  margin: 0,
                  fontSize: '1.05rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                System Health &amp; Problem Solver
              </h2>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                Checks your hardware, messages, and gate connections automatically
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={runDiagnostics}
              disabled={scanning}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,

/**
 * AttendSure - First-Time Profile Completion Modal (With Live Validation)
 * File: frontend/src/components/profile/CompleteProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { UserCheck, ShieldCheck, Phone, Lock, Building, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface CompletedProfileUser {
  full_name?: string;
  username?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface CompleteProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onCompleted: (updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => void;
}

export const CompleteProfileModal: React.FC<CompleteProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onCompleted }) => {
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    contact_number: '',
    department: '',
    password: '',
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // Live validation rules computed on every keystroke
  const liveErrors = useMemo(() => {
    const errs: { first_name?: string; last_name?: string; contact_number?: string; password?: string } = {};

    if (formData.first_name && formData.first_name.trim().length < 2) {
      errs.first_name = 'First name must be at least 2 characters.';
    }
    if (formData.last_name && formData.last_name.trim().length < 2) {
      errs.last_name = 'Last name must be at least 2 characters.';
    }

    const cleanPhone = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    if (cleanPhone && !/^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone)) {
      errs.contact_number = 'Enter a valid 11-digit PH mobile number (e.g. 09171234567).';
    }

    if (formData.password) {
      if (formData.password.length < 8) {
        errs.password = 'New password must be at least 8 characters.';
      } else if (!/[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) || !/[0-9]/.test(formData.password)) {
        errs.password = 'Password must contain both letters and numbers.';
      }
    }

    return errs;
  }, [formData]);

  const isFormValid =
    formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    /^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '')) &&
    Object.keys(liveErrors).length === 0;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isFormValid) return;

    setSaving(true);
    const cleanContact = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    const payload: Record<string, string> = {
      first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
      middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
      last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
      suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
      contact_number: cleanContact,
      department: formData.department.trim(),
    };

    if (formData.password && formData.password.trim().length >= 8) {
      payload.password = formData.password.trim();
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put('/me/', payload);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Profile Completed',
        message: 'Your official faculty record is now active and synchronized.',
        type: 'success',
      });
      onCompleted(res.data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Completion Error',
        message: err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update profile.',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => {}} title="Complete Your Profile Information">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
            border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
            borderRadius: 8,
            padding: '10px 14px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 10,
          }}
        >
          <ShieldCheck size={20} color="#0284c7" />
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', color: '#1e3a8a', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>
            Your account was created by the School Administrator. Please complete your personal details to activate your DTR and class student_list access.
          </span>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>First Name *</label>
            <input
              required
              type="text"
              style={{
                ...inputStyle,
                borderColor: liveErrors.first_name ? '#dc2626' : formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 ? '#059669' : '#cbd5e1',
              }}
              value={formData.first_name}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. Maria"
            />
            {liveErrors.first_name && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.first_name}</span>}
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name *</label>
            <input
              required
              type="text"
              style={{
                ...inputStyle,
                borderColor: liveErrors.last_name ? '#dc2626' : formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 ? '#059669' : '#cbd5e1',
              }}
              value={formData.last_name}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, last_name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="e.g. Santos"
            />
            {liveErrors.last_name && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.last_name}</span>}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Middle Name</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.middle_name}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Optional"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Suffix</label>
            <select
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.suffix}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, suffix: e.target.value })}
            >
              <option value="">None</option>
              <option value="Jr.">Jr.</option>
              <option value="Sr.">Sr.</option>
              <option value="II">II</option>
              <option value="III">III</option>
              <option value="IV">IV</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>
              <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <Phone size={12} color="#64748b" /> Contact Number *
              </span>
            </label>
            <input
              required
              type="text"
              maxLength={13}
              placeholder="09171234567"
              style={{
                ...inputStyle,
                borderColor: liveErrors.contact_number
                  ? '#dc2626'
                  : formData.contact_number.length >= 11
                  ? '#059669'
                  : '#cbd5e1',
              }}
              value={formData.contact_number}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, contact_number: e.target.value })}
            />
            {liveErrors.contact_number && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.contact_number}</span>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>
              <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                <Building size={12} color="#64748b" /> Department *
              </span>
            </label>
            <select
              required
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.department}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, department: e.target.value })}
            >
              <option value="Junior High School">Junior High School</option>
              <option value="Senior High School">Senior High School</option>
              <option value="English Department">English Department</option>
              <option value="Science Department">Science Department</option>
              <option value="Mathematics Department">Mathematics Department</option>
              <option value="Office of the Principal / Administration">Office of the Principal / Administration</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label style={labelStyle}>
            <span style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
              <Lock size={12} color="#64748b" /> Personal Password (Optional, min 8 chars)
            </span>
          </label>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Leave blank to keep your current password"
            style={{
              ...inputStyle,
              borderColor: liveErrors.password ? '#dc2626' : formData.password.length >= 8 ? '#059669' : '#cbd5e1',
            }}
            value={formData.password}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, password: e.target.value })}
          />
          {liveErrors.password && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.password}</span>}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
          <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving || !isFormValid}>
            {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <UserCheck size={16} />}
            <span>{saving ? 'Activating Profile...' : 'Complete & Activate Profile'}</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: '#334155',
  marginBottom: 4,
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%',
  padding: '8px 12px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
  fontSize: '0.84rem',
  outline: 'none',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  color: '#0f172a',
  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
};

const errorTextStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontSize: '0.70rem',
  color: '#dc2626',
  fontWeight: 600,
  marginTop: 3,
};

export default CompleteProfileModal;

/**
 * AttendSure - User Profile View & Edit Modal
 * File: frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { Mail, Phone, Lock, Building, Briefcase, Camera, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProfileUpdatePayload {
  full_name?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface ProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onProfileUpdated?: (updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => void;
}

export const ProfileModal: React.FC<ProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onProfileUpdated }) => {
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    username: '',
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    email: '',
    contact_number: '',
    position: '',
    department: '',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get('/me/')
      .then((res) => {
        const u = res.data;
        setFormData({
          username: u.username || '',
          first_name: u.first_name || '',
          middle_name: u.middle_name || '',
          last_name: u.last_name || '',
          suffix: u.suffix || '',
          email: u.email || '',
          contact_number: u.contact_number || '',
          position: u.position || '',
          department: u.department || '',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        });
        setPhotoPreview(u.photo_url || u.photo || null);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        showAlert({
          title: 'Error',
          message: err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to load user profile.',
          type: 'error',
        });
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Format',
        message: 'Only JPG, PNG, and WebP images are allowed.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Profile photos must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const base64Str = reader.result as string;
      setPhotoPreview(base64Str);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: base64Str }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);

    const payload: Record<string, any> = {
      first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
      middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
      last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
      suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
      email: formData.email.trim(),
      contact_number: formData.contact_number.trim(),
    };

    if (formData.password && formData.password.trim().length >= 8) {
      payload.password = formData.password.trim();
    }

    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put('/me/', payload);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Profile Updated',
        message: 'Your profile changes have been saved.',
        type: 'success',
      });

      if (onProfileUpdated) {
        onProfileUpdated(res.data);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Update Failed',
        message: err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update profile.',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="My User Profile">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: '#64748b' }}>Loading details...</div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          {/* Photo Section */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, padding: 10, backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ width: 54, height: 54, borderRadius: '50%', overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              {photoPreview ? (
                <img src={photoPreview} alt="Profile" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
              ) : (
                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                  No Pic
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 4,
                  fontSize: '0.74rem',
                  padding: '4px 10px',
                  backgroundColor: '#0284c7',
                  color: '#fff',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                }}
              >
                <Camera size={12} /> Change Photo
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handlePhotoSelect} style={{ display: 'none' }} />
              </label>
              {photoPreview && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setPhotoPreview(null);
                    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: '' }));
                  }}
                  style={{ marginLeft: 8, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#dc2626', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  <X size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Remove
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>First Name</label>
              <input
                required
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.first_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name</label>
              <input
                required
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.last_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, last_name: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.4fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Middle Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.middle_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Suffix</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.suffix}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, suffix: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Jr., III..."
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Mail size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Email</label>
              <input
                type="email"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Phone size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Contact Number</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                style={inputStyle}
                value={formData.contact_number}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, contact_number: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Briefcase size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Position</label>
              <input type="text" style={{ ...inputStyle, backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' }} value={formData.position} disabled />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}><Building size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> Department</label>
              <input type="text" style={{ ...inputStyle, backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' }} value={formData.department} disabled />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}><Lock size={12} style={{ verticalAlign: 'middle' }} /> New Password (Leave blank to keep current)</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              placeholder="Min 8 characters"
              style={inputStyle}
              value={formData.password}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, password: e.target.value })}
            />
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving}>
              {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : 'Save Changes'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
};

const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  color: '#334155',
  marginBottom: 4,
};

const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%',
  padding: '8px 12px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
  fontSize: '0.84rem',
  outline: 'none',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  color: '#0f172a',
  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
};

export default ProfileModal;

/**
 * AttendSure - DepEd Manual of Style (DMOS) Header & Footer
 * File: web/src/components/reports/DepEdReportHeaderFooter.tsx
 *
 * EXACT LOGO PLACEMENT RULES:
 * - Header Top Left: Kagawaran ng Edukasyon Seal (left_logo)
 * - Header Top Right: Department of Education Logo (right_logo)
 * - Footer Bottom Left: Official School Logo / Emblem (school_logo)
 */

import React from 'react';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';

export interface DepEdReportHeaderProps {
  formTitle: string;
  formSubtitle?: string;
  formType?: 'SF1' | 'SF2' | 'SF4';
  reportData?: {
    school_id?: string;
    school_name?: string;
    region?: string;
    division?: string;
    district?: string;
    academic_year?: string;
    school_year?: string;
    grade_level?: string;
    section_name?: string;
    month?: string;
    year?: number | string;
    left_logo?: string | null;
    right_logo?: string | null;
    school_logo?: string | null;
  } | null;
}

// Cybersecurity: Validate that image sources use safe protocols to prevent XSS / script injection
const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (clean.startsWith('javascript:') || clean.startsWith('vbscript:')) return false;
  return (
    clean.startsWith('http://') ||
    clean.startsWith('https://') ||
    clean.startsWith('/') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/') ||
    clean.startsWith('blob:')
  );
};

export const DepEdReportHeader: React.FC<DepEdReportHeaderProps> = ({
  formTitle,
  formSubtitle,
  formType = 'SF1',
  reportData,

  const { school } = useSchool();

  const effectiveTopLeftLogo =
    (isSafeImageUrl(reportData?.left_logo) && reportData?.left_logo) ||
    (isSafeImageUrl(school.left_logo) && school.left_logo) ||
    null;

  // 2. Top Right Seal: Department of Education Seal (right_logo)
  const effectiveTopRightLogo =
    (isSafeImageUrl(reportData?.right_logo) && reportData?.right_logo) ||
    (isSafeImageUrl(school.right_logo) && school.right_logo) ||

  const effectiveSchoolId = reportData?.school_id || school.school_id || '';
  const effectiveDivision = reportData?.division || school.division || '';
  const effectiveRegion = reportData?.region || school.region || '';
  const effectiveDistrict = reportData?.district || school.district || '';
  const effectiveYear = reportData?.academic_year || reportData?.school_year || '';

  return (

export interface DepEdReportFooterProps {
  sealUrl?: string | null;
  address?: string;
  contactNumber?: string;
  email?: string;
  reportData?: {
    school_logo?: string | null;
    right_logo?: string | null;
  } | null;
}

export const DepEdReportFooter: React.FC<DepEdReportFooterProps> = ({
  sealUrl,
  address,
  contactNumber,
  email,
  reportData,
}) => {
  const { school } = useSchool();

  // 3. Footer Bottom Left: Official School Logo / Emblem (school_logo)
  const effectiveSchoolLogo =
    (isSafeImageUrl(sealUrl) && sealUrl) ||
    (isSafeImageUrl(reportData?.school_logo) && reportData?.school_logo) ||
    (isSafeImageUrl(school.school_logo) && school.school_logo) ||
    null;

  const effectiveAddress = address || school.address || '';
  const effectiveContact = contactNumber || school.contact_number || '';
  const effectiveEmail = email || school.email || '';

  return (
    <div style={dmosFooterStyle}>
      {/* Footer Bottom Left: School Logo (0.76 Inch) */}
      <div style={sealBoxStyle}>
        {effectiveSchoolLogo ? (
          <img
            src={effectiveSchoolLogo}
            alt="School Logo"
            style={sealImgStyle}
            loading="lazy"
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* Office Details – Calibri (Body), 10 point size */}
      <div style={dmosFooterDetailsStyle}>
        <div><strong>Address: </strong>{effectiveAddress || '—'}</div>
        <div>
          <strong>Contact No.: </strong>{effectiveContact || '—'} &bull;{' '}
          <strong>Email: </strong>{effectiveEmail || '—'}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
