/**
 * AttendSure - Official Reports Navigation & Export Action Bar (Theme Adaptive)
 * File: web/src/components/reports/ReportNavBar.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  FileText,
  CalendarCheck,
  Download,
  ChevronDown,
  Printer,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  ExternalLink,
  Table as TableIcon,
  FileCode,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  X,
  Maximize2,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface ReportTabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>;
}

export interface SectionOption {
  id: number | string;
  name: string;
  grade_level?: any;
  academic_year?: string;
  adviser_name?: string;
  display_label?: string;
}

export interface ReportExportHandlers {
  onExportPdf?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportExcel?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportGoogleSheets?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportWord?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportGoogleDocs?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportCsv?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onExportJson?: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

export type LayoutMode = 'pages' | 'pageless';

export interface ReportNavBarProps {
  reports?: ReportTabItem[];
  activeReportId: string;
  onSelectReport: (reportId: string) => void;
  academicYears?: string[];
  selectedAcademicYear?: string;
  onAcademicYearChange?: (year: string) => void;
  showAcademicYearFilter?: boolean;
  gradeLevels?: string[];
  selectedGradeLevel?: string;
  onGradeLevelChange?: (grade: string) => void;
  showGradeLevelFilter?: boolean;
  sections: SectionOption[];
  selectedSectionId: string | number;
  onSectionChange: (sectionId: string) => void;
  showSectionFilter?: boolean;
  showDateFilter?: boolean;
  selectedDate?: string;
  onDateChange?: (date: string) => void;
  showMonthFilter?: boolean;
  selectedMonth?: string;
  onMonthChange?: (month: string) => void;
  monthsList?: string[];
  showCalendarYearFilter?: boolean;
  selectedCalendarYear?: number;
  onCalendarYearChange?: (year: number) => void;
  searchQuery?: string;
  onSearchChange?: (query: string) => void;
  showSearch?: boolean;
  layoutMode?: LayoutMode;
  onToggleLayoutMode?: (mode: LayoutMode) => void;
  showLayoutModeToggle?: boolean;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
  isRefreshing?: boolean;
  onOpenPageSetup?: () => void;
  exportHandlers?: ReportExportHandlers;
  onPrint?: () => void;
  isExporting?: boolean;
  exportingText?: string;
  disableActions?: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_REPORTS: ReportTabItem[] = [
  { id: 'sf1', label: 'Form 1 (School Register)', icon: FileText },
  { id: 'sf2', label: 'Form 2 (Daily Attendance)', icon: CalendarCheck },
  { id: 'sf4', label: 'Form 4 (Monthly Movement)', icon: FileSpreadsheet },
];

const DEFAULT_MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'
];

const getCurrentMonthName = (): string => {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'long' }).format(new Date());
  } catch {
    return 'January';
  }
};

const extractGradeLevelName = (val: any): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'number') return `Grade ${val}`;
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const name = val.name || val.level || val.grade_name || val.grade || val.id;
    return name !== undefined && name !== null ? String(name).trim() : '';
  }
  return String(val).trim();
};

export const ReportNavBar: React.FC<ReportNavBarProps> = ({
  reports = DEFAULT_REPORTS,
  activeReportId,
  onSelectReport,
  academicYears = [],
  selectedAcademicYear = '',
  onAcademicYearChange,
  showAcademicYearFilter = false,
  gradeLevels = [],
  selectedGradeLevel = 'ALL',
  onGradeLevelChange,
  showGradeLevelFilter = true,
  sections = [],
  selectedSectionId,
  onSectionChange,
  showSectionFilter = true,
  showDateFilter = false,
  selectedDate = '',
  onDateChange,
  showMonthFilter = false,
  selectedMonth = getCurrentMonthName(),
  onMonthChange,
  monthsList = DEFAULT_MONTHS,
  showCalendarYearFilter = false,
  selectedCalendarYear = new Date().getFullYear(),
  onCalendarYearChange,
  searchQuery = '',
  onSearchChange,
  showSearch = true,
  layoutMode = 'pages',
  onToggleLayoutMode,
  showLayoutModeToggle = true,
  onRefresh,
  isRefreshing = false,
  onOpenPageSetup,
  exportHandlers,
  onPrint,
  isExporting = false,
  exportingText = 'Exporting...',
  disableActions = false,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [isExportDropdownOpen, setIsExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  const isAdminOrPrincipal = userRole === 'ADMIN' || userRole === 'PRINCIPAL';

  const filteredReports = useMemo(() => {
    return reports.filter((rep) => {
      if (rep.id === 'sf4' && !isAdminOrPrincipal) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [reports, isAdminOrPrincipal]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isExportDropdownOpen) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isExportDropdownOpen]);

  const filteredSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedGradeLevel || selectedGradeLevel === 'ALL') {
      return sections;
    }
    return sections.filter((sec) => {
      const g = extractGradeLevelName(sec.grade_level).toLowerCase();
      const target = selectedGradeLevel.toLowerCase().trim();
      return g === target || g.includes(target);
    });
  }, [sections, selectedGradeLevel]);

  const availableGradeLevels = useMemo(() => {
    if (gradeLevels && gradeLevels.length > 0) {
      return gradeLevels
        .map(extractGradeLevelName)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
    }
    const extracted = Array.from(
      new Set(
        sections
          .map((s) => extractGradeLevelName(s?.grade_level))
          .filter(Boolean)
      )
    );
    return extracted.sort((a, b) =>
      String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
    );
  }, [gradeLevels, sections]);

  const handleExportAction = (action?: () => void | Promise<void>) => {
    setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
    if (action) action();
  };

  return (
    <div className="no-print" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', width: '100%', flexShrink: 0, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
      {/* 1. Form Type Selector Tabs */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, padding: '10px 24px', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.4px', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
          REPORT FORM:
        </span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, padding: '4px', borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
          {filteredReports.map((rep) => {
            const Icon = rep.icon;
            const isActive = rep.id === activeReportId;
            return (
              <button
                key={rep.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelectReport(rep.id)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  backgroundColor: isActive ? brand.primary : 'transparent',
                  color: isActive ? '#FFFFFF' : tokens.textSecondary,
                  boxShadow: isActive ? tokens.cardShadow : 'none',
                  transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                }}
              >
                {Icon && <Icon size={15} />}
                <span>{rep.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Filters & Action Buttons */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', padding: '10px 24px', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {showAcademicYearFilter && onAcademicYearChange && academicYears.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>School Year:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedAcademicYear}
                onChange={(e) => onAcademicYearChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{ padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, color: tokens.textPrimary, outline: 'none' }}
              >
                {!selectedAcademicYear && <option value="">-- Select S.Y. --</option>}
                {academicYears.map((sy) => (
                  <option key={sy} value={sy}>{sy}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showGradeLevelFilter && onGradeLevelChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Grade Level:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedGradeLevel}
                onChange={(e) => onGradeLevelChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{ padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, color: tokens.textPrimary, outline: 'none' }}
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Grades</option>
                {availableGradeLevels.map((g) => (
                  <option key={g} value={g}>{g}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showSectionFilter && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Section:</span>
              <select
                value={String(selectedSectionId ?? '')}
                onChange={(e) => onSectionChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{ padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, color: tokens.textPrimary, outline: 'none' }}
              >
                {!selectedSectionId && <option value="">-- Choose Section --</option>}
                {filteredSections.length === 0 ? (
                  <option value="" disabled>No sections available</option>
                ) : (
                  filteredSections.map((sec) => {
                    const gradeStr = extractGradeLevelName(sec.grade_level);
                    return (
                      <option key={sec.id} value={String(sec.id)}>
                        {sec.display_label || `${gradeStr ? `${gradeStr} - ` : ''}${sec.name}${sec.adviser_name ? ` (${sec.adviser_name})` : ''}`}
                      </option>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showDateFilter && onDateChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Date:</span>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '4px 8px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                <Calendar size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={selectedDate}
                  onChange={(e) => onDateChange(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {showMonthFilter && onMonthChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Month:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedMonth}
                onChange={(e) => onMonthChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{ padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, color: tokens.textPrimary, outline: 'none' }}
              >
                {monthsList.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>{m}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {showCalendarYearFilter && onCalendarYearChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Year:</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={selectedCalendarYear || new Date().getFullYear()}
                onChange={(e) => onCalendarYearChange(Number(e.target.value) || new Date().getFullYear())}
                style={{ padding: '6px 10px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, color: tokens.textPrimary, outline: 'none', width: 80 }}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {showSearch && onSearchChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '5px 10px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, width: 200 }}>
              <Search size={14} color={tokens.textMuted} />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                placeholder="Search name or LRN..."
                onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{ border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', fontSize: '0.78rem', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onSearchChange('')}
                  style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0 }}
                  title="Clear search"
                >
                  <X size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {onRefresh && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onRefresh}
              disabled={isRefreshing}
              title="Refresh Record from Database"
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={14} className={isRefreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {showLayoutModeToggle && onToggleLayoutMode && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onToggleLayoutMode(layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 'pages' : 'pageless')}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                backgroundColor: layoutMode === 'pageless' ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${layoutMode === 'pageless' ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong}`,
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: layoutMode === 'pageless' ? brand.primary : tokens.textPrimary,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              {layoutMode === 'pageless' ? <Maximize2 size={14} /> : <FileText size={14} />}
              <span>{layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 'Pageless' : 'Pages'}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {onOpenPageSetup && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenPageSetup}
              disabled={disableActions}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,

                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Official Document Format</div>

                        >
                          <FileSpreadsheet size={15} color={brand.success} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Microsoft Excel (.xlsx)</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Formatted DepEd spreadsheet</div>
                          </div>

                      )}
                      {exportHandlers.onExportGoogleSheets && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportGoogleSheets)}
                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <ExternalLink size={15} color={brand.success} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Google Sheets</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Opens in web spreadsheet</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}

                  {(exportHandlers.onExportCsv || exportHandlers.onExportJson) && (
                    <>
                      <div style={{ padding: '6px 14px 2px 14px', fontSize: '0.62rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.5px' }}>DATA EXCHANGE</div>
                      {exportHandlers.onExportCsv && (
                        <button

                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <TableIcon size={15} color={brand.warning} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>LIS CSV Spreadsheet (.csv)</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Standard DepEd data exchange</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {exportHandlers.onExportJson && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleExportAction(exportHandlers.onExportJson)}
                          style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 14px', border: 'none', backgroundColor: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.78rem', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
                        >
                          <FileCode size={15} color={brand.secondary} />
                          <div style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Raw JSON Data (.json)</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Database export &amp; backup</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {onPrint && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onPrint}
              disabled={disableActions}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '6px 16px',
                backgroundColor: brand.primary,
                border: 'none',
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: '#FFFFFF',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <Printer size={15} />
              <span>Print</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Institutional Classroom Attendance Scanner
 * File: web/src/components/scanner/ClassroomScanner.tsx
 * Supports: All Device Cameras, USB/OTG Barcode Guns, and Manual Entry.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import {
  Scan,
  Camera,
  HardDrive,
  QrCode,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Info,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface ScannedStudent {
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  lrn: string;
  section: string;
  status: string;
  authorization_role: string;
  scanned_at: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  gate_status_note?: string;
  is_duplicate?: boolean;
}

export interface ClassroomScannerProps {
  onClose?: () => void;
  isModal?: boolean;
}

// 1. Web Audio API Feedback Chime
const playFeedbackChime = (type: 'SUCCESS' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR') => {
  try {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();

    if (type === 'SUCCESS') {
      const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();

      osc1.type = 'sine';
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime);
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(1320, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.24);

      osc1.connect(gain);
      osc2.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc1.start(ctx.currentTime);
      osc1.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
      osc2.start(ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
      osc2.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.24);
    } else {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();

      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(240, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.32);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.32);
    }
  } catch {
    // Audio context suppressed by browser policy
  }
};

const getWorkstationDeviceId = (): string => {
  let id = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_workstation_device_id');
  if (!id) {
    id = `WEB-STATION-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9).toUpperCase()}`;
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_workstation_device_id', id);
  }
  return id;
};

// 2. Student Profile Photo Component with Initials Fallback
interface StudentPhotoProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  borderWidth?: number;
}

const StudentPhoto: React.FC<StudentPhotoProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name,
  size,
  borderWidth = 1.5,
}) => {
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setHasError(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const resolvedUrl = useMemo(() => {
    if (!photoUrl || typeof photoUrl !== 'string') return null;
    const clean = photoUrl.trim();
    if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined') return null;

    // Replace 0.0.0.0 bind host with browser host
    if (clean.includes('0.0.0.0:8000')) {
      return clean.replace('0.0.0.0:8000', window.location.host);
    }
    return clean;
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const initials = useMemo(() => {
    if (!name) return 'S';
    const cleanName = name.replace(/,/g, '').trim();
    const parts = cleanName.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
    }
    return cleanName.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  }, [name]);

  if (resolvedUrl && !hasError) {
    return (
      <img
        src={resolvedUrl}
        alt={name}
        onError={() => setHasError(true)}
        style={{
          width: size,
          height: size,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          objectFit: 'cover',
          border: `${borderWidth}px solid var(--border-subtle, #cbd5e1)`,
          flexShrink: 0,
          backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.12)',
        color: '#004b87',
        border: `${borderWidth}px solid rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.3)`,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        fontWeight: 800,
        fontSize: size > 44 ? '1.05rem' : '0.72rem',
        flexShrink: 0,
        letterSpacing: '0.5px',
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {initials}
    </div>
  );
};

export const ClassroomScanner: React.FC<ClassroomScannerProps> = ({
  onClose,
  isModal = false,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const [scannerMode, setScannerMode] = useState<'HARDWARE_OTG' | 'WEBCAM'>('HARDWARE_OTG');
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [inputCode, setInputCode] = useState('');
  const [isInputFocused, setIsInputFocused] = useState(false);

  const [activeStudent, setActiveStudent] = useState<ScannedStudent | null>(null);
  const [sessionList, setSessionList] = useState<ScannedStudent[]>([]);
  const [cameraMessage, setCameraMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const keyBuffer = useRef<string>('');
  const lastKeyTime = useRef<number>(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const cameraStreamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const animFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Send scan data to backend
  const handleProcessScan = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const clean = rawCode.trim().replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');
      if (!clean) return;

      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const deviceId = getWorkstationDeviceId();
        const res = await apiClient.post('/academics/classroom-scan/', {
          code: clean,
          device_uuid: deviceId,
        });

        if (res.data?.success) {
          const item: ScannedStudent = {
            student_id: res.data.student_id,
            student_name: res.data.student_name,
            lrn: res.data.lrn,
            section: res.data.section,
            status: res.data.status || 'PRESENT',
            authorization_role: res.data.authorization_role || 'Faculty',
            scanned_at: res.data.scanned_at,
            photo_url: res.data.photo_url || res.data.photo || null,
            gate_status_note: res.data.gate_status_note,
            is_duplicate: Boolean(res.data.is_duplicate),
          };

          setActiveStudent(item);
          if (soundEnabled) {
            playFeedbackChime(item.is_duplicate ? 'WARNING' : 'SUCCESS');
          }

          if (!item.is_duplicate) {
            setSessionList((prev) => [item, ...prev.filter((p) => p.lrn !== item.lrn)]);
          }
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('ERROR');
        const errorText =
          err?.response?.data?.error ||
          err?.response?.data?.detail ||
          'Attendance validation failed. Check student records.';
        showAlert({
          title: 'Notice',
          message: errorText,
          type: 'warning',
        });
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setInputCode('');
        setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      }
    },
    [soundEnabled, showAlert]
  );

  // Hardware Scanner listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const activeTag = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if (activeTag === 'INPUT' && document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) {
        return;
      }

      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastKeyTime.current > 120) {
        keyBuffer.current = '';
      }
      lastKeyTime.current = now;

      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        if (keyBuffer.current.length >= 2) {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleProcessScan(keyBuffer.current);
          keyBuffer.current = '';
        }
      } else if (e.key.length === 1) {
        keyBuffer.current += e.key;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [handleProcessScan]);

  // Open camera on any device
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scannerMode !== 'WEBCAM') {
      if (cameraStreamRef.current) {
        cameraStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        cameraStreamRef.current = null;
      }
      if (animFrameRef.current) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameRef.current);
        animFrameRef.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    let isScanning = true;

    const startDeviceCamera = async () => {
      try {
        setCameraMessage(null);

        let stream: MediaStream;
        if (navigator.mediaDevices && typeof navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia === 'function') {
          stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
          });
        } else {
          const legacyGetUserMedia =
            (navigator as any).webkitGetUserMedia ||
            (navigator as any).mozGetUserMedia ||
            (navigator as any).getUserMedia;

          if (!legacyGetUserMedia) {
            setCameraMessage('Camera not supported on this browser. Use Hardware Gun mode.');
            return;
          }

          stream = await new Promise<MediaStream>((resolve, reject) => {
            legacyGetUserMedia.call(
              navigator,
              { video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } } },
              resolve,
              reject
            );
          });
        }

        if (!isScanning) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
          return;
        }

        cameraStreamRef.current = stream;
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
          videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
        }

        if ('BarcodeDetector' in window) {
          const barcodeDetector = new (window as any).BarcodeDetector({
            formats: ['qr_code', 'code_128', 'ean_13'],
          });

          const scanLoop = async () => {
            if (!isScanning || !videoRef.current || videoRef.current.readyState < 2) {
              animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(scanLoop);
              return;
            }

            try {
              const barcodes = await barcodeDetector.detect(videoRef.current);
              if (barcodes.length > 0 && !loading) {
                const raw = barcodes[0].rawValue;
                if (raw) {
                  handleProcessScan(raw);
                  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1400));
                }
              }
            } catch {}

            if (isScanning) {
              animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(scanLoop);
            }
          };

          animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(scanLoop);
        }
      } catch {
        setCameraMessage(
          'Camera access was not granted by your browser. Please click the camera icon in your address bar and select "Always allow".'
        );
      }
    };

    startDeviceCamera();

    return () => {
      isScanning = false;
      if (cameraStreamRef.current) {
        cameraStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        cameraStreamRef.current = null;
      }
      if (animFrameRef.current) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameRef.current);
        animFrameRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [scannerMode, loading, handleProcessScan]);

  const sessionStats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = sessionList.length;
    const present = sessionList.filter((s) => s.status === 'PRESENT').length;
    return { total, present };
  }, [sessionList]);

  // Number position for the currently active student card
  const activeStudentNumber = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeStudent) return null;
    const foundIndex = sessionList.findIndex((s) => s.lrn === activeStudent.lrn);
    if (foundIndex >= 0) {
      return `#${foundIndex + 1}`;
    }
    return `#${sessionList.length + 1}`;
  }, [activeStudent, sessionList]);

  const containerStyle: React.CSSProperties = isModal
    ? {
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 9999,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: 16,
      }
    : {
        width: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 16,
      };

  const cardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
    borderRadius: 16,
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
    boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
    width: isModal ? '100%' : 'auto',
    maxWidth: isModal ? 880 : '100%',
    overflow: 'hidden',
    display: 'flex',
    flexDirection: 'column',
  };

  return (
    <div style={containerStyle}>
      <div style={cardStyle}>
        {/* 1. Terminal Controls Bar */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 12,
            padding: '12px 18px',
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setScannerMode('HARDWARE_OTG')}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '7px 14px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                border: `1px solid ${scannerMode === 'HARDWARE_OTG' ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: scannerMode === 'HARDWARE_OTG' ? brand.primary : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                color: scannerMode === 'HARDWARE_OTG' ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
              }}
            >
              <HardDrive size={15} />
              <span>USB / OTG Scanner Gun</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setScannerMode('WEBCAM')}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '7px 14px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                border: `1px solid ${scannerMode === 'WEBCAM' ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: scannerMode === 'WEBCAM' ? brand.primary : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                color: scannerMode === 'WEBCAM' ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
              }}
            >
              <Camera size={15} />
              <span>Device Camera Scanner</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '5px 10px',
                borderRadius: 20,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)',
                border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)',
                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: brand.success,
              }}
            >
              <span
                style={{
                  width: 7,
                  height: 7,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: brand.success,
                }}
              />
              <span>Scanner Ready</span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSoundEnabled(!soundEnabled)}
              title={soundEnabled ? 'Turn Off Sound' : 'Turn On Sound'}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 5,
                padding: '6px 10px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                color: soundEnabled ? brand.primary : tokens.textMuted,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
              }}
            >
              {soundEnabled ? <Volume2 size={15} color={brand.primary} /> : <VolumeX size={15} />}
              <span>{soundEnabled ? 'Sound On' : 'Muted'}</span>
            </button>

            {onClose && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  padding: 4,
                  color: tokens.textMuted,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                }}
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Main Scan Layout */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr)',
            gap: 16,
            alignItems: 'start',
            padding: 18,
          }}
        >
          {/* Left Column: Scanner Station & Active Student Card */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            {scannerMode === 'HARDWARE_OTG' ? (
              <div
                onClick={() => inputRef.current?.focus()}
                style={{

/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Minimalist Splash Screen (Light Mode Default)
 * File: web/src/components/splash/SplashScreen.tsx
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

interface SplashScreenProps {
  loading: boolean;
  minDurationMs?: number;
  onFinish?: () => void;
}

export const SplashScreen: React.FC<SplashScreenProps> = ({
  loading,
  minDurationMs = 600,
  onFinish,
}) => {
  const [canExit, setCanExit] = useState(false);
  const [fading, setFading] = useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);

  // Defaults to false (Light Mode) unless dark mode was explicitly saved
  const [isDark] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    const docTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
    if (docTheme === 'dark') return true;
    if (docTheme === 'light') return false;

    const saved = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_theme') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_theme_preference');
    return saved === 'dark';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setCanExit(true);
    }, minDurationMs);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [minDurationMs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && canExit) {
      setFading(true);
      const exitTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        setHidden(true);
        if (onFinish) onFinish();
      }, 300);
      return () => clearTimeout(exitTimer);
    }
  }, [loading, canExit, onFinish]);

  if (hidden) return null;

  const bgColor = isDark ? '#070b14' : '#f1f5f9';
  const textColor = isDark ? '#f8fafc' : '#0f172a';
  const mutedColor = isDark ? '#64748b' : '#94a3b8';

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 99999,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        backgroundColor: bgColor,
        opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,
        transform: fading ? 'scale(1.02)' : 'scale(1)',
        transition: 'opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)',
        pointerEvents: fading ? 'none' : 'auto',
        fontFamily: "'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif",
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            width: 72,
            height: 72,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            marginBottom: 14,
          }}
        >
          <img
            src="/splash.svg"
            alt="AttendSure Logo"
            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }}
            onError={(e) => {
              e.currentTarget.src = '/public/splash.svg';
            }}
          />
        </div>

        <h1
          style={{
            margin: 0,
            fontSize: '1.5rem',
            fontWeight: 800,
            color: textColor,
            letterSpacing: '-0.03em',
          }}
        >
          AttendSure
        </h1>

        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.74rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            color: mutedColor,
            marginTop: 4,
          }}
        >
          Campus Attendance &amp; Security
        </span>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          bottom: 28,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 6,
          fontSize: '0.72rem',
          color: mutedColor,
          userSelect: 'none',
        }}
      >
        <span>&copy; 2026 AttendSure</span>
        <span>&bull;</span>
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#475569' }}>
          TechBlazer
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SplashScreen;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';

interface FacultyMember {
  id: number;
  employee_id: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
  middle_name?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  department?: string;
  designation?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
}

interface DailyDTRRow {
  day: number;
  date_str: string;
  day_of_week: string;
  is_weekend: boolean;
  am_arrival: string;
  am_departure: string;
  pm_arrival: string;
  pm_departure: string;
  undertime_hours: number | string;
  undertime_minutes: number | string;
  is_loafing?: boolean;
  loafing_excused?: boolean;
  loafing_remarks?: string;
}

interface DTRReportData {
  faculty_id: number;
  faculty_name: string;
  employee_id: string;
  department?: string;
  month: string;
  month_number: number;
  year: number;
  regular_days_hours: string;
  saturdays_hours: string;
  school_head: string;
  school_head_title?: string;
  dtr_submitted?: boolean;
  dept_head_approved: boolean;
  approved_by_dept_head_at?: string | null;
  user_role?: string;
  can_approve_dept?: boolean;
  can_clear_loafing?: boolean;
  rows: DailyDTRRow[];
  total_undertime_hours: number;
  total_undertime_minutes: number;
  days_present: number;
}

interface ProfileAvatarProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  iconSize?: number;
}

const ProfileAvatar: React.FC<ProfileAvatarProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name = '',
  size = 36,
  iconSize = 18,
}) => {
  const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);
  const { tokens } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    setImageFailed(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const hasPhoto = Boolean(
    photoUrl &&
    typeof photoUrl === 'string' &&
    photoUrl.trim() !== '' &&
    photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'null' &&
    photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'undefined'
  );

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {hasPhoto && !imageFailed ? (
        <img
          src={photoUrl!}
          alt={name}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
          onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
        />
      ) : (
        <User size={iconSize} color={tokens.textMuted} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const DTRTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const schoolContext = useSchool() as any;
  const schoolProfile = schoolContext?.profile;

  const currentUserRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isFaculty = currentUserRole === 'FACULTY';

  const [facultyList, setFacultyList] = useState<FacultyMember[]>([]);
  const [selectedFacultyId, setSelectedFacultyId] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<number>(new Date().getMonth() + 1);
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(new Date().getFullYear());

  const [regularHours, setRegularHours] = useState('');
  const [saturdayHours, setSaturdayHours] = useState('');
  const [viewSide, setViewSide] = useState<'BOTH' | 'FRONT' | 'BACK'>('BOTH');

  const [dtrData, setDtrData] = useState<DTRReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [actionProcessing, setActionProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [exportingPdf, setExportingPdf] = useState(false);

  const [selectedViolationRow, setSelectedViolationRow] = useState<DailyDTRRow | null>(null);
  const [pardonRemarks, setPardonRemarks] = useState('');

  const printAreaRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = Boolean(selectedViolationRow) || actionProcessing;

  const activeFaculty = facultyList.find((f) => String(f.id) === selectedFacultyId);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    if (isFaculty) return;

    const loadFaculty = async () => {
      try {
        let res;
        try {
          res = await apiClient.get<any>('/faculty/?page_size=100');
        } catch (firstErr: any) {
          if (firstErr?.response?.status === 404) {
            res = await apiClient.get<any>('/faculty/?page_size=100');
          } else {
            throw firstErr;
          }
        }

        if (!isMounted || !res) return;

        const raw = res.data;
        const items: FacultyMember[] = Array.isArray(raw)
          ? raw
          : raw?.results && Array.isArray(raw.results)
          ? raw.results
          : [];

        setFacultyList(items);
        if (items.length > 0 && !selectedFacultyId) {
          setSelectedFacultyId(String(items[0].id));
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (isMounted) {
          setError(
            err?.response?.data?.detail ||
            err?.response?.data?.error ||
            'Could not load faculty directory.'
          );
        }
      }
    };

    loadFaculty();
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [isFaculty, selectedFacultyId]);

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      const endpoint = isFaculty && !selectedFacultyId
        ? '/reports/dtr/'
        : selectedFacultyId
        ? `/reports/dtr/${selectedFacultyId}/`
        : '/reports/dtr/';

      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<DTRReportData>(endpoint, {
          params: {
            month: selectedMonth,
            year: selectedYear,
          },
        });

        const loadedData = res.data;

        if (loadedData.faculty_id && String(loadedData.faculty_id) !== selectedFacultyId) {
          setSelectedFacultyId(String(loadedData.faculty_id));
        }

        if (loadedData.regular_days_hours) {
          setRegularHours(loadedData.regular_days_hours);
        }
        if (loadedData.saturdays_hours) {
          setSaturdayHours(loadedData.saturdays_hours);
        }

        const rows31: DailyDTRRow[] = [];
        const currentRows = loadedData.rows || [];

        for (let dayNum = 1; dayNum <= 31; dayNum++) {
          const found = currentRows.find((r) => r.day === dayNum);
          if (found) {
            rows31.push(found);
          } else {
            rows31.push({
              day: dayNum,
              date_str: '',
              day_of_week: '',
              is_weekend: false,
              am_arrival: '',
              am_departure: '',
              pm_arrival: '',
              pm_departure: '',
              undertime_hours: '',
              undertime_minutes: '',
              is_loafing: false,
              loafing_excused: false,
            });
          }
        }

        setDtrData({
          ...loadedData,
          rows: rows31,
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (!silent) {
          setError(
            err?.response?.data?.detail ||
            err?.response?.data?.error ||
            'Failed to retrieve DTR data. You may not be authorized to view this record.'
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [isFaculty, selectedFacultyId, selectedMonth, selectedYear]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDTR(false);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveHeartbeat = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current) {
        fetchDTR(true);
      }
    }, 4000);

    return () => clearInterval(liveHeartbeat);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDTR = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Submit Daily Time Record',
      message: `Certify and submit your official DTR for ${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year} to your Department Head for verification?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Certify & Submit',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`/reports/dtr/${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'SUBMIT_DTR',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: regularHours,
            saturdays_hours: saturdayHours,
          });
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Submitted',
            message: 'Your DTR has been submitted to your Department Head for endorsement.',
            type: 'success',
          });
          fetchDTR(true);
        } catch (err: any) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Submission Failed',
            message: err?.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to submit DTR.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleApproveByDeptHead = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Approve Official DTR',
      message: `Approve official DTR for ${dtrData.faculty_name} (${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year})? This will endorse records, remove the DRAFT watermark, and unlock official hard-copy printing.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Approve & Endorse',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`/reports/dtr/${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
          });
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Endorsed',
            message: `Official DTR for ${dtrData.faculty_name} has been verified and cleared for printing.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          fetchDTR(true);
        } catch (err: any) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Approval Failed',
            message: err?.response?.data?.error || 'Failed to submit Department Head endorsement.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleExcuseLoafingByPrincipal = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || !selectedViolationRow) return;

    if (!pardonRemarks.trim()) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Remarks Required',
        message: 'Please provide official remarks or justification for excusing this departure.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setActionProcessing(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`/reports/dtr/${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
        action: 'EXCUSE_LOAFING',
        faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
        date_str: selectedViolationRow.date_str,
        remarks: pardonRemarks.trim(),
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'Violation Excused',
        message: `Loafing record on ${selectedViolationRow.date_str} has been excused by the Principal. Salary deduction removed.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      setSelectedViolationRow(null);
      setPardonRemarks('');
      fetchDTR(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: err?.response?.data?.error || 'Only authorized leadership can excuse loafing records.',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (!printAreaRef.current || !dtrData) return;
    if (!dtrData.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Approval Required',
        message: 'This DTR must be approved by the Department Head before exporting official copies. Current view contains the DRAFT watermark.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setExportingPdf(true);
    try {
      let html2pdfInstance = (window as any).html2pdf;
      if (!html2pdfInstance) {
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const script = document.createElement('script');
          script.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js';
          script.onload = () => resolve((window as any).html2pdf);
          script.onerror = reject;
          document.head.appendChild(script);
        });
        html2pdfInstance = (window as any).html2pdf;
      }

      const opt = {
        margin: [0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15],
        filename: `CSC_Form_48_${(dtrData.faculty_name || 'Faculty').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}_${dtrData.month}_${dtrData.year}.pdf`,
        image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: 0.98 },
        html2canvas: {
          scale: 2,
          useCORS: true,
          logging: false,
          scrollX: 0,
          scrollY: 0,
        },
        jsPDF: {
          unit: 'in',
          format: 'legal',
          orientation: 'portrait',
        },
        pagebreak: { mode: ['css', 'legacy'], after: '.csc-print-page' },
      };

      await html2pdfInstance().from(printAreaRef.current).set(opt).save();
    } catch {
      window.print();
    } finally {
      setExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (!dtrData?.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Printing Locked',
        message: 'Official hard-copy printing is locked until the Department Head endorses this record.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }
    window.print();
  };

  const resolvedSchoolHead = (
    dtrData?.school_head ||
    schoolProfile?.principal_name ||
    ''
  ).trim();

  const resolvedSchoolHeadTitle = (
    dtrData?.school_head_title ||
    schoolProfile?.principal_title ||
    ''
  ).trim();

  // Dynamic Theme-Driven Styles
  const dynamicStyles = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      controlBar: {
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',

        padding: '12px 18px',
        borderRadius: 12,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      scheduleBar: {
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',

        padding: '8px 16px',

        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',

        borderRadius: 8,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
        fontSize: '0.82rem',
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        outline: 'none',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      inputSchedule: {
        padding: '4px 8px',

        outline: 'none',

      errorBanner: {

        gap: 8,

        backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)',
        color: brand.danger,
        borderRadius: 8,
        fontSize: '0.82rem',
        border: `1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)`,
      },
      paperPreviewWrapper: {
        overflowX: 'auto' as const,
        padding: '16px',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        borderRadius: 14,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
    };
  }, [tokens, brand]);

  const renderDTRCopy = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return null;

    return (
      <div style={formCardContainer}>
        {!dtrData.dept_head_approved && (
          <div style={draftWatermarkStyle}>

            DAILY TIME RECORD
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 8, borderBottom: '1.2px solid #000', paddingBottom: 1, minHeight: 18 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '9.2pt', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
              {dtrData.faculty_name}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 1 }}>(Name)</div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: '6.8pt', marginBottom: 4, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '0.8px solid #000', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
            <span>
              For the month of <u>&nbsp;<strong>{dtrData.month}</strong>&nbsp;</u>, 20<u>&nbsp;<strong>{String(dtrData.year).slice(-2)}</strong>&nbsp;</u>
            </span>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginTop: 3 }}>
            <div style={{ width: '46%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>

              and departure
            </div>
            <div style={{ width: '54%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>
              <div>Regular Days: <u>{regularHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
              <div style={{ marginTop: 1 }}>Saturdays: <u>{saturdayHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
            </div>

        <table style={dtrTable}>

              <th rowSpan={2} style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrTh }}>Days</th>

              </th>

              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>

              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>DEPAR-<br />TURE</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Hours</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Minutes</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {dtrData.rows.map((row) => {
              const isViolating = row.is_loafing && !row.loafing_excused;

              return (

                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {row.day}
                    {row.is_loafing && (
                      <span
                        onClick={() => dtrData.can_clear_loafing && setSelectedViolationRow(row)}
                        title={isViolating ? 'Loafing flag. Click for review.' : 'Excused by Principal'}
                        style={{
                          marginLeft: 2,
                          fontSize: '5.2pt',
                          color: isViolating ? '#dc2626' : '#059669',
                          cursor: dtrData.can_clear_loafing ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                        }}
                      >
                        {isViolating ? '(!)' : '(✓)'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: isViolating ? '#dc2626' : '#000000', fontWeight: isViolating ? 700 : 'normal' }}>
                    {row.am_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: isViolating ? '#dc2626' : '#000000', fontWeight: isViolating ? 700 : 'normal' }}>
                    {row.am_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: isViolating ? '#dc2626' : '#000000', fontWeight: isViolating ? 700 : 'normal' }}>
                    {row.pm_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: isViolating ? '#dc2626' : '#000000', fontWeight: isViolating ? 700 : 'normal' }}>
                    {row.pm_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: isViolating ? '#dc2626' : '#000000', fontWeight: isViolating ? 800 : 'normal' }}>

                    {row.undertime_minutes}

            <tr style={{ height: 16, borderTop: '1.2px solid #000', fontWeight: 800 }}>

              <td colSpan={4} style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontSize: '5.6pt' }}>
                Days Present: <strong>{dtrData.days_present}</strong> &bull; Total Undertime:
              </td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_hours || ''}</td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_minutes || ''}</td>

          I CERTIFY on my honor that the above is a true and correct report of the hours of work performed, record of which was made daily at the time of arrival and departure from office.

          <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', width: '82%', margin: '0 auto', minHeight: 14 }}>

              {resolvedSchoolHead}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.4pt', fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 1 }}>
            {resolvedSchoolHeadTitle || 'In-Charge'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 4, fontSize: '5.6pt', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          (See Instructions on back)
        </div>
      </div>
    );
