  const renderInstructionsCopy = () => (
    <div style={formCardContainer}>
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 8, borderBottom: '1px solid #000', paddingBottom: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '11pt', fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: '0.8px' }}>
          INSTRUCTIONS
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ fontSize: '6.0pt', textAlign: 'justify', lineHeight: 1.35, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Civil Service Form No. 48, after completion, Should be filed in the records of the Bureau or Office which submits the monthly report on Civil Service Form No. 3 to the Bureau of Civil Service.
        </p>

        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          In lieu of the above, court interpreters and stenographers who accompany the judges of the Court of First Instance will fill out the daily time reports on this form in triplicate, after which they should be approved by the judge with whom service has been rendered, or by an officer of the Department of Justice authorized to do so. The original should be forwarded promptly after the end of the month to the Bureau of Civil Service, thru the Department of Justice; the duplicate to kept in the department of justice; and the triplicate, in the office of the Clerk of Court where service was rendered.
        </p>

        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          In the space provided for the purpose on the other side will be indicated the office hours the employee is required to observe, as for example, &ldquo;Regular days, 8:00 to 12:00 and 1:00 to 4:00; Saturdays 8:00 to 1:00.&rdquo;
        </p>

        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Attention is invited to paragraph 3, Civil Service Rule XV, Executive Order No. 5, series of 1909, which reads as follows:
        </p>

        <blockquote style={{ margin: '0 0 0 8px', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #000', paddingLeft: 6, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          &ldquo;Each chief of a Bureau or Office shall require a daily record of attendance of all the officers and employees under him entitled to leave or absence or vacation (including faculty) to be kept on the proper form and also a systematic office record showing for each day all absences from duty from any cause whatever. At the beginning of each month he shall report to the Commissioner on the proper form of all absences from any cause whatever, including the exact amount of undertime of each person for each day. Officers or employees serving in the field or on the water need not be required to keep a daily record, but all absences of such employees must be included in the monthly report of changes and absences. Falsification of time records will render the offending officers or employee liable to summary removal from the service and criminal prosecution.&rdquo;
        </blockquote>

        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '5.7pt' }}>
          <strong>(NOTE</strong> A record made from memory at sometime subsequent to the occurrence of as event is not reliable. Non observance of office hours deprives the employee of the leave privileges although he may have rendered overtime service. Where service rendered outside of the Office for the whole morning or afternoon, notation to that effect should be made clearly.)
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
      
      {/* 1. Control Header Bar */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.controlBar}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <ProfileAvatar
              photoUrl={activeFaculty?.photo}
              name={activeFaculty?.full_name || dtrData?.faculty_name || ''}
              size={36}
              iconSize={18}
            />

            {isFaculty ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
                title="Your view is locked to your personal time record."
              >
                <Lock size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                <span>
                  {dtrData?.faculty_name || ''}{' '}
                  {dtrData?.employee_id ? `(${dtrData.employee_id})` : ''}
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select
                value={selectedFacultyId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedFacultyId(e.target.value)}
                style={dynamicStyles.selectControl}
              >
                {facultyList.map((f) => (
                  <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                    {f.full_name || `${f.last_name}, ${f.first_name}`} ({f.employee_id})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <Calendar size={15} color={brand.primary} />
            <select
              value={selectedMonth}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedMonth(Number(e.target.value))}
              style={dynamicStyles.selectControl}
            >
              {[
                'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
                'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
              ].map((m, idx) => (
                <option key={m} value={idx + 1}>{m}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <select
            value={selectedYear}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedYear(Number(e.target.value))}
            style={dynamicStyles.selectControl}
          >
            {[2025, 2026, 2027].map((y) => (
              <option key={y} value={y}>{y}</option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
            <Layers size={14} color={tokens.textMuted} />
            <select
              value={viewSide}
              onChange={(e) => setViewSide(e.target.value as any)}
              style={dynamicStyles.selectControl}
            >
              <option value="BOTH">Full Form (Front &amp; Back)</option>
              <option value="FRONT">Front Side Only (DTR)</option>
              <option value="BACK">Back Side Only (Instructions)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <Button variant="secondary" size="md" onClick={() => fetchDTR(false)} disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <RefreshCw size={14} />}
            <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Refresh</span>
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          {isFaculty && dtrData && !dtrData.dtr_submitted && !dtrData.dept_head_approved && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              onClick={handleSubmitDTR}
              disabled={actionProcessing}
              style={{ backgroundColor: brand.primary, borderColor: brand.primary }}
            >
              {actionProcessing ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <Send size={14} />}
              <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Certify &amp; Submit DTR</span>
            </Button>
          )}

          {dtrData?.can_approve_dept && !dtrData?.dept_head_approved && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              onClick={handleApproveByDeptHead}
              disabled={actionProcessing}
              style={{ backgroundColor: brand.success, borderColor: brand.success }}
            >
              {actionProcessing ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <CheckCircle2 size={14} />}
              <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Approve as Dept Head</span>
            </Button>
          )}

          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="md"
            onClick={handleDownloadPdf}
            disabled={exportingPdf || !dtrData || !dtrData.dept_head_approved}
            title={!dtrData?.dept_head_approved ? 'Department Head endorsement required before exporting.' : 'Export DTR PDF'}
          >
            {exportingPdf ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : !dtrData?.dept_head_approved ? <Lock size={14} color={brand.danger} /> : <Download size={14} />}
            <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Export PDF</span>
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="md"
            onClick={handlePrint}
            disabled={!dtrData || !dtrData.dept_head_approved}
            title={!dtrData?.dept_head_approved ? 'Department Head endorsement required before printing.' : 'Print Hard Copy DTR'}
          >
            {!dtrData?.dept_head_approved ? <Lock size={14} /> : <Printer size={14} />}
            <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Print DTR</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Governance Status Banner */}
      {dtrData && (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            padding: '12px 18px',
            borderRadius: 10,
            backgroundColor: dtrData.dept_head_approved
              ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)'
              : dtrData.dtr_submitted
              ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.12)'
              : 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)',
            border: `1px solid ${
              dtrData.dept_head_approved
                ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.28)'
                : dtrData.dtr_submitted
                ? 'rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.28)'
                : 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28)'
            }`,
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            {dtrData.dept_head_approved ? (
              <ShieldCheck size={20} color={brand.success} />
            ) : (
              <ShieldAlert size={20} color={dtrData.dtr_submitted ? brand.primary : brand.warning} />
            )}
            <div>
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  color: dtrData.dept_head_approved
                    ? brand.success
                    : dtrData.dtr_submitted
                    ? brand.primary
                    : brand.warning,
                }}
              >
                {dtrData.dept_head_approved
                  ? 'DEPARTMENT HEAD APPROVED — OFFICIAL COPY UNLOCKED (DRAFT WATERMARK REMOVED)'
                  : dtrData.dtr_submitted
                  ? 'SUBMITTED TO DEPARTMENT HEAD — AWAITING DIGITAL ENDORSEMENT'
                  : 'DRAFT MODE — PLEASE CERTIFY AND SUBMIT TO YOUR DEPARTMENT HEAD'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
                {dtrData.dept_head_approved
                  ? 'Official hard-copy printing is unlocked. Submit physical copy to Principal with your signature.'
                  : 'Digital endorsement from your Department Head is required before official hard-copy printing is unlocked.'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            Status:{' '}
            <span
              style={{
                color: dtrData.dept_head_approved
                  ? brand.success
                  : dtrData.dtr_submitted
                  ? brand.primary
                  : brand.warning,
              }}
            >
              {dtrData.dept_head_approved
                ? 'APPROVED & CLEARED'
                : dtrData.dtr_submitted
                ? 'SUBMITTED / PENDING REVIEW'
                : 'DRAFT / UNSUBMITTED'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. Official Working Hours Bar */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.scheduleBar}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
          <Clock size={15} color={tokens.textMuted} />
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Prescribed Hours:</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>
            <span style={{ color: tokens.textSecondary }}>Regular:</span>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={regularHours}
              placeholder="Enter regular working hours"
              onChange={(e) => setRegularHours(e.target.value)}
              style={dynamicStyles.inputSchedule}
            />
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>
            <span style={{ color: tokens.textSecondary }}>Saturdays:</span>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={saturdayHours}
              placeholder="Enter Saturday working hours"
              onChange={(e) => setSaturdayHours(e.target.value)}
              style={dynamicStyles.inputSchedule}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div style={dynamicStyles.errorBanner}>
          <AlertCircle size={18} />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. Official Printable Sheets Preview */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.paperPreviewWrapper}>
        {loading ? (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', height: 320, gap: 10 }}>
            <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={26} color={brand.primary} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
              Loading attendance logs and verifying clearance...
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : dtrData ? (
          <div ref={printAreaRef} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 24 }}>
            {(viewSide === 'BOTH' || viewSide === 'FRONT') && (
              <div id="csc-form-48-front" className="csc-print-page" style={printableSheetContainer}>
                {renderDTRCopy()}
                <div style={perforationLine}></div>
                {renderDTRCopy()}
              </div>
            )}

            {(viewSide === 'BOTH' || viewSide === 'BACK') && (
              <div id="csc-form-48-back" className="csc-print-page" style={printableSheetContainer}>
                {renderInstructionsCopy()}
                <div style={perforationLine}></div>
                {renderInstructionsCopy()}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* 5. Principal Loafing Violation Review Modal */}
      {selectedViolationRow && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(selectedViolationRow)}
          onClose={() => setSelectedViolationRow(null)}
          title="Principal Discretion: Loafing Violation Review"
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: 12, backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28)' }}>
              <AlertTriangle size={24} color={brand.danger} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: brand.danger, lineHeight: 1.35 }}>
                An unexcused departure or loafing flag was recorded for <strong>{dtrData?.faculty_name}</strong> on <strong>{selectedViolationRow.date_str}</strong>.
                If not excused by the Principal, this date will incur a salary deduction.
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              <strong>Recorded Gate Note:</strong> {selectedViolationRow.loafing_remarks || 'None'}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                Principal Pardon Reason / Official Remarks:
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={pardonRemarks}
                onChange={(e) => setPardonRemarks(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  fontSize: '0.84rem',
                  outline: 'none',
                  boxSizing: 'border-box',
                }}
                placeholder="Enter justification for excusing departure..."
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 10, marginTop: 10 }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" onClick={() => setSelectedViolationRow(null)}>
                Leave as Deduction
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                size="md"
                onClick={handleExcuseLoafingByPrincipal}
                disabled={actionProcessing}
                style={{ backgroundColor: brand.success, borderColor: brand.success }}
              >
                {actionProcessing ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <CheckCircle2 size={14} />}
                <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>Pardon &amp; Clear Deduction</span>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* High-Precision Print Media Styles */}
      <style>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: 8.5in 13in;
            margin: 0.2in !important;
          }
          html, body, #root {
            background: #ffffff !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
          }
          body * {
            visibility: hidden;
          }
          .csc-print-page, .csc-print-page * {
            visibility: visible;
          }
          .csc-print-page {
            position: relative;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            width: 8.5in !important;
            min-height: 12.5in !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            padding: 0.25in !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            border: none !important;
            page-break-after: always !important;
            break-after: page !important;
          }
          .csc-print-page:last-child {
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            break-after: avoid !important;
          }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Faculty & Staff Directory (Theme Adaptive)
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/FacultyTab.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Pagination, ALL_ROWS_SIZE, exportToCsv } from '../common/Pagination';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import {
  User,
  Plus,
  QrCode,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Camera,
  Loader2,
  Download,
  Search,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface Faculty {
  id: number;
  employee_id: string;
  first_name: string;
  middle_name?: string;
  last_name: string;
  suffix?: string;
  full_name: string;
  position: string;
  department: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  email?: string;
  rfid_uid?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
}

interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  count: number;
  total_pages?: number;
  current_page?: number;
  results: T[];
}

const FACULTY_POSITIONS = [
  {
    category: 'Classroom Faculty',
    ranks: [
      'Faculty I',
      'Faculty II',
      'Faculty III',
      'Special Science Faculty I',
      'Master Faculty I',
      'Master Faculty II',
      'Master Faculty III',
      'Master Faculty IV',
    ],
  },
  {
    category: 'Department Heads',
    ranks: [
      'Head Faculty I',
      'Head Faculty II',
      'Head Faculty III',
      'Head Faculty IV',
      'Head Faculty V',
      'Head Faculty VI',
    ],
  },
  {
    category: 'School Administration & Leadership',
    ranks: [
      'Assistant School Principal I',
      'Assistant School Principal II',
      'School Principal I',
      'School Principal II',
      'School Principal III',
      'School Principal IV',
      'Secondary School Principal IV',
    ],
  },
  {
    category: 'Non-Teaching & Academic Support',
    ranks: [
      'Administrative Officer II',
      'Administrative Assistant',
      'School Registrar',
      'Guidance Counselor I',
    ],
  },
];

const FACULTY_DEPARTMENTS = [
  'Office of the Principal / Administration',
  'Junior High School',
  'Senior High School',
  'English Department',
  'Science Department',
  'Mathematics Department',
  'Filipino Department',
  'Araling Panlipunan Department',
  'MAPEH Department',
  'TLE / TVL Department',
  'Values Education / EsP Department',
  'Guidance & Counseling Office',
];

const SUFFIX_OPTIONS = ['', 'Jr.', 'Sr.', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];

const INITIAL_FORM_DATA = {
  employee_id: '',
  first_name: '',
  middle_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  suffix: '',
  position: 'Faculty I',
  department: 'Junior High School',
  contact_number: '',
  email: '',
  rfid_uid: '',
  photo: null as string | null,
};

export const FacultyTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [facultys, setFacultys] = useState<Faculty[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [departmentFilter, setDepartmentFilter] = useState('');

  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(25);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingFaculty, setEditingFaculty] = useState<Faculty | null>(null);
  const [inspectingFaculty, setInspectingFaculty] = useState<Faculty | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const activeAbortController = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen || Boolean(inspectingFaculty);

  const handleCopy = async (text: string, id: string) => {
    let success = false;
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        success = true;
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }
    if (!success) {
      try {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = text;
        textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.focus();
        textArea.select();
        success = document.execCommand('copy');
        textArea.remove();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Clipboard copy error:', err);
      }
    }
    if (success) {
      setCopiedKey(id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
    }
  };

  const fetchFacultys = useCallback(
    async (page = 1, size = 25, query = '', deptVal = '', silent = false) => {
      if (activeAbortController.current) {
        activeAbortController.current.abort();
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      activeAbortController.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        const isAll = size >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;

        const res = await apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<Faculty> | Faculty[]>('/facultys/', {
          params: {
            page: isAll ? 1 : page,
            page_size: isAll ? 'ALL' : size,
            search: query.trim() || undefined,
            department: deptVal || undefined,
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (res.data && 'results' in res.data) {
          setFacultys(res.data.results);
          setTotalCount(res.data.count);
          setTotalPages(isAll ? 1 : res.data.total_pages || Math.ceil(res.data.count / size) || 1);
          setCurrentPage(isAll ? 1 : res.data.current_page || page);
        } else if (Array.isArray(res.data)) {
          setFacultys(res.data);
          setTotalCount(res.data.length);
          setTotalPages(1);
          setCurrentPage(1);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.name === 'CanceledError' || err.name === 'AbortError') return;
        if (!silent) {
          setError('Unable to load faculty records. Please check server connectivity.');
        }
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentPage(1);
      fetchFacultys(1, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [search, departmentFilter, pageSize, fetchFacultys]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current) {
        fetchFacultys(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true);
      }
    }, 4000);

    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, fetchFacultys]);

  const handlePageChange = (newPage: number) => {
    if (newPage < 1 || newPage > totalPages) return;
    setCurrentPage(newPage);
    fetchFacultys(newPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false);
  };

  const handlePageSizeChange = (newSize: number) => {
    setPageSize(newSize);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    fetchFacultys(1, newSize, search, departmentFilter, false);
  };

  const handleExportFacultyCsv = () => {
    const suffix = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 'ALL' : `Page${currentPage}_${pageSize}rows`;
    const exported = exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_Faculty_${suffix}.csv`,
      ['Employee ID', 'Full Name', 'Position', 'Department', 'Email', 'Contact', 'RFID UID', 'Status'],
      facultys.map((f) => [
        f.employee_id,
        f.full_name,
        f.position,
        f.department,
        f.email || '',
        f.contact_number || '',
        f.rfid_uid || '',
        f.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
      ])
    );

    if (exported) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'CSV Exported',
        message: `Exported ${facultys.length} faculty records to CSV.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Image Format',
        message: 'Only JPG, PNG, and WebP image formats are accepted.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Profile photos must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const base64String = reader.result as string;
      setPhotoPreview(base64String);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: base64String }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = () => {
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: '' }));
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingFaculty(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    setEditingFaculty(faculty);
    setFormData({
      employee_id: faculty.employee_id || '',
      first_name: faculty.first_name || '',
      middle_name: faculty.middle_name || '',
      last_name: faculty.last_name || '',
      suffix: faculty.suffix || '',
      position: faculty.position || 'Faculty I',
      department: faculty.department || 'Junior High School',
      contact_number: faculty.contact_number || '',
      email: faculty.email || '',
      rfid_uid: faculty.rfid_uid || '',
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(faculty.photo_url || faculty.photo || null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);

    const cleanedContact = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    const cleanPayload: Record<string, any> = {
      employee_id: formData.employee_id.trim().toUpperCase(),
      first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
      middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
      last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
      suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
      position: formData.position.trim(),
      department: formData.department.trim(),
      email: formData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      contact_number: cleanedContact,
      rfid_uid: formData.rfid_uid.trim().toUpperCase() || null,
    };

    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      cleanPayload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;
    }

    try {
      if (editingFaculty) {
        const res = await apiClient.put<Faculty>(`/facultys/${editingFaculty.id}/`, cleanPayload);
        setFacultys((prev) => prev.map((f) => (f.id === editingFaculty.id ? res.data : f)));
        showAlert({
          title: 'Profile Updated',
          message: `Saved changes for ${editingFaculty.first_name} ${editingFaculty.last_name}.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        const res = await apiClient.post<Faculty>('/facultys/', cleanPayload);
        setFacultys((prev) => [res.data, ...prev]);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Faculty Registered',
          message: `${cleanPayload.first_name} ${cleanPayload.last_name} registered successfully.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchFacultys(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const serverMessage =
        err.response?.data?.employee_id?.[0] ||
        err.response?.data?.rfid_uid?.[0] ||
        err.response?.data?.email?.[0] ||
        err.response?.data?.detail ||
        'Failed to save faculty record. Please verify details.';

      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: serverMessage,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const promptDelete = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Faculty Member',
      message: `Permanently delete ${faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name} (${faculty.employee_id}) from the faculty registry?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Faculty',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`/facultys/${faculty.id}/`);
          setFacultys((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== faculty.id));
          if (inspectingFaculty?.id === faculty.id) setInspectingFaculty(null);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Faculty Removed',
            message: `Record for ${faculty.first_name} has been deleted.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          fetchFacultys(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true);
        } catch (err: any) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Failed',
            message: err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Unable to delete faculty member.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });

  const activeFacultyCount = facultys.filter((f) => f.is_active).length;
  const pairedCardsCount = facultys.filter((f) => Boolean(f.rfid_uid && f.rfid_uid.trim().length > 0)).length;

        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,

        letterSpacing: '0.4px',
        textTransform: 'uppercase' as const,
      },
      statValue: {
        fontSize: '1.60rem',
        fontWeight: 800,

        margin: '6px 0 2px 0',

      statHelp: {
        fontSize: '0.70rem',
        color: tokens.textSecondary,

        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',

      },
      searchInput: {
        width: 240,

        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,

        outline: 'none',

        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,

        outline: 'none',
      },

        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        overflow: 'hidden',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      th: {
        padding: '12px 14px',
        fontSize: '0.72rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        color: tokens.textMuted,
        textTransform: 'uppercase' as const,
        letterSpacing: '0.4px',
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
      },
      td: {
        padding: '12px 14px',
        fontSize: '0.80rem',
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
      },

        width: 30,

        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        color: tokens.textSecondary,
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
      },
    };
  }, [tokens, brand]);

    <div style={dynamicStyles.container}>
      {/* 1. Statistics Cards */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.statsContainer}>
        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>

          <div style={dynamicStyles.statValue}>{totalCount || facultys.length}</div>

        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>

          <div style={{ ...dynamicStyles.statValue, color: brand.success }}>{activeFacultyCount}</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Cleared for real-time tracking</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>RFID CARDS PAIRED</div>

            {pairedCardsCount}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: tokens.textMuted, fontWeight: 500 }}>
              {' '}
              / {facultys.length}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Active smart ID credentials</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>

                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 4,
                          }}
                          title="Click to copy UID"
                        >
                          {copiedKey === `rfid-${f.id}` ? <Check size={11} color={brand.success} /> : <Copy size={11} />}
                          <span>{f.rfid_uid}</span>
                        </span>

                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Unassigned</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td style={dynamicStyles.td}>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          display: 'inline-flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 4,
                          padding: '3px 8px',

                          fontWeight: 800,
                          backgroundColor: f.is_active ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)',
                          color: f.is_active ? brand.success : brand.danger,
                        }}
                      >
                        {f.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ ...dynamicStyles.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 6 }}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setInspectingFaculty(f)}
                          style={dynamicStyles.actionBtn}
                          title="View Digital Pass"
                        >
                          <QrCode size={14} />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(f)}
                          style={dynamicStyles.actionBtn}
                          title="Edit Profile"
                        >
                          <Pencil size={14} />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => promptDelete(f)}
                          style={{ ...dynamicStyles.actionBtn, color: brand.danger }}
                          title="Delete Faculty"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={14} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <Pagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          totalCount={totalCount}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          onPageChange={handlePageChange}
          onPageSizeChange={handlePageSizeChange}
          itemLabel="faculty members"
          style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}
        />

      {/* 4. Add / Edit Faculty Modal */}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 52,
                  height: 52,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {photoPreview ? (
                  <img src={photoPreview} alt="Preview" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
                ) : (

                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  ref={fileInputRef}

                  Employee ID *
                </label>

                  style={{

                    padding: '8px 12px',

                  placeholder="e.g. EMP-1049"

                  RFID Card UID
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.rfid_uid}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, rfid_uid: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '8px 12px',
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                    color: tokens.textPrimary,
                    outline: 'none',
                    boxSizing: 'border-box',

                  }}
                  placeholder="e.g. 8A3F29C1"

                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, color: tokens.textPrimary, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}

                  style={{ width: '100%', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 6, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, color: tokens.textPrimary, outline: 'none', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}

                  ))}

                <select
                  value={formData.position}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, position: e.target.value })}

              </div>

              <div style={{ padding: '16px 14px' }}>

                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {inspectingFaculty.full_name}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
                  {inspectingFaculty.position}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                  {inspectingFaculty.department}
                </div>

                <div style={{ margin: '12px auto', width: 110, height: 110, padding: 6, backgroundColor: '#ffffff', borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                  <img
                    src={`https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=110x110&data=${encodeURIComponent(inspectingFaculty.employee_id)}`}
                    alt="QR"
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }}
                  />
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  ID: {inspectingFaculty.employee_id}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, padding: '8px 12px', borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                Card UID: {inspectingFaculty.rfid_uid || 'No Card Linked'}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" onClick={() => setInspectingFaculty(null)}>
                Close
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FacultyTab;

/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Gate Logs Ledger & Telemetry Monitor
 * Real-time transaction history with full light/dark color mode adaptation.
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/GateLogsTab.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { ModuleTableLayout } from './ModuleTableLayout';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import {
  User,
  LogIn,
  LogOut,
  RefreshCw,
  Radio,
  QrCode,
  GraduationCap,
  Briefcase,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Eye,
  ChevronsLeft,
  ChevronsRight,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface GateLogEntry {
  log_id: string;
  person_type: 'STUDENT' | 'STAFF' | 'FACULTY';
  identifier: string;
  name: string;
  direction: 'IN' | 'OUT';
  scan_method: string;
  kiosk_name?: string;
  kiosk?: string;
  kiosk_code?: string;
  scan_time: string;
  raw_time?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  snapshot_url?: string | null;
  section_or_dept?: string;
}

export type GateLogItem = GateLogEntry;

interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  count: number;
  total_pages?: number;
  current_page?: number;
  results: T[];
}

interface ProfileAvatarProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  iconSize?: number;
}

const ProfileAvatar: React.FC<ProfileAvatarProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name = 'Person',
  size = 38,
  iconSize = 19,
}) => {
  const { tokens } = useTheme();
  const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setImageFailed(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const hasPhoto = Boolean(
    photoUrl &&
    typeof photoUrl === 'string' &&
    photoUrl.trim() !== '' &&
    photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'null' &&
    photoUrl.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'undefined'
  );

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {hasPhoto && !imageFailed ? (
        <img
          src={photoUrl!}
          alt={name}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
          onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
        />
      ) : (
        <User size={iconSize} color={tokens.textMuted} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const GateLogsTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<GateLogEntry[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [personFilter, setPersonFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'STUDENT' | 'STAFF'>('ALL');
  const [directionFilter, setDirectionFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'IN' | 'OUT'>('ALL');
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState(true);

  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(25);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const [inspectedLog, setInspectedLog] = useState<GateLogEntry | null>(null);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const activeAbortController = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = Boolean(inspectedLog);

  const handleCopy = async (text: string, id: string) => {
    let success = false;
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        success = true;
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }
    if (!success) {
      try {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = text;
        textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.focus();
        textArea.select();
        success = document.execCommand('copy');
        textArea.remove();
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }
    if (success) {
      setCopiedKey(id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
    }
  };

  const fetchLogs = useCallback(
    async (page = 1, size = 25, query = '', pFilter = 'ALL', dFilter = 'ALL', silent = false) => {
      if (activeAbortController.current) {
        activeAbortController.current.abort();
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      activeAbortController.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        const res = await apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<GateLogEntry> | GateLogEntry[]>('/gate/logs/', {
          params: {
            page,
            page_size: size,
            person_type: pFilter !== 'ALL' ? pFilter : undefined,
            direction: dFilter !== 'ALL' ? dFilter : undefined,
            q: query.trim() || undefined,
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        const raw = res.data;
        if (raw && 'results' in raw) {
          setLogs(raw.results);
          setTotalCount(raw.count);
          setTotalPages(raw.total_pages || Math.ceil(raw.count / size) || 1);
          setCurrentPage(raw.current_page || page);
        } else if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
          setLogs(raw);
          setTotalCount(raw.length);
          setTotalPages(1);
          setCurrentPage(1);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.name === 'CanceledError' || err.name === 'AbortError') return;
        if (!silent) {
          setError(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Unable to load gate scanner transactions from database.');
        }
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
    const safeLogs = Array.isArray(logs) ? logs : [];
    return {
      total_today: totalCount || safeLogs.length,
      in_today: safeLogs.filter((l) => l.direction === 'IN').length,
      out_today: safeLogs.filter((l) => l.direction === 'OUT').length,
      rfid_count: safeLogs.filter((l) => l.scan_method === 'RFID').length,
      qr_count: safeLogs.filter((l) => l.scan_method !== 'RFID').length,
    };
  }, [logs, totalCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentPage(1);
      fetchLogs(1, pageSize, search, personFilter, directionFilter, false);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search, personFilter, directionFilter, pageSize, fetchLogs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoRefresh) return;

    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current) {
        fetchLogs(currentPage, pageSize, search, personFilter, directionFilter, true);
      }
    }, 4000);

    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [autoRefresh, currentPage, pageSize, search, personFilter, directionFilter, fetchLogs]);

  const handlePageChange = (newPage: number) => {
    if (newPage < 1 || newPage > totalPages) return;
    setCurrentPage(newPage);
    fetchLogs(newPage, pageSize, search, personFilter, directionFilter, false);
  };

  const handlePageSizeChange = (newSize: number) => {
    setPageSize(newSize);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    fetchLogs(1, newSize, search, personFilter, directionFilter, false);
  };

  const startRecord = totalCount > 0 ? (currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1 : 0;
  const endRecord = Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, totalCount);

  const dynamicStyles = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      container: {
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 14,
        padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        minHeight: '100%',
        boxSizing: 'border-box' as const,
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      statsContainer: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr))',
        gap: 12,
      },
      statCard: {
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderRadius: 14,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        padding: '14px 18px',
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      statLabel: {
        fontSize: '0.64rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        color: tokens.textMuted,
        marginBottom: 4,
        letterSpacing: '0.4px',
        textTransform: 'uppercase' as const,
      },
      statValue: {
        fontSize: '1.45rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        lineHeight: 1.1,
      },
      statHelp: {
        fontSize: '0.68rem',
        color: tokens.textSecondary,
        marginTop: 3,
      },
      controlBar: {
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        padding: '12px 16px',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderRadius: 12,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 10,
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      tableCard: {
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderRadius: 14,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
        overflow: 'hidden',
        transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
      },
      paginationContainer: {
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        padding: '12px 16px',
        borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 10,
      },
      paginationSelect: {
        padding: '4px 8px',
        borderRadius: 6,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
        fontSize: '0.76rem',
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        outline: 'none',
        cursor: 'pointer',
      },
      paginationBtn: {
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: '5px',
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
        borderRadius: 6,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        cursor: 'pointer',
        transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
      },
      fieldBox: {
        padding: '10px 14px',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        borderRadius: 8,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
      },
      actionBtn: {
        background: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
        borderRadius: 6,
        padding: '5px 7px',
        cursor: 'pointer',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease',
      },
    };
  }, [tokens]);

  const getFilterTabStyle = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    padding: '5px 12px',
    borderRadius: 6,
    border: active ? `1px solid ${brand.primary}` : `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
    backgroundColor: active ? brand.primary : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
    color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
    fontSize: '0.74rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    cursor: 'pointer',
    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
  });

  return (
    <div style={dynamicStyles.container}>
      {/* 1. Live Gate Telemetry Metrics */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.statsContainer}>
        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>TOTAL SCANS TODAY</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statValue}>{metrics.total_today.toLocaleString()}</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Transactions processed</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>CAMPUS ENTRIES (IN)</div>
          <div style={{ ...dynamicStyles.statValue, color: brand.success }}>{metrics.in_today.toLocaleString()}</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Verified gate arrivals</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>CAMPUS EXITS (OUT)</div>
          <div style={{ ...dynamicStyles.statValue, color: brand.warning }}>{metrics.out_today.toLocaleString()}</div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Authorized departures</div>
        </div>

        <div style={dynamicStyles.statCard}>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statLabel}>SCAN METHODS (TODAY)</div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.primary }}>{metrics.rfid_count}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 600 }}>RFID</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.success, marginLeft: 6 }}>{metrics.qr_count}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 600 }}>QR Code</span>
          </div>
          <div style={dynamicStyles.statHelp}>Card taps vs. QR scans</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Control & Real-time Filter Bar */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.controlBar}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flex: 1 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, color: brand.success, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>
            <span
              style={{
                width: 7,
                height: 7,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                backgroundColor: brand.success,
                boxShadow: `0 0 6px ${brand.success}`,
              }}
            />
            <span>Gate Hardware Stream Online</span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ color: tokens.borderStrong }}>|</div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPersonFilter('ALL')}
              style={getFilterTabStyle(personFilter === 'ALL')}
            >
              All Persons
            </button>
            <button

              onClick={() => setPersonFilter('STUDENT')}

              Learners

              onClick={() => setPersonFilter('STAFF')}

              Faculty &amp; Staff

            <button
              type="button"

              style={getFilterTabStyle(directionFilter === 'ALL')}
            >
              All Directions

              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDirectionFilter('IN')}
              style={getFilterTabStyle(directionFilter === 'IN')}
            >
              Entries (IN)
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDirectionFilter('OUT')}
              style={getFilterTabStyle(directionFilter === 'OUT')}
            >
              Exits (OUT)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>

            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={autoRefresh}
              onChange={(e) => setAutoRefresh(e.target.checked)}
              style={{ cursor: 'pointer', accentColor: brand.primary }}

          </label>

          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="md"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fetchLogs(currentPage, pageSize, search, personFilter, directionFilter, false)}
            disabled={loading}
            style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, padding: '6px 12px' }}
          >
            <RefreshCw size={13} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            <span>Refresh</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Main Ledger Table Card */}
      <div style={dynamicStyles.tableCard}>
        <ModuleTableLayout
          title="Gate Logs Ledger"
          subtitle="Real-time transaction history of RFID card taps and QR passes recorded at school gate terminals."
          searchPlaceholder="Search by name, LRN, or Employee ID..."
          searchValue={search}
          onSearchChange={setSearch}
          loading={loading}
          error={error}
          data={logs}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.log_id}
          columns={[
            {
              header: 'Individual Profile', 
              render: (item) => (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                  <ProfileAvatar
                    photoUrl={item.photo_url || item.photo}
                    name={item.name}

                  <div>

                      {item.name}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginTop: 2 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                        {item.identifier}
                      </span>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleCopy(item.identifier, `id-${item.log_id}`)}
                        title="Copy Identifier"
                        style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 1, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}
                      >
                        {copiedKey === `id-${item.log_id}` ? (
                          <Check size={11} color={brand.success} />
                        ) : (
                          <Copy size={11} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              header: 'Person Type',
              render: (item) => {
                const isStudent = item.person_type === 'STUDENT';
                return (
                  <span
                    style={{
                      display: 'inline-flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 4,
                      padding: '3px 8px',
                      borderRadius: 12,
                      fontSize: '0.70rem',
                      fontWeight: 800,
                      backgroundColor: isStudent ? tokens.primaryLight : 'rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15)',
                      color: isStudent ? brand.primary : '#a78bfa',
                      border: `1px solid ${isStudent ? 'rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.3)' : 'rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3)'}`,
                    }}
                  >
                    {isStudent ? <GraduationCap size={12} /> : <Briefcase size={12} />}
                    {isStudent ? 'STUDENT' : 'FACULTY'}
                  </span>
                );
              },
            },
            {
              header: 'Direction',
              render: (item) => {
                const isEntry = item.direction === 'IN';
                return (
                  <span
                    style={{
                      display: 'inline-flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 4,
                      padding: '3px 9px',
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      fontSize: '0.72rem',
                      fontWeight: 800,
                      backgroundColor: isEntry ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : 'rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.15)',
                      color: isEntry ? brand.success : brand.warning,
                      border: `1px solid ${isEntry ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)' : 'rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.3)'}`,

                  >
                    {isEntry ? <LogIn size={12} /> : <LogOut size={12} />}
                    {item.direction}
                  </span>
                );
              },
            },
            {
              header: 'Scan Method',
              render: (item) => (
                <span
                  style={{
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 4,
                    fontSize: '0.74rem',

                    color: item.scan_method === 'RFID' ? brand.primary : brand.success,
                  }}
                >
                  {item.scan_method === 'RFID' ? <Radio size={12} /> : <QrCode size={12} />}
                  {item.scan_method}
                </span>
              ),
            },
            {
              header: 'Timestamp',
              render: (item) => (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', fontWeight: 600, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  {item.scan_time}
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              header: 'Station Terminal',
              render: (item) => (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{item.kiosk_name || item.kiosk || 'Terminal'}</span>{' '}
                  {item.kiosk_code && (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                      ({item.kiosk_code})
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              header: 'Actions',
              align: 'right',
              render: (item) => (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setInspectedLog(item)}
                    title="Inspect Scan Details"
                    style={dynamicStyles.actionBtn}
                  >
                    <Eye size={13} color={brand.primary} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ),
            },
          ]}
        />

        {/* 4. Ledger Pagination Bar */}
        <div style={dynamicStyles.paginationContainer}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            {totalCount > 0 ? (
              <>
                Showing <strong>{startRecord}</strong> to <strong>{endRecord}</strong> of{' '}
                <strong>{totalCount}</strong> gate transactions
              </>
            ) : (
              'No transactions recorded'
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginRight: 8 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Per page:</span>
              <select
                value={pageSize}
                onChange={(e) => handlePageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value))}
                style={dynamicStyles.paginationSelect}
              >
                <option value={15}>15</option>
                <option value={25}>25</option>
                <option value={50}>50</option>
                <option value={100}>100</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(1)}
              disabled={currentPage <= 1 || loading}
              style={{ ...dynamicStyles.paginationBtn, opacity: currentPage <= 1 || loading ? 0.35 : 1 }}
              title="First Page"
              type="button"
            >
              <ChevronsLeft size={16} />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
              disabled={currentPage <= 1 || loading}
              style={{ ...dynamicStyles.paginationBtn, opacity: currentPage <= 1 || loading ? 0.35 : 1 }}
              title="Previous Page"
              type="button"
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            </button>

            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600, padding: '0 8px', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              Page {currentPage} of {Math.max(1, totalPages)}
            </span>

            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
              disabled={currentPage >= totalPages || loading}
              style={{ ...dynamicStyles.paginationBtn, opacity: currentPage >= totalPages || loading ? 0.35 : 1 }}
              title="Next Page"
              type="button"
            >
              <ChevronRight size={16} />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(totalPages)}
              disabled={currentPage >= totalPages || loading}
              style={{ ...dynamicStyles.paginationBtn, opacity: currentPage >= totalPages || loading ? 0.35 : 1 }}
              title="Last Page"
              type="button"
            >
              <ChevronsRight size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5. Inspection Modal */}
      {inspectedLog && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(inspectedLog)}
          onClose={() => setInspectedLog(null)}
          title="Gate Transaction Verification"
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, padding: '12px 14px', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
              <ProfileAvatar
                photoUrl={inspectedLog.photo_url || inspectedLog.photo}
                name={inspectedLog.name}
                size={54}
                iconSize={27}
              />
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.98rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {inspectedLog.name}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
                  Identifier:{' '}
                  <strong style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    {inspectedLog.identifier}
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 2 }}>
                  Role: {inspectedLog.person_type === 'STUDENT' ? 'Enrolled Student' : 'Faculty / Staff'}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
              <div style={dynamicStyles.fieldBox}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>DIRECTION &amp; ACTION</div>
                <div style={{ marginTop: 3, fontWeight: 800, color: inspectedLog.direction === 'IN' ? brand.success : brand.warning }}>
                  Campus {inspectedLog.direction === 'IN' ? 'Entry (Arrival)' : 'Exit (Departure)'}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={dynamicStyles.fieldBox}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>SECURITY METHOD</div>
                <div style={{ marginTop: 3, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  {inspectedLog.scan_method === 'RFID' ? <Radio size={13} color={brand.primary} /> : <QrCode size={13} color={brand.success} />}
                  <span>{inspectedLog.scan_method} Verified</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={dynamicStyles.fieldBox}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>TERMINAL STATION</div>
                <div style={{ marginTop: 3, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {inspectedLog.kiosk_name || inspectedLog.kiosk || 'Main Gate'}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={dynamicStyles.fieldBox}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>TIMESTAMP</div>
                <div style={{ marginTop: 3, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {inspectedLog.scan_time}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {inspectedLog.snapshot_url && (
              <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 220, borderRadius: 10, overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: '#000000' }}>
                <img
                  src={inspectedLog.snapshot_url}
                  alt="Gate Snapshot"
                  style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }}
                />
              </div>
            )}

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 4 }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" onClick={() => setInspectedLog(null)}>
                Close
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GateLogsTab;

File: web\src\components\tabs\GatePassesTab.tsx
