                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => promptDelete(row)}
                            style={{ ...actionBtn, backgroundColor: '#fef2f2', borderColor: '#fee2e2' }}
                            title="Delete Student Record"
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={14} color="#dc2626" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 4. Server-Side Pagination Bar */}
        <div style={paginationFooter}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
            Showing <strong>{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1}</strong> to{' '}
            <strong>{Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, totalCount)}</strong> of{' '}
            <strong>{totalCount.toLocaleString()}</strong> students
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
              <span>Rows per page:</span>
              <select
                value={pageSize}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPageSize(Number(e.target.value));
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                style={pageSelectStyle}
              >
                <option value={25}>25</option>
                <option value={50}>50</option>
                <option value={100}>100</option>
                <option value={1000}>All (1000)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
                disabled={currentPage === 1 || loading}
                style={{ ...pageNavBtn, opacity: currentPage === 1 ? 0.4 : 1 }}
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={16} />
              </button>

              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                Page {currentPage} of {totalPages}
              </span>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
                disabled={currentPage === totalPages || loading}
                style={{ ...pageNavBtn, opacity: currentPage === totalPages ? 0.4 : 1 }}
              >
                <ChevronRight size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5. Full 30-Column Modal (With Linked Year Level & Section) */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        title={editingStudent ? `Edit Learner: ${editingStudent.full_name || editingStudent.first_name}` : 'Enroll New Learner (DepEd SF1)'}
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
          {formError && (
            <div style={errorBanner}>
              <AlertCircle size={16} />
              <span>{formError}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Sub-Tabs */}
          <div style={modalTabContainer}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFormTab('BASIC')}
              style={formTab === 'BASIC' ? modalActiveTab : modalInactiveTab}
            >
              <User size={13} /> 1. Basic &amp; Gate ID
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFormTab('ADDRESS')}
              style={formTab === 'ADDRESS' ? modalActiveTab : modalInactiveTab}
            >
              <Home size={13} /> 2. Address
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFormTab('PARENTS')}
              style={formTab === 'PARENTS' ? modalActiveTab : modalInactiveTab}
            >
              <Users2 size={13} /> 3. Parents &amp; Guardian
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFormTab('DEPED')}
              style={formTab === 'DEPED' ? modalActiveTab : modalInactiveTab}
            >
              <GraduationCap size={13} /> 4. DepEd Profile
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* TAB 1: Basic & Gate ID (Includes Linked Year Level & Section) */}
          {formTab === 'BASIC' && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
              
              {/* Profile Photo Uploader */}
              <div style={photoUploadContainer}>
                <div style={photoPreviewCircle}>
                  {formData.photo ? (
                    <img
                      src={formData.photo}
                      alt="Preview"
                      style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <User size={30} color="#94a3b8" />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <label style={uploadPhotoLabelBtn}>
                      <Camera size={13} />
                      <span>{formData.photo ? 'Change Photo' : 'Upload Profile Picture'}</span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                        onChange={handlePhotoUpload}
                        style={{ display: 'none' }}
                      />
                    </label>

                    {formData.photo && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: null }))}
                        style={removePhotoBtn}
                      >
                        <X size={13} />
                        <span>Remove</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    JPG, PNG, or WebP format (max file size: 2 MB)
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.2fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>12-Digit Learner Reference Number (LRN) *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    maxLength={12}
                    value={formData.lrn}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, lrn: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '') })}
                    style={formInput}
                    placeholder="e.g. 128936000093"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Birthdate *</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    required
                    value={formData.birthdate}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, birthdate: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>First Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.first_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                    placeholder="First name"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Last Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.last_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, last_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                    placeholder="Last name"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Middle Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.middle_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                    placeholder="Optional"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Suffix</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.suffix}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, suffix: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  >
                    <option value="">None</option>
                    <option value="Jr.">Jr.</option>
                    <option value="Sr.">Sr.</option>
                    <option value="II">II</option>
                    <option value="III">III</option>
                    <option value="IV">IV</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Sex *</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.sex}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, sex: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  >
                    <option value="Male">Male</option>
                    <option value="Female">Female</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 2-Tier Linking: Year Level filters the Class Section dropdown */}
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1.2fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Year Level (Dropdown) *</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.grade_level_id}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const newGL = e.target.value;
                      setFormData({
                        ...formData,
                        grade_level_id: newGL,
                        section_id: '', // Reset section when year level changes
                      });
                    }}
                    style={formInput}
                    required
                  >
                    <option value="">-- Choose Year Level --</option>
                    {gradeLevels.map((gl) => (
                      <option key={gl.id} value={gl.id}>
                        {gl.name} ({gl.code})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Class Section (Dropdown) *</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.section_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, section_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                    required
                    disabled={!formData.grade_level_id && modalAvailableSections.length === 0}
                  >
                    <option value="">
                      {formData.grade_level_id ? '-- Select Section --' : 'Select Year Level First'}
                    </option>
                    {modalAvailableSections.map((sec) => (
                      <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                        {sec.name} {sec.code ? `(${sec.code})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label style={formLabel}>School Gate RFID UID (Optional)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. 6B69D870"
                  value={formData.rfid_uid}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, rfid_uid: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  style={{ ...formInput, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: Address */}
          {formTab === 'ADDRESS' && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
              <div>
                <label style={formLabel}>House / Street / Sitio</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Zone 2, Purok Apple"
                  value={formData.house_street_sitio}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, house_street_sitio: e.target.value })}
                  style={formInput}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Barangay</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Lapasan, Lumbia"
                    value={formData.barangay}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, barangay: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Municipality / City</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.municipality_city}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, municipality_city: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label style={formLabel}>Province</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.province}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, province: e.target.value })}
                  style={formInput}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 3: Parents & Guardian */}
          {formTab === 'PARENTS' && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Father's Full Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Juan Santos Cruz"
                    value={formData.father_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, father_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Mother's Maiden Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Maria Lopez Reyes"
                    value={formData.mother_maiden_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, mother_maiden_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.2fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Guardian Name (if not with parents)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Guardian full name"
                    value={formData.guardian_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, guardian_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Relationship</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Aunt, Grandmother"
                    value={formData.guardian_relationship}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, guardian_relationship: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label style={formLabel}>Parent Contact Mobile (11 digits for SMS Alerts) *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. 09170000093"
                  value={formData.parent_contact}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, parent_contact: e.target.value })}
                  style={formInput}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 4: DepEd Demographics */}
          {formTab === 'DEPED' && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Mother Tongue</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Cebuano, Tagalog"
                    value={formData.mother_tongue}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, mother_tongue: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={formLabel}>Ethnic Group / Indigenous Community</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Higaonon, None"
                    value={formData.ethnic_group}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, ethnic_group: e.target.value })}
                    style={formInput}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label style={formLabel}>Religion / Faith Tradition</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. Roman Catholic, Islam, Seventh-Day Adventist"
                  value={formData.religion}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, religion: e.target.value })}
                  style={formInput}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Modal Navigation Buttons */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
              {formTab !== 'BASIC' && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (formTab === 'ADDRESS') setFormTab('BASIC');
                    else if (formTab === 'PARENTS') setFormTab('ADDRESS');
                    else if (formTab === 'DEPED') setFormTab('PARENTS');
                  }}
                  style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                >
                  &larr; Previous Tab
                </button>
              )}
              {formTab !== 'DEPED' && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (formTab === 'BASIC') setFormTab('ADDRESS');
                    else if (formTab === 'ADDRESS') setFormTab('PARENTS');
                    else if (formTab === 'PARENTS') setFormTab('DEPED');
                  }}
                  style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                >
                  Next Tab &rarr;
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving}>
                {saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> : editingStudent ? 'Save Learner Profile' : 'Enroll Learner (SF1)'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* ID Pass View/Print Modal */}
      {badgeStudent && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(badgeStudent)}
          onClose={() => setBadgeStudent(null)}
          title="Student Gate & Classroom Pass"
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', padding: '6px 0' }}>
            <div style={{ width: 300, backgroundColor: '#ffffff', border: '2px solid #004b87', borderRadius: 14, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <div style={{ background: '#004b87', color: '#ffffff', padding: '12px 14px' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', fontWeight: 800 }}>ATTENDSURE STUDENT PASS</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.60rem', color: '#e0f2fe', marginTop: 2 }}>Department of Education &bull; Student Pass</div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ padding: '16px 14px' }}>
                <div style={{ width: 68, height: 68, borderRadius: '50%', margin: '0 auto 8px auto', overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', border: '2px solid #004b87' }}>
                  {badgeStudent.photo_url ? (
                    <img
                      src={badgeStudent.photo_url}
                      alt={badgeStudent.full_name || badgeStudent.first_name}
                      style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <User size={34} color="#94a3b8" />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  {badgeStudent.full_name || `${badgeStudent.first_name} ${badgeStudent.last_name}`}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: '#64748b', marginTop: 2 }}>
                  Section: {badgeStudent.current_section || 'Unassigned'}
                </div>
                <div style={{ margin: '8px 0', padding: '4px 10px', backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', borderRadius: 6, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  LRN: {badgeStudent.lrn}
                </div>
                <div style={{ width: 120, height: 120, margin: '10px auto', padding: 6, border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 10 }}>
                  <img
                    src={`https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=120x120&data=${encodeURIComponent(badgeStudent.lrn)}`}
                    alt="QR"
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0', padding: '8px 12px', fontSize: '0.70rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                Card UID: <strong>{badgeStudent.rfid_uid || 'No Card Linked'}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, marginTop: 16 }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setBadgeStudent(null)}>
                Close
              </Button>
              <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => window.print()}>
                <Printer size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                Print ID Card
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Delete Confirmation Dialog */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={confirmDialog.isOpen}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDialog((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
        title={confirmDialog.title}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#334155', margin: 0 }}>
            {confirmDialog.message}
          </p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmDialog((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              type="button"
              onClick={async () => {
                await confirmDialog.action();
                setConfirmDialog((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
              }}
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#dc2626', borderColor: '#dc2626' }}
            >
              {confirmDialog.confirmLabel}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StudentsTab;

========================================================

/**
 * AttendSure - Users & Security Access Management
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/UsersTab.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Architecture:
 * 1. Single Point Registration: All staff and faculty are enrolled here.
 * 2. Automated Directory Filtering: Users with "Can Teach" enabled automatically appear
 *    in the Faculty tab; non-teaching users show only in the Users tab.
 * 3. Complete Attribute Ingestion: Employee ID, Name, Department, Position, Contact, and RFID UID.
 * 4. Password Security: Passwords hashed securely on the server with real-time complexity checks.
 * 5. Simple English Terms: Clean labels with Lucide SVG icons (no emojis).
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { ModuleTableLayout } from './ModuleTableLayout';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import {
  User,
  Plus,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  Loader2,
  Camera,
  X,
  Shield,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Phone,
  Briefcase,
  Building,
  CreditCard,
  GraduationCap,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface SystemUser {
  id: number;
  username: string;
  employee_id?: string;
  first_name?: string;
  middle_name?: string;
  last_name?: string;
  suffix?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  email?: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  department?: string;
  position?: string;
  rfid_uid?: string;
  role?: string;
  current_role?: string;
  is_teaching?: boolean;
  can_teach?: boolean;
  is_profile_completed?: boolean;
  faculty_id?: number | null;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
}

const RBAC_ROLES = [
  { value: 'FACULTY', label: 'Classroom Faculty', color: '#004b87', bg: '#e0f2fe' },
  { value: 'FACULTY_ADMIN', label: 'Faculty / Admin (Dual Role)', color: '#4f46e5', bg: '#eef2ff' },
  { value: 'ADMIN', label: 'System Administrator', color: '#0f172a', bg: '#f1f5f9' },
  { value: 'PRINCIPAL', label: 'School Principal', color: '#059669', bg: '#d1fae5' },
  { value: 'DEPT_HEAD', label: 'Department Head', color: '#0284c7', bg: '#e0f2fe' },
  { value: 'GUARD', label: 'Gate Security Guard', color: '#d97706', bg: '#fef3c7' },
];

const DEPARTMENTS_LIST = [
  'Junior High School',
  'Senior High School',
  'English Department',
  'Science Department',
  'Mathematics Department',
  'Filipino Department',
  'Araling Panlipunan Department',
  'MAPEH Department',
  'TLE / TVL Department',
  'Values Education (EsP) Department',
  'Office of the Principal / Administration',
  'Security & Gate Operations',
];

const POSITIONS_LIST = [
  'Faculty I',
  'Faculty II',
  'Faculty III',
  'Master Faculty I',
  'Master Faculty II',
  'Head Faculty I',
  'Head Faculty II',
  'Secondary School Principal IV',
  'Assistant School Principal',
  'Security Officer',
  'Administrative Assistant',
];

const INITIAL_FORM = {
  username: '',
  employee_id: '',
  first_name: '',
  middle_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  suffix: '',
  email: '',
  contact_number: '',
  department: 'Junior High School',
  position: 'Faculty I',
  rfid_uid: '',
  role: 'FACULTY',
  is_teaching: true,
  is_active: true,
  password: '',
  photo: null as string | null,
};

export const UsersTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const currentLoggedUsername = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  const [users, setUsers] = useState<SystemUser[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [teachingFilter, setTeachingFilter] = useState<string>('');

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState<SystemUser | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const activeAbortController = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef<boolean>(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen;

  const [liveErrors, setLiveErrors] = useState<{
    username?: string;
    email?: string;
    password?: string;
  }>({});
  const [isCheckingUsername, setIsCheckingUsername] = useState(false);

  // Real-time field validation
  useEffect(() => {
    const newErrors: { username?: string; email?: string; password?: string } = {};

    if (formData.username) {
      if (/\s/.test(formData.username)) {
        newErrors.username = 'Username cannot contain spaces.';
      } else if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/.test(formData.username)) {
        newErrors.username = 'Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores.';
      } else if (formData.username.length < 3) {
        newErrors.username = 'Username must be at least 3 characters.';
      }
    }

    if (formData.email && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(formData.email.trim())) {
      newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
    }

    if (formData.password) {
      if (formData.password.length < 8) {
        newErrors.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.';
      } else if (!/[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) || !/[0-9]/.test(formData.password)) {
        newErrors.password = 'Password must include both letters and numbers.';
      }
    }

    setLiveErrors((prev) => ({
      ...newErrors,
      username: newErrors.username || (prev.username?.includes('already') ? prev.username : undefined),
    }));
  }, [formData.username, formData.email, formData.password]);

  // Real-time server check for username availability
  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanUser = formData.username.trim();
    if (!isModalOpen || cleanUser.length < 3 || /\s/.test(cleanUser)) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        setIsCheckingUsername(true);
        const res = await apiClient.get('/validate-field/', {
          params: {
            field: 'username',
            value: cleanUser,
            exclude_id: editingUser?.id,
          },
        });
        if (!res.data.valid) {
          setLiveErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, username: res.data.message || 'Username already taken.' }));
        } else {
          setLiveErrors((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            username: prev.username?.includes('already') ? undefined : prev.username,
          }));
        }
      } catch {
      } finally {
        setIsCheckingUsername(false);
      }
    }, 400);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [formData.username, editingUser, isModalOpen]);

  const hasLiveErrors = Boolean(liveErrors.username || liveErrors.email || liveErrors.password);

  const handleCopy = async (text: string, id: string) => {
    if (!text) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopiedKey(id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
    } catch {}
  };

  const fetchUsers = useCallback(async (query = '', silent = false) => {
    if (activeAbortController.current) {
      activeAbortController.current.abort();
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    activeAbortController.current = controller;

    try {
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const res = await apiClient.get('/users/', {
        params: { search: query.trim() || undefined },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });

      const raw = res.data;
      const items: SystemUser[] = Array.isArray(raw)
        ? raw
        : raw && 'results' in raw && Array.isArray(raw.results)
        ? raw.results
        : [];
      setUsers(items);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.name === 'CanceledError' || err.name === 'AbortError') return;
      if (!silent) {
        setError('Unable to load user accounts. Administrator permissions required.');
      }
    } finally {
      if (!silent) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => fetchUsers(search, false), 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [search, fetchUsers]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Image',
        message: 'Only JPG, PNG, and WebP images are allowed.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Profile picture must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const b64 = reader.result as string;
      setPhotoPreview(b64);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: b64 }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingUser(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM);
    setLiveErrors({});
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (user: SystemUser) => {
    const rawRole = (user.current_role || user.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
    const isTeach =
      user.is_teaching !== undefined
        ? Boolean(user.is_teaching)
        : user.can_teach !== undefined
        ? Boolean(user.can_teach)
        : rawRole !== 'GUARD';

    const effectiveRole = rawRole === 'ADMIN' && isTeach ? 'FACULTY_ADMIN' : rawRole;

    setEditingUser(user);
    setLiveErrors({});
    setFormData({
      username: user.username || '',
      employee_id: user.employee_id || user.username || '',
      first_name: user.first_name || '',
      middle_name: user.middle_name || '',
      last_name: user.last_name || '',
      suffix: user.suffix || '',
      email: user.email || '',
      contact_number: user.contact_number || '',
      department: user.department || 'Junior High School',
      position: user.position || 'Faculty I',
      rfid_uid: user.rfid_uid || '',
      role: effectiveRole,
      is_teaching: isTeach,
      is_active: user.is_active ?? true,
      password: '',
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(user.photo_url || user.photo || null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (hasLiveErrors) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Form Notice',
        message: 'Please resolve the highlighted field errors before saving.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanUsername = formData.username.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (!cleanUsername) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Username Required',
        message: 'Username cannot be blank or contain spaces.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!editingUser && formData.password.trim().length < 8) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Password Required',
        message: 'Initial password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, any> = {
        username: cleanUsername,
        employee_id: (formData.employee_id.trim() || cleanUsername).toUpperCase(),
        first_name: formData.first_name.trim(),
        middle_name: formData.middle_name.trim(),
        last_name: formData.last_name.trim(),
        suffix: formData.suffix.trim(),
        email: formData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
        contact_number: formData.contact_number.trim(),
        department: formData.department.trim(),
        position: formData.position.trim(),
        rfid_uid: formData.rfid_uid.trim().toUpperCase() || null,
        role: formData.role,
        is_teaching: formData.is_teaching,
        is_active: formData.is_active,
      };

      if (formData.password.trim()) {
        payload.password = formData.password.trim();
      }

      if (formData.photo !== null) {
        payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;
      }

      if (editingUser) {
        await apiClient.put(`/users/${editingUser.id}/`, payload);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Account Saved',
          message: `Saved updates for @${cleanUsername}. Teaching permissions synchronized.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post('/users/', payload);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Account Registered',
          message: `@${cleanUsername} is registered. ${formData.is_teaching ? 'This faculty member now appears in the Faculty tab.' : 'Non-teaching user stored only in Users tab.'}`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchUsers(search, true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errMsg =
        err.response?.data?.username?.[0] ||
        err.response?.data?.error ||
        err.response?.data?.detail ||
        'Failed to save user account.';
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: errMsg,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const promptDelete = (user: SystemUser) => {
    if (user.username.trim().toLowerCase() === currentLoggedUsername) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: 'You cannot delete your own active administrator account.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete User Account',
      message: `Permanently delete account "@${user.username}"? Associated teaching and class list profiles will also be unlinked.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Account',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`/users/${user.id}/`);
          setUsers((prev) => prev.filter((u) => u.id !== user.id));
          showAlert({
            title: 'Account Removed',
            message: `User @${user.username} was deleted.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
        } catch {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Error',
            message: 'Unable to delete user account.',
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const filteredUsers = users.filter((u) => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    const name = `${u.first_name || ''} ${u.last_name || ''}`.toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch =
      (u.username || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (u.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (u.employee_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      name.includes(q);

    const matchesRole = !roleFilter || (u.current_role || u.role || '').toUpperCase() === roleFilter;

    let matchesTeaching = true;
    if (teachingFilter === 'CAN_TEACH') {
      matchesTeaching = Boolean(u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach);
    } else if (teachingFilter === 'CANT_TEACH') {
      matchesTeaching = !Boolean(u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach);
    }

    return matchesSearch && matchesRole && matchesTeaching;
  });

  const activeCount = users.filter((u) => u.is_active).length;
  const canTeachCount = users.filter((u) => Boolean(u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach)).length;
  const cantTeachCount = users.length - canTeachCount;

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)' }}>
      {/* 1. System Account Telemetry Summary */}
      <div style={statsGrid}>
        <div style={statCard}>
          <div style={statLabel}>TOTAL REGISTERED USERS</div>
          <div style={statValue}>{users.length}</div>
          <div style={statHelp}>System master user accounts</div>
        </div>

        <div style={statCard}>
          <div style={statLabel}>CAN TEACH (IN FACULTY TAB)</div>
          <div style={{ ...statValue, color: '#004b87' }}>{canTeachCount}</div>
          <div style={statHelp}>Visible in Faculty tab &amp; schedules</div>
        </div>

        <div style={statCard}>
          <div style={statLabel}>CANNOT TEACH (USERS ONLY)</div>
          <div style={{ ...statValue, color: '#64748b' }}>{cantTeachCount}</div>
          <div style={statHelp}>Staff, guards &amp; admin-only</div>
        </div>

        <div style={statCard}>
          <div style={statLabel}>ACTIVE ACCOUNTS</div>
          <div style={{ ...statValue, color: '#059669' }}>{activeCount}</div>
          <div style={statHelp}>Authorized for portal login</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Control Bar with Filters & Add Button */}
      <div style={controlBar}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            value={roleFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setRoleFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={selectPill}
          >
            <option value="">All Roles</option>
            {RBAC_ROLES.map((r) => (
              <option key={r.value} value={r.value}>
                {r.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <select
            value={teachingFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setTeachingFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={selectPill}
          >
            <option value="">All Status</option>
            <option value="CAN_TEACH">Can Teach (In Faculty Tab)</option>
            <option value="CANT_TEACH">Cannot Teach (Users Tab Only)</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <Button
          variant="primary"
          size="md"
          type="button"
          onClick={handleOpenCreate}
          style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, backgroundColor: '#004b87', borderColor: '#004b87' }}
        >
          <Plus size={15} />
          Register User / Faculty
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Main Users Table */}
      <div style={{ backgroundColor: '#ffffff', borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
          <ModuleTableLayout
            title="Users & Access Control"
            subtitle="All faculty, guards, and leadership are registered here. Enabling 'Can Teach' automatically displays the member in the Faculty tab."
            searchPlaceholder="Search by username, name, employee ID, or email..."
            searchValue={search}
            onSearchChange={setSearch}
            loading={loading}
            error={error}
            data={filteredUsers}
            keyExtractor={(u) => u.id}
            columns={[
              {
                header: 'User Profile & Identity',
                render: (u) => (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                    <div style={avatarBox}>
                      {u.photo_url || u.photo ? (
                        <img src={u.photo_url || u.photo || ''} alt={u.username} style={avatarImg} />
                      ) : (
                        <User size={18} color="#94a3b8" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a', fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>
                        {u.full_name || `${u.first_name || ''} ${u.last_name || ''}`.trim() || u.username}
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginTop: 2 }}>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                          ID: {u.employee_id || u.username}
                        </span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(u.username, `user-${u.id}`)}
                          title="Copy Username"
                          style={copyMiniBtn}
                        >
                          {copiedKey === `user-${u.id}` ? <Check size={11} color="#059669" /> : <Copy size={11} color="#94a3b8" />}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ),
              },
              {
                header: 'Role & Faculty Visibility',
                render: (u) => {
                  const canTeach = Boolean(u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach);
                  return (
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                      <span style={{ ...rolePillStyle, backgroundColor: '#eff6ff', color: '#004b87' }}>
                        <Shield size={11} /> {u.current_role || u.role || 'FACULTY'}
                      </span>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          ...rolePillStyle,
                          backgroundColor: canTeach ? '#ecfdf5' : '#f1f5f9',
                          color: canTeach ? '#047857' : '#64748b',
                          border: `1px solid ${canTeach ? '#a7f3d0' : '#e2e8f0'}`,
                        }}
                      >
                        {canTeach ? <GraduationCap size={11} /> : <User size={11} />}
                        {canTeach ? 'Can Teach (In Faculty Tab)' : 'Cannot Teach (Users Only)'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  );
                },
              },
              {
                header: 'Department & Position',
                render: (u) => (
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b', fontSize: '0.80rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                      <Briefcase size={12} color="#004b87" /> {u.position || 'Classroom Faculty'}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, marginTop: 2 }}>
                      <Building size={12} color="#94a3b8" /> {u.department || 'Junior High School'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ),
              },
              {
                header: 'Contact & Gate Card',
                render: (u) => (
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#334155', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                      <Phone size={11} color="#64748b" /> {u.contact_number || '—'}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: u.rfid_uid ? '#059669' : '#94a3b8', fontFamily: 'monospace', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, marginTop: 2 }}>
                      <CreditCard size={11} /> {u.rfid_uid || 'No Card'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ),
              },
              {
                header: 'Status',
                render: (u) => (
                  <span
                    style={{
                      padding: '3px 8px',
                      borderRadius: 12,
                      fontSize: '0.68rem',
                      fontWeight: 800,
                      backgroundColor: u.is_active ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef2f2',
                      color: u.is_active ? '#059669' : '#dc2626',
                      border: `1px solid ${u.is_active ? '#a7f3d0' : '#fecaca'}`,
                    }}
                  >
                    {u.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'SUSPENDED'}
                  </span>
                ),
              },
              {
                header: 'Actions',
                align: 'right',
                render: (u) => {
                  const isSelf = u.username.trim().toLowerCase() === currentLoggedUsername;
                  return (
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(u)}
                        title="Edit User & Permissions"
                        style={actionBtn}
                      >
                        <Pencil size={13} color="#004b87" />
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={isSelf}
                        onClick={() => promptDelete(u)}
                        title={isSelf ? 'Cannot delete your active account' : 'Delete Account'}
                        style={{
                          ...actionBtn,
                          backgroundColor: '#fef2f2',
                          borderColor: '#fee2e2',
                          opacity: isSelf ? 0.35 : 1,
                          cursor: isSelf ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                        }}
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={13} color="#dc2626" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                },
              },
            ]}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Complete Registration & Edit Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        title={editingUser ? `Edit User: @${editingUser.username}` : 'Register User / Faculty'}
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
          {/* Photo Upload */}
          <div style={photoUploadContainer}>
            <div style={photoPreviewBox}>
              {photoPreview ? (
                <img src={photoPreview} alt="Preview" style={photoPreviewImg} />
              ) : (
                <User size={28} color="#94a3b8" />
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, flex: 1 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                Profile Portrait Picture
              </span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                JPEG, PNG, or WebP under 2.5 MB.
              </span>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
                <input
                  type="file"
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp"
                  style={{ display: 'none' }}
                  onChange={handlePhotoSelect}
                />
                <label onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} style={uploadBtnLabel}>
                  <Camera size={13} />
                  <span>{photoPreview ? 'Change Photo' : 'Upload Photo'}</span>
                </label>

                {photoPreview && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setPhotoPreview(null);
                      setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: '' }));
                    }}
                    style={removePhotoBtn}
                  >
                    <X size={12} />

                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Credentials: Username & Employee ID */}
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Username (Login ID) *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={formData.username}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, username: e.target.value })}
                style={{
                  ...inputStyle,
                  borderColor: liveErrors.username ? '#dc2626' : formData.username.length >= 3 ? '#059669' : '#cbd5e1',
                }}
                placeholder="e.g. maria_santos"
              />
              {liveErrors.username && <span style={errorTextStyle}>{liveErrors.username}</span>}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Employee ID *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={formData.employee_id}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, employee_id: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                style={inputStyle}
                placeholder="e.g. EMP-2026-004"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Full Name Fields */}
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 140px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>First Name *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={formData.first_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })}
                style={inputStyle}
                placeholder="First name"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Middle Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.middle_name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })}
                style={inputStyle}
                placeholder="Optional"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Last Name *</label>
              <input

                required

                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, last_name: e.target.value })}

              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Phone Number (For SMS &amp; 2FA)</label>
              <input
                type="text"

                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, contact_number: e.target.value })}
                style={inputStyle}
                placeholder="09171234567"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Role & Teaching Clearance */}
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>RBAC System Role *</label>
            <select
              value={formData.role}
              onChange={(e) => {

                setFormData({
                  ...formData,

          {/* "Can Teach" Checkbox */}

              type="checkbox"

              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, is_teaching: e.target.checked })}
              style={{ width: 18, height: 18, accentColor: '#004b87', cursor: 'pointer' }}
            />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 800, color: formData.is_teaching ? '#004b87' : '#0f172a' }}>
                Can Teach Classes (Visible in Faculty Tab &amp; Timetables)
              </span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                {formData.is_teaching
                  ? 'Active: This member will appear in the Faculty tab, advisee sections, and class schedules.'
                  : 'Inactive: Non-teaching user. Will appear ONLY in the Users tab.'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </label>

          {/* Department, Position & RFID */}
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Department</label>
              <select
                value={formData.department}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, department: e.target.value })}
                style={inputStyle}
              >
                {DEPARTMENTS_LIST.map((d) => (
                  <option key={d} value={d}>
                    {d}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label style={labelStyle}>Official Position / Title</label>
              <select
                value={formData.position}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, position: e.target.value })}
                style={inputStyle}
              >
                {POSITIONS_LIST.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p} value={p}>

                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>Gate Scanner RFID Card UID</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. 5A92B1C4"
              value={formData.rfid_uid}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, rfid_uid: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
              style={{ ...inputStyle, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Password */}
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle}>
              {editingUser ? 'Reset Password (Optional, min 8 chars)' : 'Initial Password (Min 8 chars) *'}
            </label>
            <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              <input
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                required={!editingUser}
                minLength={8}
                placeholder={editingUser ? 'Leave blank to preserve current password' : 'Minimum 8 characters'}
                value={formData.password}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, password: e.target.value })}
                style={{ ...inputStyle, paddingRight: 36 }}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                style={eyeToggleBtn}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={15} /> : <Eye size={15} />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              type="submit"
              disabled={saving || hasLiveErrors || isCheckingUsername}
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#004b87', borderColor: '#004b87' }}
            >
              {saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> : null}
              {editingUser ? 'Save Updates' : 'Register User'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Resilient Modal Dialog
 * File: web/src/components/ui/AlertDialog.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. Safe Child Parsing: Safely converts objects, errors, and arrays to text to prevent React rendering crashes.
 * 2. Focus & Escape Handling: Automatically focuses primary action and supports Escape dismissal.
 * 3. Quick Workflow (Auto-Close): Automatically dismisses non-critical success alerts after 3.5 seconds.
 * 4. Overflow Protection: Adds scroll constraints so long error messages never clip action buttons.
 */

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  XCircle,
  X,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';

export type AlertType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

export interface AlertDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title?: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  type?: AlertType;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  autoClose?: boolean; // Defaults to true for success, false for error/warning
  autoCloseDuration?: number; // Milliseconds (default: 3500ms)
  onAction?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Defensive Sanitizer: Ensures message is always rendered as a safe, readable string.
 * Prevents React rendering crashes when Django or Axios returns error objects or arrays.
 */
const sanitizeMessage = (msg: unknown): string => {
  if (msg === null || msg === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof msg === 'string') return msg;
  if (typeof msg === 'number' || typeof msg === 'boolean') return String(msg);
  if (msg instanceof Error) return msg.message;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(msg);
  } catch {
    return 'An unexpected system notification was received.';
  }
};

export const AlertDialog: React.FC<AlertDialogProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  title,
  message,
  type = 'info',
  confirmLabel = 'Understood',
  actionLabel,
  autoClose,
  autoCloseDuration = 3500,
  onAction,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const confirmBtnRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const autoCloseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    onClose();
  }, [onClose]);

  // Handle Escape key and auto-focus for accessibility
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    // Focus primary action button immediately
    const focusTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      confirmBtnRef.current?.focus();
    }, 50);

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

    // Auto-dismiss success notifications to speed up operator actions
    const shouldAutoClose = autoClose ?? (type === 'success' && !actionLabel);
    if (shouldAutoClose) {
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        handleClose();
      }, autoCloseDuration);
    }

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(focusTimeout);
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      }
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, type, actionLabel, autoClose, autoCloseDuration, handleClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const config = {
    info: {
      icon: Info,
      color: '#0284c7',
      bgColor: '#e0f2fe',
      borderColor: '#bae6fd',
      defaultTitle: 'Notice',
    },
    success: {
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      color: '#059669',
      bgColor: '#d1fae5',
      borderColor: '#a7f3d0',
      defaultTitle: 'Operation Successful',
    },
    warning: {
      icon: AlertTriangle,
      color: '#d97706',
      bgColor: '#fef3c7',
      borderColor: '#fde68a',
      defaultTitle: 'Action Required',
    },
    error: {
      icon: XCircle,
      color: '#dc2626',
      bgColor: '#fee2e2',
      borderColor: '#fecaca',
      defaultTitle: 'System Alert',
    },
  }[type];

  const IconComponent = config.icon;
  const safeMessage = sanitizeMessage(message);

  return (
    <div
      style={overlayStyle}
      onClick={handleClose}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="alert-dialog-title"
    >
      <div
        style={modalBoxStyle}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Top Accent Color Line */}
        <div style={{ height: 4, backgroundColor: config.color, width: '100%' }} />

        <div style={{ padding: '20px 22px 18px 22px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 14 }}>
            {/* Status Icon */}
            <div
              style={{
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                backgroundColor: config.bgColor,
                border: `1px solid ${config.borderColor}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              <IconComponent size={22} color={config.color} />
            </div>

            {/* Content Text */}
            <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, paddingTop: 1 }}>
              <div
                id="alert-dialog-title"
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.96rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  color: '#0f172a',
                  marginBottom: 6,
                }}
              >
                {title || config.defaultTitle}
              </div>
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  color: '#475569',
                  lineHeight: 1.5,
                  maxHeight: '40vh',
                  overflowY: 'auto',
                  wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  paddingRight: 4,
                }}
              >
                {safeMessage}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Top Close Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              style={closeBtnStyle}
              title="Close"
              aria-label="Close dialog"
              onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.color = '#334155')}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.color = '#94a3b8')}
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Action Button Row */}
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'flex-end',
              gap: 8,
              marginTop: 18,
              paddingTop: 12,
              borderTop: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
            }}
          >
            {actionLabel && onAction && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onAction();
                  handleClose();
                }}
                style={actionBtnStyle}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = '#0369a1')}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = '#0284c7')}
              >
                <span>{actionLabel}</span>
                <ArrowRight size={13} />
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              ref={confirmBtnRef}
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              style={{
                padding: '7px 16px',
                backgroundColor: actionLabel ? '#f1f5f9' : config.color,
                color: actionLabel ? '#475569' : '#ffffff',
                borderRadius: 6,
                border: actionLabel ? '1px solid #e2e8f0' : 'none',
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                transition: 'opacity 0.15s ease',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '0.9')}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '1')}
            >
              {confirmLabel}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { theme } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'dark' | 'ghost';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  loading?: boolean;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

export const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({
  children,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  loading = false,
  icon,
  disabled,
  style,
  ...props
}) => {
  const getVariantStyles = (): React.CSSProperties => {
    switch (variant) {
      case 'primary':
        return { backgroundColor: theme.colors.primary, color: theme.colors.textWhite };
      case 'secondary':
        return { backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceSubtle, color: theme.colors.textPrimary, border: `1px solid ${theme.colors.border}` };
      case 'danger':
        return { backgroundColor: theme.colors.danger, color: theme.colors.textWhite };
      case 'dark':
        return { backgroundColor: '#334155', color: theme.colors.textWhite };
      case 'ghost':
        return { backgroundColor: 'transparent', color: theme.colors.textPrimary };
    }
  };

  const sizeStyles: React.CSSProperties = size === 'sm'
    ? { padding: '5px 10px', fontSize: '0.8rem' }
    : { padding: '8px 14px', fontSize: '0.875rem' };

  return (
    <button
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        gap: '6px',
        fontWeight: 600,
        borderRadius: theme.radius.sm,
        border: 'none',
        cursor: disabled || loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
        opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
        transition: 'all 0.15s ease-in-out',
        ...sizeStyles,
        ...getVariantStyles(),
        ...style,
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> : icon}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
};
