========================================================
File: web\src\context\AlertContext.tsx
========================================================
/**
 * AttendSure - Global Modern Alert & Confirmation System
 * File: web/src/context/AlertContext.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. Safe Type Parsing: Converts raw objects/arrays to clean text to prevent UI render crashes.
 * 2. Unhandled Exception Shield: Encapsulates async confirmations in try-catch-finally.
 * 3. Keyboard & Focus Trap Protection: Adds native Escape key dismiss handlers.
 * 4. Fast Auto-Dismiss: Closes non-critical success notifications automatically after 3.5 seconds.
 */

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  XCircle,
  Info,
  X,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';

export type AlertType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

export interface AlertOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  type?: AlertType;
  actionLabel?: string;
  autoCloseDuration?: number; // Milliseconds (defaults to 3500ms for success)
  onAction?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  isDestructive?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void> | void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

interface AlertContextType {
  showAlert: (options: AlertOptions) => void;
  showConfirm: (options: ConfirmOptions) => void;
  closeAlert: () => void;
  closeConfirm: () => void;
}

const AlertContext = createContext<AlertContextType | undefined>(undefined);

/**
 * Defensive Sanitizer: Ensures message is always a safe, readable string.
 * Prevents React child injection crashes from raw backend error dictionaries.
 */
const toSafeString = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val;
  if (typeof val === 'number' || typeof val === 'boolean') return String(val);
  if (val instanceof Error) return val.message;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(val);
  } catch {
    return 'An unexpected system event occurred.';
  }
};

export const AlertProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [alertData, setAlertData] = useState<AlertOptions | null>(null);
  const [confirmData, setConfirmData] = useState<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const [isConfirmLoading, setIsConfirmLoading] = useState(false);

  const autoCloseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const closeAlert = useCallback(() => {
    if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (alertData?.onClose) {
      alertData.onClose();
    }
    setAlertData(null);
  }, [alertData]);

  const closeConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    if (isConfirmLoading) return;
    if (confirmData?.onCancel) {
      confirmData.onCancel();
    }
    setConfirmData(null);
  }, [confirmData, isConfirmLoading]);

  const showAlert = useCallback(
    (options: AlertOptions) => {
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
      }

      setAlertData({
        ...options,
        title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Notification',
        message: toSafeString(options.message),
      });

      // Auto-dismiss success notifications to keep workflows fast
      if (options.type === 'success' && !options.actionLabel) {
        const duration = options.autoCloseDuration ?? 3500;
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          closeAlert();
        }, duration);
      }
    },
    [closeAlert]
  );

  const showConfirm = useCallback((options: ConfirmOptions) => {
    setConfirmData({
      ...options,
      title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Confirm Action',
      message: toSafeString(options.message),
    });
  }, []);

  // Keyboard navigation safeguard (Escape key closes modals)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (confirmData && !isConfirmLoading) {
          closeConfirm();
        } else if (alertData) {
          closeAlert();
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [alertData, confirmData, isConfirmLoading, closeAlert, closeConfirm]);

  const handleConfirmAction = async () => {
    if (!confirmData || isConfirmLoading) return;
    try {
      setIsConfirmLoading(true);
      await confirmData.onConfirm();
      setConfirmData(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[AlertContext] Confirm action failed:', err);
      // Display error modal if confirmation action throws
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Error',
        message: err,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsConfirmLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAlertAction = () => {
    if (alertData?.onAction) {
      alertData.onAction();
    }
    closeAlert();
  };

  const getAlertIcon = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return <CheckCircle2 size={24} color="#059669" />;
      case 'error':
        return <XCircle size={24} color="#dc2626" />;
      case 'warning':
        return <AlertTriangle size={24} color="#d97706" />;
      case 'info':
      default:
        return <Info size={24} color="#0284c7" />;
    }
  };

  const getAlertColorTheme = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return { bg: '#ecfdf5', border: '#a7f3d0' };
      case 'error':
        return { bg: '#fef2f2', border: '#fecaca' };
      case 'warning':
        return { bg: '#fffbeb', border: '#fde68a' };
      case 'info':
      default:
        return { bg: '#f0f9ff', border: '#bae6fd' };
    }
  };

  return (
    <AlertContext.Provider value={{ showAlert, showConfirm, closeAlert, closeConfirm }}>
      {children}

      {/* 1. INFORMATIONAL / ACTION ALERT MODAL */}
      {alertData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,
                  backgroundColor: getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').bg,
                  border: `1px solid ${getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').border}`,
                }}
              >
                {getAlertIcon(alertData.type || 'info')}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  {alertData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: '#475569',
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >
                  {String(alertData.message)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeAlert}
                style={closeBtnStyle}
                title="Close"
                aria-label="Close alert"
              >
                <X size={16} color="#64748b" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
              {alertData.actionLabel ? (
                <>
                  <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={secondaryBtnStyle}>
                    Dismiss
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={handleAlertAction} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                    {alertData.actionLabel}
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                  Okay
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. CONFIRMATION DIALOG MODAL */}
      {confirmData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,
                  backgroundColor: confirmData.isDestructive ? '#fef2f2' : '#eff6ff',
                  border: `1px solid ${confirmData.isDestructive ? '#fecaca' : '#bfdbfe'}`,
                }}
              >
                {confirmData.isDestructive ? (
                  <AlertTriangle size={24} color="#dc2626" />
                ) : (
                  <Info size={24} color="#0284c7" />
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  {confirmData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: '#475569',
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >
                  {String(confirmData.message)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 18 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={closeConfirm}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
              >
                {confirmData.cancelLabel || 'Cancel'}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={handleConfirmAction}
                style={{
                  ...primaryBtnStyle,
                  backgroundColor: confirmData.isDestructive ? '#dc2626' : '#0284c7',
                }}
              >
                {isConfirmLoading ? (
                  <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                ) : null}
                {confirmData.confirmLabel || 'Confirm'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AlertContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAlert = () => {
  const context = useContext(AlertContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAlert must be used within an AlertProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

  justifyContent: 'center',

  border: 'none',
  cursor: 'pointer',
  padding: 4,
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
};

  fontSize: '0.80rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  cursor: 'pointer',

  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',

  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
  color: '#334155',
  border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
  borderRadius: 6,

/**
 * AttendSure - Institutional Context Provider (Real Database Data)
 * File: web/src/context/SchoolContext.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Performance:
 * 1. Zero Mock Data: All school information is loaded strictly from the PostgreSQL database.
 * 2. Real-Time Cache Sync: Caches genuine database records in localStorage to ensure fast frame-1 boot.
 * 3. Quota Safety Guard: Strips excessive base64 payload strings before writing to browser storage.
 * 4. Simple English Terms: Clean data interfaces for school profile, head, and boundary settings.
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../api/client';

export interface SchoolData {
  school_id: string;
  school_name: string;
  division: string;
  region: string;
  district: string;
  address?: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  email?: string;
  website?: string;
  principal_faculty?: number | string | null;
  principal_name: string;
  principal_title: string;
  superintendent_name?: string;
  school_logo: string | null;
  left_logo: string | null;
  right_logo: string | null;
  latitude: number | null;
  longitude: number | null;
  geofence_radius_meters: number;
  academic_year?: string;
}

const EMPTY_SCHOOL: SchoolData = {
  school_id: '',
  school_name: '',
  division: '',
  region: '',
  district: '',
  address: '',
  contact_number: '',
  email: '',
  website: '',
  principal_faculty: null,
  principal_name: '',
  principal_title: '',
  superintendent_name: '',
  school_logo: null,
  left_logo: null,
  right_logo: null,
  latitude: null,
  longitude: null,
  geofence_radius_meters: 100,
  academic_year: '',
};

interface SchoolContextValue {
  school: SchoolData;
  loading: boolean;
  refreshSchool: () => Promise<void>;
  updateSchool: (data: Partial<SchoolData>) => void;
  updateSchoolInstantly: (data: Partial<SchoolData>) => void;
}

const SchoolContext = createContext<SchoolContextValue>({
  school: EMPTY_SCHOOL,
  loading: false,
  refreshSchool: async () => {},
  updateSchool: () => {},
  updateSchoolInstantly: () => {},
});

export const SchoolProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [school, setSchool] = useState<SchoolData>(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_school_profile');
      if (cached) {
        return { ...EMPTY_SCHOOL, ...JSON.parse(cached) };
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback to empty state
    }
    return EMPTY_SCHOOL;
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    return !localStorage.getItem('attendsure_school_profile');
  });

  const applySchoolUpdate = useCallback((patch: Partial<SchoolData>) => {
    setSchool((prev) => {
      const updated = { ...prev, ...patch };
      try {
        const storageSafe = { ...updated };
        if (storageSafe.school_logo && storageSafe.school_logo.length > 300000) storageSafe.school_logo = null;
        if (storageSafe.left_logo && storageSafe.left_logo.length > 300000) storageSafe.left_logo = null;
        if (storageSafe.right_logo && storageSafe.right_logo.length > 300000) storageSafe.right_logo = null;
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_school_profile', JSON.stringify(storageSafe));
      } catch {
        // Handle browser quota limit safely
      }
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchSchoolData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<SchoolData>('/settings/school/', { timeout: 8000 });
      if (res.data) {
        applySchoolUpdate(res.data);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      console.warn('[SchoolContext] Database sync notice:', msg);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [applySchoolUpdate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSchoolData();
  }, [fetchSchoolData]);

  return (
    <SchoolContext.Provider
      value={{
        school,
        loading,
        refreshSchool: fetchSchoolData,
        updateSchool: applySchoolUpdate,
        updateSchoolInstantly: applySchoolUpdate,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </SchoolContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useSchool = () => useContext(SchoolContext);
export default SchoolContext;

    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface-hover', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.bgSurfaceHover);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-subtle', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.borderSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-strong', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.borderStrong);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-primary', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.textPrimary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-secondary', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.textSecondary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-muted', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.textMuted);
    root.style.setProperty('--card-shadow', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.cardShadow);
    root.style.setProperty('--primary-light', PURE_WHITE_TOKENS.primaryLight);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-primary', BRAND_COLORS.primary);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-secondary', BRAND_COLORS.secondary);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-success', BRAND_COLORS.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-warning', BRAND_COLORS.warning);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-danger', BRAND_COLORS.danger);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider
      value={{

File: web\src\hooks\usePageSetup.ts

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP } from '../types/pageSetup';
import type { PageSetupConfig } from '../types/pageSetup';

const GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY = 'attendsure_page_setup_default';

export const usePageSetup = (reportKey: string = 'general') => {
  const specificKey = `attendsure_page_setup_${reportKey}`;

  const loadInitial = (): PageSetupConfig => {
    try {
      const specific = localStorage.getItem(specificKey);
      if (specific) return JSON.parse(specific);

      const globalDefault = localStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY);
      if (globalDefault) return JSON.parse(globalDefault);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to parse page setup from local storage', e);
    }
    return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  };

  const [config, setConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(loadInitial);

  // Sync state if localStorage changes from another tab/window
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === specificKey || e.key === GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY) {
        setConfig(loadInitial());
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  }, [specificKey]);

  const saveConfig = useCallback(
    (newConfig: PageSetupConfig, setAsGlobalDefault: boolean = false) => {
      setConfig(newConfig);
      localStorage.setItem(specificKey, JSON.stringify(newConfig));
      if (setAsGlobalDefault) {
        localStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY, JSON.stringify(newConfig));
      }
    },
    [specificKey]
  );

  return { config, saveConfig };
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient from './api/client';
import { LoginView } from './components/auth/LoginView';
import { SplashScreen } from './components/splash/SplashScreen';
import { Sidebar, type NavItemKey } from './components/layout/Sidebar';
import { Header } from './components/layout/Header';
import Footer from './components/layout/Footer';
import { ProfileModal, type ProfileUpdatePayload } from './components/modals/ProfileModal';
import { CompleteProfileModal, type CompletedProfileUser } from './components/modals/CompleteProfileModal';
import { DashboardView } from './components/dashboard/DashboardView';
import { AdvisorySubjectMonitor } from './components/advisory/AdvisorySubjectMonitor';
import { SchoolProvider, useSchool } from './context/SchoolContext';
import { AlertProvider } from './context/AlertContext';
import { ThemeProvider, useTheme } from './context/ThemeContext';
import type { UserSession } from './types/section';
import {
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowLeft,
  WifiOff,
} from 'lucide-react';

// Modular Tab Views
import {
  SF1ReportTab,
  SF2ReportTab,
  SF4ReportTab,
  StudentsTab,
  FacultyTab,
  DTRTab,
  GatePassesTab,
  SchedulesTab,
  GeofenceTab,
  UsersTab,
  SettingsTab,
  SmsTab,
} from './components/tabs';
import { MyAssignedClassesTab } from './components/tabs/MyAssignedClassesTab';
import { ClassroomScanner } from './components/scanner/ClassroomScanner';

// Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Permissions Map (Classroom & Loafing Scope)
export const BASE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS: Record<string, NavItemKey[]> = {
  ADMIN: [
    'dashboard',
    'classroom-scanner',
    'my-classes',
    'advisory-monitor',
    'students',
    'facultys',
    'users',
    'gate-passes',
    'schedules',
    'dtr',
    'geofence',
    'sms',
    'reports',
    'settings',
  ],
  PRINCIPAL: [
    'dashboard',
    'classroom-scanner',
    'my-classes',
    'advisory-monitor',
    'students',
    'facultys',
    'gate-passes',
    'schedules',
    'dtr',
    'geofence',
    'sms',
    'reports',
    'settings',
  ],
  DEPT_HEAD: [
    'dashboard',
    'classroom-scanner',
    'my-classes',
    'advisory-monitor',
    'students',
    'facultys',
    'gate-passes',
    'schedules',
    'dtr',
    'reports',
  ],
  FACULTY: [
    'dashboard',
    'classroom-scanner',
    'my-classes',
    'advisory-monitor',
    'students',
    'dtr',
    'gate-passes',
    'reports',
  ],
};

interface OfflineNoticeOverlayProps {
  onManualRetry: () => void;
  isChecking: boolean;
}

const OfflineNoticeOverlay: React.FC<OfflineNoticeOverlayProps> = ({ onManualRetry, isChecking }) => {
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 35,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.70)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(5px)',
        WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(5px)',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: '20px',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        userSelect: 'none',
      }}
      aria-busy="true"
      aria-live="polite"
    >
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 10,
          padding: '10px 20px',
          borderRadius: 9999,
          backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
          border: '1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)',
          boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)',
          cursor: 'pointer',
        }}
        onClick={onManualRetry}
        title="Click to reconnect"
      >
        <WifiOff size={16} color="#38bdf8" />
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#f8fafc' }}>
          {isChecking ? 'Connecting to school system...' : 'System offline. Click to reconnect.'}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const AppContent: React.FC = () => {
  const { school, loading: isSchoolLoading } = useSchool();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const [session, setSession] = useState<UserSession | null>(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token');
    const username = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username');
    const faculty_name = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_faculty_name');
    const role = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role');
    const user_id = Number(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') || 0);

    return token
      ? {
          user_id,
          token,
          username: username || '',
          faculty_name: faculty_name || username || 'Faculty User',
          role: role || 'FACULTY',
        }
      : null;
  });

  const [userPhoto, setUserPhoto] = useState<string | null>(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_photo') || null;
  });

  const [canTeach, setCanTeach] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('attendsure_can_teach') === 'true';
  });
  const [isCompleteProfileModalOpen, setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<NavItemKey>('dashboard');
  const [selectedReport, setSelectedReport] = useState<'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4'>('sf1');
  const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isProfileModalOpen, setIsProfileModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [isServerOnline, setIsServerOnline] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isCheckingServer, setIsCheckingServer] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const userRole = (session?.role || '').toUpperCase();

  const allowedTabs = useMemo<NavItemKey[]>(() => {
    if (!userRole) return [];
    const baseAllowed = BASE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[userRole] || BASE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS['FACULTY'];
    const tabs = [...baseAllowed];

    if (canTeach && !tabs.includes('my-classes')) {
      tabs.push('my-classes');
    }
    if (canTeach && !tabs.includes('classroom-scanner')) {
      tabs.push('classroom-scanner');
    }
    if (canTeach && !tabs.includes('advisory-monitor')) {
      tabs.push('advisory-monitor');
    }
    return tabs;
  }, [userRole, canTeach]);

  const isAllowedToAccess = useMemo(() => {
    return allowedTabs.includes(activeTab);
  }, [allowedTabs, activeTab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (session && allowedTabs.length > 0 && !allowedTabs.includes(activeTab)) {
      setActiveTab(allowedTabs[0]);
    }
  }, [session, allowedTabs, activeTab]);

  const handleAuthExpired = useCallback(() => {
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_token');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_username');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_faculty_name');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_role');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_id');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');
    localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_can_teach');
    setSession(null);
    setUserPhoto(null);
    setCanTeach(false);
    setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(false);
  }, []);

  const handleTabSelection = useCallback((tab: NavItemKey) => {
    if (allowedTabs.includes(tab)) setActiveTab(tab);
  }, [allowedTabs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleNavigate = (e: Event) => {
      const customEvent = e as CustomEvent<string | { tab: string; report?: string }>;
      const detail = customEvent.detail;
      if (!detail) return;

      if (typeof detail === 'string') {
        handleTabSelection(detail as NavItemKey);
      } else if (typeof detail === 'object' && detail.tab) {
        handleTabSelection(detail.tab as NavItemKey);
        if (detail.report && ['sf1', 'sf2', 'sf4'].includes(detail.report)) {
          setSelectedReport(detail.report as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4');
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('attendsure:navigate', handleNavigate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:navigate', handleNavigate);
  }, [handleTabSelection]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.token) return;

    let isSubscribed = true;

    apiClient
      .get('/me/', { timeout: 8000 })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!isSubscribed || !res.data) return;

        setIsServerOnline(true);
        const photo = res.data.photo || null;
        const name: string = String(res.data.full_name || res.data.username || '').trim();
        const role = (res.data.role || res.data.system_role || session.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
        const userId = Number(res.data.id || res.data.user_id || 0);
        const isCompleted = res.data.is_profile_completed ?? true;
        const canTeachFlag = Boolean(
          res.data.can_teach ||
          res.data.is_teaching ||
          res.data.assigned_class_count > 0 ||
          role === 'FACULTY'
        );

        if (photo) {
          setUserPhoto(photo);
          localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
        } else {
          setUserPhoto(null);
          localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');
        }

        if (name) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', name);
        if (role) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', role);
        if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));

        setCanTeach(canTeachFlag);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(canTeachFlag));

        if (!isCompleted) {
          setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(true);
        }

        setSession((prev) =>
          prev
            ? {
                ...prev,
                user_id: userId || prev.user_id,
                faculty_name: name || prev.faculty_name,
                role: role || prev.role,
              }
            : null
        );
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        if (!err.response && (err.code === 'ERR_NETWORK' || err.message?.includes('Network Error'))) {
          setIsServerOnline(false);
        } else if (err.response?.status === 401) {
          handleAuthExpired();
        }
      });

    return () => {
      isSubscribed = false;
    };
  }, [session?.token, handleAuthExpired]);

  const retryConnection = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsCheckingServer(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get('/settings/school/', { timeout: 5000 });
      if (res.status >= 200 && res.status < 500) {
        setIsServerOnline(true);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (!err.response) {
        setIsServerOnline(false);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingServer(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const getPageTitle = (): string => {
    if (!isAllowedToAccess) return 'Access Restricted';
    const currentSchool = school.school_name ? `${school.school_name} ` : '';

    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard': return `${currentSchool}Dashboard`;
      case 'classroom-scanner': return 'Classroom Attendance Scanner';
      case 'my-classes': return 'My Classes';
      case 'advisory-monitor': return 'Classroom Attendance & Loafing Monitor';
      case 'students': return 'Student Profiles & IDs';
      case 'facultys': return 'Faculty & Staff Directory';
      case 'users': return 'User Accounts & Roles';
      case 'gate-passes': return 'Classroom Exit Passes';
      case 'schedules': return 'Class Schedules & Sections';
      case 'dtr': return 'Daily Time Records (DTR)';
      case 'geofence': return 'Campus Boundary';
      case 'sms': return 'Parent Text Messages (SMS)';
      case 'reports':
        if (selectedReport === 'sf1') return 'School Register (Form 1)';
        if (selectedReport === 'sf2') return 'Daily Attendance Register (Form 2)';
        return "Monthly Learner's Movement and Attendance (Form 4)";
      case 'settings': return 'School Settings';
      default: return 'AttendSure System';
    }
  };

  const renderActiveTabContent = () => {
    if (!isAllowedToAccess) {
      return (
        <div style={{ height: '100%', minHeight: 400, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 24, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ width: 56, height: 56, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <ShieldAlert size={28} color={brand.danger} />
          </div>
          <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.20rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, margin: '0 0 6px 0' }}>Access Restricted</h2>
          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: tokens.textMuted, maxWidth: 440, margin: '0 0 20px 0' }}>
            Your account role (<strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{userRole}</strong>) does not have permission to view this section.
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(allowedTabs[0] || 'dashboard')}
            style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, padding: '8px 16px', backgroundColor: brand.primary, color: '#ffffff', borderRadius: 8, border: 'none', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
            type="button"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={14} /> Return to Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        return (
          <DashboardView
            isServerOnline={isServerOnline}
            userRole={userRole}
            onManualRefresh={retryConnection}
            onNavigateTab={(tab, report) => {
              handleTabSelection(tab as NavItemKey);
              if (report && ['sf1', 'sf2', 'sf4'].includes(report)) {
                setSelectedReport(report as 'sf1' | 'sf2' | 'sf4');
              }
            }}
          />
        );
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)', width: '100%', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
            <ClassroomScanner />
          </div>
        );
      case 'my-classes': return <MyAssignedClassesTab />;
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)', width: '100%', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}>
            <AdvisorySubjectMonitor />
          </div>
        );
      case 'reports':
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%', width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            {selectedReport === 'sf1' && <SF1ReportTab activeReportId={selectedReport} onSelectReport={(id) => setSelectedReport(id as any)} />}
            {selectedReport === 'sf2' && <SF2ReportTab activeReportId={selectedReport} onSelectReport={(id) => setSelectedReport(id as any)} />}
            {selectedReport === 'sf4' && <SF4ReportTab activeReportId={selectedReport} onSelectReport={(id) => setSelectedReport(id as any)} />}
          </div>
        );
      case 'students': return <StudentsTab />;
      case 'facultys': return <FacultyTab />;
      case 'dtr': return <DTRTab />;
      case 'sms': return <SmsTab />;
      case 'gate-passes': return <GatePassesTab />;
      case 'schedules': return <SchedulesTab />;
      case 'geofence': return <GeofenceTab />;
      case 'users': return <UsersTab />;
      case 'settings': return <SettingsTab />;
      default: return <DashboardView isServerOnline={isServerOnline} onManualRefresh={retryConnection} />;
    }
  };

  const resolvedSchoolLogo = school.school_logo || school.left_logo || null;

  return (
    <>
      <SplashScreen loading={isSchoolLoading} minDurationMs={300} />

      {!session ? (
        <LoginView
          onLoginSuccess={(newSession: UserSession) => {
            setSession(newSession);
            setActiveTab('dashboard');
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            height: '100vh',
            width: '100%',
            maxWidth: '100%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp || '#f1f5f9',
            padding: 'clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 16px)',
            gap: 'clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 16px)',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
            textAlign: 'left',
            transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease',
          }}
        >
          {/* Floating Sidebar */}
          <div
            style={{
              height: '100%',
              borderRadius: 16,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
              border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
              display: 'flex',
              flexShrink: 0,
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
              transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
            }}
          >
            <Sidebar
              activeTab={activeTab}
              onSelectTab={handleTabSelection}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              isCollapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
              onToggleCollapse={() => setIsSidebarCollapsed((prev) => !prev)}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              canTeach={canTeach}
              allowedTabs={allowedTabs}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Floating Main Content Card */}
          <div
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              minWidth: 0,
              minHeight: 0,
              height: '100%',
              borderRadius: 16,
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
              boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
              border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
            }}
          >
            <Header
              title={getPageTitle()}
              isGateNodeOnline={isServerOnline}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              onLogout={handleAuthExpired}
              onNavigateTab={handleTabSelection}
              onOpenProfile={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(true)}
            />

            <main
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                minWidth: 0,
                minHeight: 0,
                overflowY: activeTab === 'dashboard' || activeTab === 'reports' ? 'hidden' : 'auto',
                overflowX: 'hidden',
                position: 'relative',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
              }}
            >
              <div
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  minWidth: 0,
                  width: '100%',
                  height: '100%',
                  filter: !isServerOnline ? 'grayscale(90%) blur(3px) opacity(0.30)' : 'none',
                  pointerEvents: !isServerOnline ? 'none' : 'auto',
                  userSelect: !isServerOnline ? 'none' : 'text',
                  transition: 'filter 0.25s ease',
                }}
              >
                {renderActiveTabContent()}
              </div>

              {!isServerOnline && (
                <OfflineNoticeOverlay onManualRetry={retryConnection} isChecking={isCheckingServer} />
              )}
            </main>

            <Footer
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              divisionOrCity={school.division}
              isDatabaseConnected={isServerOnline}
              isGateSystemOnline={isServerOnline}
            />
          </div>

          <ProfileModal
            isOpen={isProfileModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(false)}
            onProfileUpdated={(updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => {
              const safeName = typeof updated.full_name === 'string' && updated.full_name.trim() !== '' ? updated.full_name.trim() : undefined;
              if (safeName) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', safeName);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, faculty_name: safeName } : null));
              }
              if (updated.photo !== undefined) {
                setUserPhoto(updated.photo || null);
                if (updated.photo) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', updated.photo);
                else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');
              }
            }}
          />

          <CompleteProfileModal
            isOpen={isCompleteProfileModalOpen}
            onCompleted={(updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => {
              setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(false);
              const safeName = String(updatedUser.full_name || updatedUser.username || '').trim();
              const photo = (typeof updatedUser.photo_url === 'string' && updatedUser.photo_url) || (typeof updatedUser.photo === 'string' && updatedUser.photo) || null;
              if (safeName) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', safeName);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, faculty_name: safeName } : null));
              }
              if (photo) {
                setUserPhoto(photo);
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
              }
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <SchoolProvider>
        <AlertProvider>
          <AppContent />
        </AlertProvider>
      </SchoolProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
};

export default App;

/**
 * AttendSure V3 - Application Entry Point
 * File: web/src/main.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';
import './index.css';
import appLogoSrc from './assets/attendsure-logo.svg';

// Dynamically generate a high-contrast PNG favicon from SVG emblem
const applyAppFavicon = () => {
  try {
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = appLogoSrc;

    img.onload = () => {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 64;
        canvas.height = 64;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) return;

        // Circular background badge for clear contrast on dark browser tabs
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(32, 32, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
        ctx.stroke();

        // Render AttendSure emblem centered
        ctx.drawImage(img, 10, 10, 44, 44);

        const pngDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

        // Safely remove existing icon links to prevent duplicate DOM tags
        const existingIcons = document.querySelectorAll("link[rel*='icon']");
        existingIcons.forEach((el) => el.remove());

        // Inject new favicon link
        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.type = 'image/png';
        link.rel = 'icon';
        link.href = pngDataUrl;
        document.head.appendChild(link);
      } catch (err) {
        // Fallback silently if canvas operations fail
      }
    };

    img.onerror = () => {
      // Keep existing default favicon if image load fails
    };
  } catch {
    // Top-level error catch prevents favicon logic from blocking UI render
  }
};

// Apply high-contrast favicon
applyAppFavicon();

// Mount root React application
const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');
if (rootElement) {
  ReactDOM.createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <React.StrictMode>
      <App />
    </React.StrictMode>
  );
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>

// File: D:\AttendSure_V3\web\vite.config.ts

import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import type { ServerResponse } from 'http';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src'),
    },
  },
  server: {
    port: 80, // Default HTTP port
    host: true, // Listen on all network interfaces (0.0.0.0)
    strictPort: true,
    // Protect against host-header injection and unauthorized tunnels
    allowedHosts: [
      'lapasan.attendsure.com.ph',
      '.attendsure.com.ph',
      '.trycloudflare.com',
      'localhost',
      '127.0.0.1',
    ],
    fs: {
      allow: [path.resolve(__dirname, '..')],
    },
    proxy: {
      '/api': {
        target: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        timeout: 10000,
        configure: (proxy) => {
          proxy.on('error', (err, _req, res) => {
            // Guard: verify res is an HTTP response before writing headers
            if (res && 'writeHead' in res && typeof res.writeHead === 'function') {
              const httpRes = res as ServerResponse;
              if (!httpRes.headersSent) {
                httpRes.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                httpRes.end(
                  JSON.stringify({
                    error: 'Backend offline or restarting',
                    detail: err.message,
                  })
                );
              }
            }
          });
        },
      },
      '/media': {
        target: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
      },
    },
  },
  build: {
    chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1200,
    sourcemap: false, // Cybersecurity: prevent source code leaks in production
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        // Universal function syntax compatible with all Vite and Rollup releases
        manualChunks(id: string) {
          if (id.includes('node_modules')) {
            if (id.includes('react') || id.includes('react-dom')) {
              return 'vendor-react';
            }
            if (id.includes('lucide-react')) {
              return 'vendor-icons';
            }
            if (id.includes('axios')) {
              return 'vendor-network';
            }
          }
        },
      },
    },
  },
});
